title: Software Development Engineer III
description:
**Company Description**
 Entain India is the engineering and delivery powerhouse for Entain, one of the world's leading global sports and gaming groups. Established in Hyderabad in 2001, we've grown from a small tech hub into a dynamic force, delivering cutting\-edge software solutions and support services that power billions of transactions for millions of users worldwide.
   

  

 Our focus on quality at scale drives us to create innovative technology that supports Entain's mission to lead the change in global sports and gaming sector. At Entain India, we make the impossible possible, together.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As an SDE III, you'll bring your engineering depth into a new way of working. You won't just write code — you'll specify, orchestrate, validate, and ship with AI as your primary collaborator. You'll work in a small, mission\-driven cross\-functional team called a pod — three functions (Product, Engineer, Quality) with high agency, shared ownership, and no hand\-offs.
   

  

 Reporting to the Tech Lead, you'll join the Product \& Technology Team. Are you ready to be part of a team that's redefining how software gets built in an AI Native setup?
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Deliver against the pod's mission — own the full software delivery lifecycle including quality, from design through production and measurement.
* Operate in continuous flow (Kanban) — pull work, respect WIP limits, ship daily.
* Use AI agents as your primary delivery mechanism — code generation, testing, spec writing, deployment.
* Design, build, and debug software across backend and frontend with distributed systems awareness.
* Evaluate and tune agent workflows — steering docs, prompts, rules, skills. You improve the tools you use.
* Write clean, well\-tested code and take ownership of quality end\-to\-end.
* Act as the initial on\-call responder, ensuring health and stability of deployed applications.
* Mentor junior developers and contribute to shared tooling, knowledge bases, and the agent foundation kit.


 Engineering Mindset — What We Look For
   

  

**We Assess Every Candidate Across Six Core Dimensions**
* AI Fluency: AI is the primary way we engineer. Prompt, evaluate, and iterate. Manual coding is a deliberate choice, not the default.
* Cross\-Functional Versatility: “That’s not my area” doesn’t exist. Contribute beyond your discipline, share knowledge openly, and communicate clearly across different formats.
* Customer and Value Awareness: Ask “why” and “for whom” before “how.” Understand the bigger business context while still being able to zoom in and trace a bug. Map dependencies before you build.
* Craft: Apply SOLID principles, DRY, separation of concerns, and observability by default. Write clean, maintainable code with the right level of testing. Treat CI/CD as standard engineering practice, whether the code is written by a human or an AI agent.
* Technical Curiosity: Build a prototype, experiment, and try to break it before relying solely on documentation. Stay curious about how things work and continuously explore better approaches.
* Agency \& Entrepreneurship: Don’t wait for permission. Take ownership of outcomes end\-to\-end, enable others to succeed, challenge the status quo, and proactively look for ways to create value.


**Qualifications**
* Strong proficiency in at least one of the following: Java/Spring Boot, Python, .NET, Go, or Angular, with the ability to learn and work with other technologies using AI.
* Strong foundation in engineering fundamentals, including distributed systems, data structures, API design, database concepts, and cloud computing.
* Experience with clean code practices, TDD, CI/CD, and version control.
* Experience with application monitoring, observability, and production debugging.
* Familiarity with Docker/Kubernetes, microservices, and event\-driven architectures.
* Proficiency in using AI\-assisted development tools for code generation, pair programming, and automated testing.
* Experience with agent systems, MCP/tool protocols, or building AI\-augmented workflows.
* Experience designing evaluation and observability strategies for AI\-generated outputs.


**Nice to Have**
* Contributions to shared tooling, internal platforms, or open\-source projects.
* Background in industries with strict regulatory requirements, such as gaming, financial services, or healthcare.


**Additional Information**
 At Entain India, we offer a strong package and the support people need to make an impact. Join us, and a great compensation package is just the beginning. You can expect to receive benefits like:
   

  

* Safe home pickup and home drop.
* A regular bonus and great pension.
* 24 days annual leave.
* Extra paid leave, including wellbeing and development days.
* Life assurance and Income Protection.
* Private healthcare and wellbeing support.
* INR 3,000 per month Communication allowance.
* Up to INR 16,000 per year in Crèche expenses (children under 3\).

You'll collaborate with cross\-functional teams to architect robust, scalable systems that handle real\-world financial transactions at Amazon scale, making meaningful contributions to credit and lending businesses that span continents.

The team values collaboration and technical excellence, creating an environment where engineers grow their expertise while delivering high\-impact solutions.

**Company Description**
 Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
   

  

**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
 Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
   

  

 As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
   

  

**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
 More about
 **our mission** 
 and
 **what we offer** 
 .
   

  

 All our customers start their Wise journey by going through customer verification. We do this to keep our customers' money safe and to prevent criminals from using our products for illegal activities.
   

  

 We in Personal Onboarding Verification are building and running the global KYC (Know Your Customer) system that provides the functionality to verify our customers. This system needs to keep up with increasingly sophisticated methods of criminals, but do it in a way to keep our product convenient and cheap for customers.
   

  

 In addition to building global KYC features, our team also builds the framework for our Regional Teams to localize the verification experience. Our colleagues in Regional Teams extend the system with local verification vendors, collect documents specific to the country and implement any other checks that the local regulations mandate.
   

  

 To succeed, our team needs to implement a system that keeps up with state of the art technology, enables several teams to contribute while keeping complexity and load manageable and has the data and observability to analyse our flows and prove they work according to regulations.
   

  

**Team You Will Be Working With**
 You'll join our Personal Onboarding Verification team – a diverse, cross\-functional group passionate about solving complex problems with elegant solutions. We bring together engineering disciplines across the stack, designers, data analysts, and product managers who collaborate closely to deliver exceptional customer experiences. Our team is responsible for the critical verification journey that consumers complete before using Wise's products. We own the entire verification lifecycle – from document collection flows and automated review systems to agent tooling and compliance monitoring. We operate with high autonomy, make data\-driven decisions, and celebrate both technical excellence and customer impact. As a team that touches both regulatory requirements and customer experience, we have unique opportunities to innovate in a space traditionally resistant to change.
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
   

  

 We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
   

  

 Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
   

  

 If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
   

  

 Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

 As a Backend Engineer, you’ll be responsible for building the backend infrastructure that powers Lane’s telemetry and driving intelligence platform. * Build and maintain scalable backend services, APIs, and data ingestion systems.

* Build secure authentication, authorization, and role\-based access systems for enterprise and internal users.

* 2–5 years of experience in backend engineering.
* Strong proficiency in at least one backend language such as Node.js, Python, Go, or Java.

* Experience working with AWS or other cloud platforms.
* Strong understanding of REST/GraphQL APIs and backend architecture.
* Understanding of scalable, high\-throughput, and real\-time data systems.
* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills.
* Ability to take end\-to\-end ownership in a fast\-moving startup environment.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience with IoT, telematics, connected vehicles, or sensor data.

* Familiarity with Flutter, iOS, or Android backend integrations.
* Experience working with time\-series databases or real\-time analytics.
* Exposure to AI/ML data pipelines or data processing systems.



  





**Why Join Lane?** 



* Build the core technology infrastructure behind Lane’s driving intelligence and mobility platform.
* Work on real\-world telemetry and high\-frequency data at scale.
* High ownership and the opportunity to influence architecture and engineering decisions.
* Direct collaboration with senior technical and business leadership.
* Be part of a fast\-growing startup working towards a future with safer roads and smarter mobility.

Today, Dentira operates across the US, Canada, Asia Pacific, and Europe. Building on this foundation, our Lab Platform streamlines case creation and management by connecting clinics, intraoral scanners, and dental labs. We’re also applying AI to complex healthcare problems such as automatic invoice reconciliation, procedure cost prediction, and intelligent procurement, with solutions that have broad applicability across healthcare. As we expand into adjacent verticals, our goal is to achieve 10X growth over the next 3 years and be at the forefront of Agentic Commerce for healthcare supplies. Dentira just raised a $50M Series B from Vista Equity Partners, one of the world's leading technology\-focused private equity firms and an investor behind landmark software transactions including the $16\.5B acquisition of Citrix.
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer with 5\+ years of experience building performant, scalable, and reliable systems at product companies and startups.You’ll work on challenging engineering problems spanning distributed systems, data\-intensive platforms, event\-driven architectures, APIs, AI\-powered workflows, and high\-scale backend infrastructure that directly power healthcare operations across multiple markets. This is a high\-ownership role.
 



 You’ll take complex and often ambiguous problems from requirements and architecture through implementation, production deployment, observability, scaling, and incident resolution.
 



 We’re looking for someone with strong problem\-solving fundamentals who can use the right abstractions to turn complex real\-world problems into elegant, maintainable systems. You should be comfortable operating in a fast\-paced environment with changing priorities and influencing technical decisions beyond your immediate area of ownership.
 



 You should also be AI\-native in how you engineer \- comfortable using coding agents, LLM\-powered development workflows,and agentic practices to accelerate implementation, debugging, testing, and system understanding.
 



  





**Primary Requirements** 




  




* 5\+ years of experience building and scaling backend services and microservices using Nodejs (with TypeScript) and Go.
* Strong expertise in API design best practices across REST and GraphQL, with a solid understanding of HTTP fundamentals, API contracts, versioning, reliability, and performance.
* Deep experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, including PostgreSQL and MongoDB, with expertise in database design, query optimization, indexing, and operating databases at scale.
* Strong data modelling skills, with the ability to design schemas and domain models that remain maintainable as products and requirements evolve.
* Strong ability to use abstractions effectively \- designing clean interfaces, reusable components, and well\-defined system boundaries without unnecessary complexity.
* Strong hands\-on experience with event\-driven architectures and distributed systems, including message brokers such as RabbitMQ or Kafka, with the ability to design for scalability, resilience, consistency, and reliability.

* Strong understanding of backend system performance, concurrency, caching, asynchronous processing, fault tolerance, observability, and production reliability.
* End\-to\-end ownership of backend systems \- from requirement clarification and architecture design through implementation, production deployment, monitoring, scaling, and incident resolution.
* Solid foundation in data structures and algorithms, coupled with strong debugging and troubleshooting skills.
* Experience mentoring engineers, conducting thoughtful code and architecture reviews, and influencing engineering standards and technical best practices.
* An AI\-native engineering mindset, with demonstrated ability to effectively use coding agents and agentic development practices to accelerate development, debugging, testing, and problem\-solving.



  





**Good to Have** 




  




* Experience designing or operating LLM\-powered production systems, especially where correctness matters
* Worked with agent orchestration frameworks, or with MCP and the surrounding ecosystem
* Open\-source contributions or meaningful participation in developer communities.

title: Principal Engineer
description:
**About Neo** 




  





 AI is the most significant shift in how work gets done since the advent of the Internet — yet most organizations fail to capture its value.
 **Neo** 
 is changing that.
 



 Founded by
 **Bhavin Turakhia**
 — Co\-Founder of
 
 Zeta
 
 ,
 
 Radix
 
 , and
 
 Titan
 
 —
 **Neo** 
 is building an integrated, AI\-first suite of products that capture work, centralize context, and make AI a first\-class participant in every workflow:
 



**Tasket** 
 — A radically reimagined, AI\-native work management platform that centralizes context and makes AI delegation seamless for all work.
 



**Friday** 
 — AI Assistant, co\-worker and agent platform, pre\-integrated into Tasket, Studio, Drive and 1000\+ SaaS platforms.
 



**Studio** 
 — AI\-native suite for co\-creating docs, spreadsheets and diagrams collaboratively with humans and agents.
 



**Scribe** 
 — AI assistant for meetings that goes beyond note\-taking and actually does your work while on the call.
 



  





**About the role** 




 As a Principal Engineer you will own the design and architecture of the suite and mentor engineers across teams.
 



 We are proponents of leveraging best\-in\-breed AI tools at every step of the engineering lifecycle — design, development, review, and testing. This requires a different engineering mindset: a lean team of senior, hands\-on, AI\-adept engineers, resulting in ultra\-rapid iteration cycles and fast output. You will own and oversee this approach for the systems you lead, from design through to production.
 



 This is a role for a proactive, independent decision\-maker who is at home reasoning from system internals up to cross\-team architecture, and who raises the bar for what both people and agents ship.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 Architecture \& technical direction
 


* Own the architecture of Neo's backend services and frontend components — service boundaries, data models
* Resolve cross\-cutting reliability, performance, and security concerns
* Build platforms, reusable libraries, and utilities that make the team faster and the codebase consistent.



  





 Execution \& delivery
 


* Drive delivery end to end: turn a spec into shipped software by breaking it down, running agents in parallel to implement, and steering them to a working result.
* Own verification — the real bottleneck in an agentic workflow. Decide what "correct" means for a system and make sure what ships actually meets it, before it reaches users.



  





 AI\-first SDLC harness
 


* Build and improve the harness the team builds with — specs, reusable skills, subagents, evals, and guardrails that let many agents work in parallel and give consistent results regardless of the underlying tool.
* Set the quality gates that agent\-authored changes pass before a human reviews them, and improve them as failure modes show up.



  





 Mentoring \& raising the bar
 


* Mentor engineers and run design reviews; turn what works into standards, templates, and paved roads the whole team uses.
* Spread good agent practice across the team so its leverage compounds, not just your own.



  





 Product thinking
 


* Work with product to pin down the right problem before building — scope feasibility, surface trade\-offs, and push back when the cost isn't worth the outcome.
* Own outcomes, not tickets.



  





**Skills** 



* AI\-native engineering practice — Fluent in an agentic development workflow: spec\-driven delivery, running and steering coding agents, and building the harness (specs, skills, evals, guardrails) that makes agent output reliable at the team level
* Strong language \& runtime fundamentals — Deep proficiency in one or more of the languages we work in — Java, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go — including OOP and design, concurrency, memory management, and how your runtime behaves under load. Comfortable picking the right language for the job rather than defaulting to one.
* System internals — Working knowledge of processor, memory, network, and storage internals, and how to write code that exploits hardware well and avoids bottlenecks.
* Distributed systems — Fault modelling, concurrency, isolation, and consensus; time, clocks, and ordering of events; rate control and load distribution. Strong design and problem\-solving instincts for performance, scalability, security, and reliability.
* Internals of core infrastructure — Hands\-on with the internals of Kafka, Cassandra/Scylla, and Redis — enough to troubleshoot, tune, and make sound usage decisions.
* I/O\-optimised algorithms — Asynchronous and non\-blocking I/O and DMA, for high throughput in performance\-critical paths.
* Hosting \& orchestration — Kubernetes and containerised deployment of cloud\-native applications.
* Low\-level network protocols — Familiarity with gRPC, HTTP/2, and QUIC.
* Troubleshooting \& performance — Diagnosing memory issues, GC tuning, and resource leaks to keep systems stable and efficient under load.
* Delivery engineering — Branching, build, deployment, and CI/CD practices that keep delivery fast and high\-quality.
* OOAD \& algorithms — Object\-oriented analysis and design and efficient data structures for well\-structured, maintainable, performant systems.
* Cloud — AWS / Google Cloud / Azure (OpenStack where relevant).



  





**Experience \& Qualifications** 



* 8\+ years in software development and delivery, with a track record of architecting systems at scale.
* Production experience across a modern stack — e.g. Java / Python with REST, SQL (PostgreSQL or MySQL), messaging systems, and microservices.
* Engineering degree in computer science or equivalent.



  





**Equal Opportunity** 




 Neo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds, cultures, and communities to apply and believe that a diverse workforce is key to our success.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Backend)
description:
**Company Description**
 Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
   

  

**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
 Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
   

  

 As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
   

  

**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
 More about
 **our mission** 
 and
 **what we offer** 
 .
   

  

 We are the Global KYC and Onboarding squad in the Servicing department and we have a mission: to enable teams at Wise to expand and fine\-tune the business in a "config change" manner all across the globe, while remaining compliant and safe for the customers. There are three teams in the squad: Business Onboarding Verification, Personal Onboarding Verification and Wise Platform Verification (our B2B platform).
   

  

 The scale we operate at: In FY2025, 15\.6 million people and businesses used Wise, we onboarded over 5\.9 million new customers (\~500k/month), and moved £145\.2bn across borders (\~£400m/day) across 160\+ countries and 40\+ currencies. Our verification systems aren't supporting tools — they're core production infrastructure that protects customers, enables growth, and must stay reliable under constant change in regulations, policies, and evolving threat patterns.
   

  

 All of the teams are diverse, cross\-functional groups passionate about solving complex problems with elegant solutions. We bring together backend and frontend engineers, mobile developers, designers, data analysts, and product managers who collaborate closely to deliver exceptional customer experiences. Our teams are responsible for the critical verification journeys that business and personal customers complete before using Wise's products. We own the entire verification lifecycle – from document collection flows and automated review systems to agent tooling and compliance monitoring. We operate with high ownership in a bottom\-up, transparent culture, make data\-driven decisions, and celebrate both technical excellence and customer impact. Right now we're focused on building KYC/FinCrime as a configuration\-driven product, refactoring and building new scalable microservice systems, and increasing automation using ML/AI where it genuinely improves decisioning, review quality, and operational efficiency — with safe fallbacks and clear observability. As a team that touches both regulatory requirements and customer experience, we have unique opportunities to innovate in a space traditionally resistant to change.
   

  

 By joining one of our teams, you'll directly impact these customers by transforming a traditionally frustrating experience into one that's fast, intuitive, and fair. Your code will help individuals and small businesses access global banking faster, enable entrepreneurs to pay international employees on time, and allow people like you and your teammates support their families across borders without friction. We're not just building verification systems – we're removing barriers that stand between our customers and their financial freedom.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 As a Senior Software Engineer, you will own large\-sized, impactful projects within the domain. Your responsibilities span end\-to\-end:
   

  

 You will own the technical roadmap for your areas of ownership, ensuring they address important technical debt, reliability, scalability, and security concerns.
   

  

 You will be instrumental in designing and implementing robust backend systems that provide clean APIs and interfaces to hide the internal complexity.
   

  

 You will drive the integration with various risk and mitigation systems to ensure that Wise is compliant.
   

  

 You will take initiative to identify and solve impactful problems both within your team and beyond, contributing to high\-impact cross\-team initiatives.
   

  

**What We Expect From You**
 You have 6\+ years of experience working with Java 8\+, Spring framework, asynchronous message queues (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ), and have architected and built highly scalable microservices.
   

  

 A strong product mindset and a deep passion for both customer experience and regulatory compliance.
   

  

 You will prioritize work with a holistic view of the customer and business impact, making data\-driven decisions to solve complex, ambiguous problems.
   

  

 Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical and architectural concepts clearly to diverse audiences, including product managers, designers, and other engineering teams.
   

  

 You demonstrate a commitment to writing clean, testable, maintainable, and highly performant code, and you are a strong advocate for best coding practices and rigorous code reviews.
   

  

 Proven ability to identify and lead the technical delivery of large\-scale, organisationally\-complex projects, adept at anticipating and escalating organizational blockers.
   

  

 Extensive experience working with relational and non\-relational databases, including advanced query optimization, schema design, and data lifecycle management for sensitive information.
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
   

  

 We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
   

  

 Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
   

  

 If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
   

  

 Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

title: Engineering Lead
description:
**We’re looking for people to join the Access family, who share our passion for believing in better, and who will help us continue to grow.**









 Love Work. Love Life. Be You. \- is central to our success and how we give our customers the freedom to do more of what's important to them.
 








**What does Access offer you?**









 We offer a blended approach to office working, encouraging you to collaborate and connect in one of our thriving offices. We deliver on what we say, taking the development of our people seriously. We’ll work with you to progress your success plan and provide opportunities to accelerate your career.
 








**Position Summary** 




 The Lead Software Engineer is a ‘50:50’ role. Half the time you are in the code — shipping production software, holding the technical bar and setting the standard the team follows. The other half you are leading the people, the process and the architecture — running a high\-performing engineering stream and developing the engineers within it.
 







 You’ll be joining a small, value\-aligned structure: up to two streams of four engineers each, with Product cover per stream. QA is owned by engineering — there is no handoff to a separate team, and that is by design.
 







 The F\&B Software Company sits within Access Hospitality, with engineering teams distributed globally, and powers many millions of guest experiences every day. The portfolio includes ResDiary, Dish Cult, DesignMyNight, Collins, Tonic, Soda, Wireless Social, Paytronix, Paytronix Online Ordering, QikServe Digital Ordering, Kiosk, QikServe Connect, Access EPOS, Newbridge POS, GuestPOS, Acteol, Trail, Maintain, RotaReady and CPL.
 







 AI augmentation is a pre\-requisite for this role, not an optional extra. Access has invested in cutting\-edge AI tooling and we expect every engineer and leader to use AI pervasively to accelerate outcomes, raise quality, and shorten feedback loops. Lead Software Engineers are expected to model this behaviour, embed it into team standards and hold the bar for AI adoption across their streams. If you are not already working this way, you will need to get there fast.
 







**Key Accountabilities and Responsibilities** 




**Technical Leadership** 



* Spend approximately half your time as a hands\-on engineer: writing, reviewing and shipping production code to the same standard you hold your team to.
* Own the technical direction of your stream — architecture decisions, technology choices, design patterns and code standards.
* Set and maintain the engineering quality bar: code review standards, test coverage expectations, CI/CD discipline, observability and security practice.
* Identify and address technical debt proactively, balancing pragmatism with the long\-term health of the codebase.
* Contribute to platform\-wide architectural decisions, feeding your stream’s experience and evidence back into broader engineering strategy.







**People Leadership** 



* Own the performance, development and wellbeing of up to eight engineers across your streams.
* Run regular 1:1s, set clear goals, and give direct, actionable feedback — both positive and developmental.
* Manage the full performance cycle for your engineers: goal setting, mid\-year reviews, end\-of\-year assessments and, where necessary, performance improvement plans.
* Identify growth opportunities for each engineer and actively create the conditions for them to progress.
* Hire well — contribute to recruitment, assess candidates rigorously, and take accountability for the quality of who joins your team.
* Model the behaviours and working practices you expect from the team, including AI adoption, communication standards and engineering discipline.







**Delivery \& Process** 



* Keep your streams delivering consistently — predictable throughput, low change failure rate, fast recovery when things go wrong.
* Own the engineering process within your streams: sprint ceremonies, planning quality, backlog health and cross\-team dependency management.
* Work closely with Product to balance feature delivery against technical investment, making the trade\-offs visible and explicit rather than absorbed silently.
* Remove blockers for your engineers — escalate where needed, resolve where you can, and protect the team’s ability to focus.
* Ensure incidents are handled well: fast triage, clear communication, thorough post\-mortems, and unique failures — the same class of incident should not recur.







**Key Performance Indicators** 




**Technical** 



* Software owned by your streams meets reliability, latency and availability targets in production.
* Lead time for change trends downwards; deployment frequency trends upwards across your streams.
* Change failure rate stays under 15%; MTTR trends downwards.
* Critical and high security vulnerabilities patched within agreed SLAs (1 day / 14 days).
* AI tooling is a demonstrable, routine part of your workflow and embedded visibly in team standards.







**People** 



* Engineers in your streams have clear goals, regular feedback and a development plan they understand.
* Regrettable attrition is low; engineers in your streams are growing and progressing.
* Performance issues are identified early and managed directly, without escalation becoming the default.
* New hires reach productive contribution within an agreed onboarding window.







**Delivery** 



* Your streams deliver predictably against commitments made to Product and stakeholders.
* Failures are unique — the same defect or incident class does not recur.
* Technical debt is visible, prioritised and moving in the right direction.







**Skills, Knowledge, Experience \& Qualifications** 




**How We Work** 




 Before the tech stack, this is what working in the F\&B engineering team looks like. As a Lead Software Engineer you are expected to model these standards, not just meet them.
 


* AI tooling is your default starting point, not a fallback — Copilot, Claude Code, Devin, Cursor or equivalent are open before you write the first line.
* You use AI pervasively across the full development lifecycle: generating and reviewing code, writing tests, producing documentation, triaging incidents and researching unfamiliar domains.
* You can prompt effectively — you know how to get useful output, iterate on it, and critically evaluate what comes back rather than accepting it at face value.
* You treat AI\-generated code with the same scrutiny as code from a colleague — it gets reviewed, tested and owned by you.
* You actively embed AI working practices into your team — through standards, playbooks, code review culture and leading by example.
* You improve your AI working practices continuously and bring the team with you; this field moves fast and standing still is falling behind.
* Expect your interview process to include assessment on how you work with AI tooling — not just what you know without it. Come prepared to demonstrate your workflow, not just talk about it.







**Technical Foundation** 




 The fundamentals are non\-negotiable — your technical credibility is what earns the trust of your engineers.
 


* Strong commercial software engineering background with a track record of shipping production systems end\-to\-end.
* Clean code, automated testing and CI/CD discipline — you set the standard, which means you have to embody it.
* Comfortable across the stack — backend, frontend or full\-stack — able to review and contribute across the breadth of what your streams own.
* Solid SQL and relational database skills; experience with cloud\-hosted databases in production.
* Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs and/or event\-driven architectures.
* Familiarity with containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes or equivalent).
* Experience making and communicating architectural decisions, including the trade\-offs involved.







**Leadership \& People** 



* Proven experience leading a software engineering team — setting direction, managing performance and developing engineers.
* Direct, honest and constructive communicator — comfortable giving difficult feedback and having conversations that matter.
* Able to manage competing priorities across engineering and people responsibilities without dropping either.
* Experience running engineering process — agile delivery, planning, retrospectives, incident management.
* Comfortable working asynchronously across distributed teams (UK and India).







**Technologies** 




 Access F\&B runs a broad and evolving tech stack. We care far more about solid fundamentals and the ability to learn than exact technology match.
 


* Java — present across several F\&B product areas.
* TypeScript / React — frontend and web\-based ordering and management interfaces.
* Azure — our primary cloud platform; experience with Azure\-native services (App Service, Service Bus, SQL, AKS, Key Vault) is valuable.
* AWS — also present across parts of the F\&B portfolio.







**Security \& Compliance** 



* Working knowledge of security fundamentals: auth and authorisation patterns, secrets management, encryption at rest and in transit, and PII handling.
* Awareness of GDPR and UK GDPR as they apply to software systems handling guest and payment data.











**What are we all about?** 








 The Access Group is one of the largest UK\-headquartered business management software providers. It provides solutions that empower more than 160,000 small and mid\-sized organisations in commercial and non\-profit sectors across Europe, USA and APAC, giving every employee the freedom to do more of what's important. Its innovative cloud solutions and integrated AI software experience across multiple Access products transform how business technology is used.
 







 With
 **over 9,300 talented individuals driving innovation and customer excellence** 
 , we’re shaping the future of work. And we want you to be part of it. At Access,
 **people are at the heart of everything we do** 
 . We’re committed to creating an inclusive, high\-performing culture where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive. If you’re excited about this role \- even if your experience doesn’t tick every box \- you might be exactly who we’re looking for.
 







 We believe in equality for all and the transformative power of diversity. So why not join our vibrant team, where you can love what you do, love how you live, and most importantly, be authentically you?
 







 Let’s make a difference together.
 



**Love Work. Love Life. Be You.**

title: Lead Backend Engineer - Data Platform
description:
**ABOUT WINGIFY:** 




 Wingify \+ AB Tasty is a global leader in Digital Experience Optimization. In 2026, VWO and AB Tasty joined forces to build a unified platform spanning experimentation, personalization, feature management, behavioural insights, and AI.
 



 Together, we serve 4,000\+ customers globally, with nearly 800 people across 11 offices and more than $100M in revenue.
 



 Both companies were founded 15\+ years ago with experimentation at their core and share a similar engineering philosophy: deep thinking, fast execution, strong ownership, and minimal bureaucracy.
 



 As we bring two mature technology platforms together, we are solving complex engineering problems around data scale, analytics architecture, identity, reporting, and platform convergence.
 



  





  





**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




 We are looking for a
 **Lead Engineer \- Backend / Data Platform** 
 to provide technical leadership for backend and data\-intensive systems powering analytics, reporting, experimentation, and behavioural insights across Wingify \+ AB Tasty.
 



 This is a
 **hands\-on technical leadership** 
 role, not an engineering management position.
 



 You will continue to design systems and write production code, while also owning architecture and technical direction for significant workstreams.
 



 You will work across
 **Java, ClickHouse, BigQuery, Bigtable, Redis, Kafka, and GCP,** 
 solving problems spanning event ingestion, distributed processing, query engines, analytical storage, low\-latency serving, and reporting.
 



 A key part of the role is helping us evolve two mature analytics platforms toward a more unified data foundation without compromising the reliability of systems already serving production customers.
 



  





  





**WHAT YOU'LL WORK WITH** 



* Java, Spring Boot and JVM\-based backend services
* ClickHouse and ClickHouse Cloud for high\-volume analytics
* BigQuery for large\-scale analytical workloads
* Bigtable for low\-latency NoSQL serving
* Kafka and Pub/Sub for real\-time event streaming
* Redis for caching and distributed coordination
* GCP, including GCS, Dataflow, GKE and VMs
* Apache Beam / Dataflow for distributed data processing
* Go for adjacent reporting and SQL services



  





**WHAT YOU'LL DO** 



* Own the architecture and technical design of significant backend and data\-platform workstreams.
* Design distributed systems for high\-volume event ingestion, analytical querying, data processing, and low\-latency serving.
* Remain hands\-on with Java and production backend development.
* Build and evolve backend services, APIs, query engines, data pipelines, and distributed processing systems.
* Make architectural decisions around data modelling, storage engines, partitioning, query patterns, caching, streaming, reliability, and cost.
* Design and optimise systems using ClickHouse, BigQuery, Bigtable, Redis, Kafka, and related technologies.
* Write and optimise complex analytical SQL and troubleshoot query\-performance bottlenecks.
* Solve challenging production problems involving data correctness, pipeline failures, latency, throughput, and infrastructure.
* Own critical systems from design and implementation through deployment, observability, and production operations.
* Review technical designs and architecture proposed by other engineers.
* Mentor engineers and help improve system\-design and production\-engineering capabilities across the team.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Data, and Infrastructure teams to translate complex requirements into scalable technical solutions.



  





  





**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** 



* 6\+ years of hands\-on backend/software engineering experience.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Java and backend development.
* Experience designing and building distributed or data\-intensive production systems.
* Strong system\-design and architecture fundamentals.
* Experience with analytical databases, data warehouses, or large\-scale non\-relational databases.
* Strong understanding of data modelling, partitioning, indexing, clustering, caching, and query optimisation.
* Strong SQL skills, particularly for analytical workloads.
* Experience designing and operating event\-driven or streaming architectures using Kafka, Pub/Sub, or similar technologies.
* Experience building batch and/or streaming data pipelines at scale.
* Hands\-on cloud experience. GCP is preferred.
* Strong production debugging and troubleshooting skills across applications, databases, pipelines, and infrastructure.
* Experience reviewing technical designs, mentoring engineers, and influencing architecture.



  





  





**NICE TO HAVE** 



* Production experience with ClickHouse.
* Experience with BigQuery and/or Bigtable at scale.
* Apache Beam / Dataflow.
* Snowflake or warehouse\-native compute.
* Experience processing billions of events or TB/PB\-scale analytical datasets.
* Go or Vert.x.
* Experience with experimentation platforms, A/B testing, funnels, segmentation, identity, cohorts, or behavioural analytics.
* Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Prometheus, Grafana, or GCP Cloud Monitoring.



  





**WHY THIS ROLE** 




 You will work on a production data platform that already operates at significant scale while helping shape the next generation of analytics infrastructure across Wingify \+ AB Tasty.
 



 This is an opportunity to remain deeply hands\-on while influencing architecture, solving complex distributed\-system problems, and helping bring two mature analytics platforms onto a common data foundation.

**Job Description**

 We are looking for a motivated and hands\-on
 **Senior Software Engineer** 
 to join the CRONUS Platform Team and strengthen the Identity module for Portfolio Brands. The role will focus on building secure, reliable and scalable backend services that support customer registration, login, authentication, authorization and personal\-data protection.

 As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design and deliver secure customer identity capabilities and production\-grade backend services.

* Design, build and maintain backend services using Java and Spring Boot.

 Reliability, availability, monitoring, alerts and performance engineering.

 Quality automation using Playwright and process automation using RPA.

 Incident management, problem management and platform stability.

* **Overall Experience:** 
 8\-10 years of relevant software engineering experience, including designing, developing, testing and operating backend applications or services.
* **Java:** 
 Strong and recent hands\-on experience with Java 17\+ and core Java concepts, including object\-oriented design, collections, exception handling, concurrency and clean code.
* **Spring Boot:** 
 Practical experience building production\-grade REST APIs and microservices using Spring Boot and the wider Spring ecosystem.
* **IAM / CIAM:** 
 Meaningful hands\-on experience with customer identity and access management, including authentication, authorization, user identity, access control, identity journeys, customer profiles, consent and personal\-data protection.

 Experience with Azure AD B2C / Microsoft Entra External ID or a comparable CIAM platform. You should understand user flows or policies, registration, MFA, social identity providers, tokens and backend integration.
* **Identity Standards:** 
 Good understanding of OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, JWT and token lifecycle management.
* **Backend Engineering:** 
 Strong experience with API design, microservices, secure coding, databases, system integrations, performance, reliability and production support.
* **Cloud \& Containers:** 
 Experience with cloud\-native development, Docker and Kubernetes. Azure experience is preferred.
* **CI/CD:** 
 Experience with automated build, test and deployment pipelines.
* **Databases:** 
 Practical experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases, for example PostgreSQL or Cosmos DB.
* **Testing:** 
 Experience with unit, integration, contract, security and performance testing.
* **Observability:** 
 Experience with logging, monitoring, metrics, tracing and production alerting.

* Exposure to Strivacity or another modern customer identity platform.

* Experience in e\-commerce or another high\-traffic customer\-facing digital platform.



**And people who are**



* Passionate about secure, reliable and simple customer experiences.
* Comfortable taking ownership and moving complex work from problem to production.
* Collaborative team players who work well in global, cross\-functional environments.
* Proactive problem\-solvers who balance technical quality with practical delivery.
* Able to explain technical choices, risks and trade\-offs in clear language.
* Interested in mentoring colleagues and growing into broader technical leadership responsibilities.
* Curious and adaptable as technologies and identity platforms evolve.



**WHO WE ARE** 
**​**




 H\&M is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​
   

  





 We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​
   

  





 Help us re\-imagine fashion and together we will re\-shape our industry. Learn more about H\&M here.
   

  





**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE** 
**​**




 At H\&M, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. ​
   

  





 We offer all our employees at H\&M attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H\&M brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H\&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H\&M HOME, \& Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H\&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H\&M Incentive Program here.
   

  

  

  

 In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment types and countries.
   

  





**JOIN US**

 Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​

title: SDE III Backend Engineer — Simulation / DES
description:
**Own core simulation engine work: the tick loop, task allocation, traffic and collision resolution, and the boundary where third\-party algorithm plugins hook into the simulation.**
**What You'll Do**
* Build and extend the discrete\-event simulation core: tick scheduling, robot state machines, task generation, and traffic or path deconfliction.
* Implement and optimize simulation algorithms — task allocation heuristics, multi\-agent path planning such as SIPP\-A\* — for correctness and performance at 400\+ agent scale.
* Own parts of the plugin boundary: calling into sandboxed third\-party algorithm modules from the simulation tick loop within a strict per\-tick latency budget.
* Work on the in\-memory map and graph representation the simulator uses for pathfinding and spatial queries.
* Write high\-quality, tested Rust in an async runtime (Tokio), with close attention to allocation patterns and tick\-time predictability.


**What We're Looking For**
* 5\-8 years of backend or systems engineering experience, with meaningful production Rust experience (2\+ years preferred).
* Experience with async Rust (Tokio or equivalent) and building systems with strict per\-operation latency budgets.
* Solid grounding in discrete\-event simulation concepts, multi\-agent systems, or game/robotics simulation — tick loops, state machines, deterministic replay.
* Comfort with algorithmic work: graph algorithms, pathfinding (A\*, Dijkstra, or similar), or scheduling and allocation problems.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with WebAssembly runtimes (Wasmtime, Wasmer, Extism) or sandboxing untrusted code.
* Familiarity with warehouse automation, robotics, AGV/AMR fleet management, or traffic simulation.
* Direct experience with SIPP, A\*, or other real\-time multi\-agent path planning algorithms.

**Job Description**  

We are looking for a motivated and hands\-on **Senior Software Engineer** to join the CRONUS Platform Team and strengthen the Identity module for Portfolio Brands. The role will focus on building secure, reliable and scalable backend services that support customer registration, login, authentication, authorization and personal\-data protection.


You will work with engineers, product managers, architects, security specialists and business stakeholders to improve Customer Identity and Access Management capabilities across Weekday, COS, ARKET and \&Other Stories. You will contribute across the full development lifecycle, including design, coding, testing, deployment, monitoring and production support.


This is a long\-term strategic role with strong ownership. Over time, there will be opportunities to take broader technical leadership responsibilities within the team.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**


As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design and deliver secure customer identity capabilities and production\-grade backend services.


Key responsibilities include:

* Design, build and maintain backend services using Java and Spring Boot.
* Develop and improve customer identity journeys, including registration, sign\-in, password reset, account recovery, multi\-factor authentication and social login.
* Integrate backend services with Azure AD B2C / Microsoft Entra External ID and other customer identity platforms.
* Implement secure authentication and authorization using OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect and token\-based security.
* Build reliable APIs and integrations for customer profile, consent, newsletter and related customer capabilities.
* Protect customer and personal data through secure design, access controls, privacy\-aware data handling and appropriate operational controls.
* Design services for scalability, reliability, performance and maintainability.
* Improve observability through effective logging, monitoring, metrics, tracing and alerts.
* Own services across the full lifecycle, including automated testing, CI/CD, deployment, production support and continuous improvement.
* Investigate technical issues and production incidents, identify root causes and implement long\-term improvements.
* Collaborate with security, architecture, product and engineering teams to turn business needs into practical technical solutions.
* Review code, support engineering standards, mentor colleagues and communicate technical risks and trade\-offs clearly.
* Contribute to the future evolution of the CIAM landscape, including the adoption of new identity platforms such as Strivacity.

**WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH**


The CRONUS Platform Team is part of Portfolio Brands Tech and supports the digital commerce platform used by Weekday, COS, ARKET and \&Other Stories. The team owns shared platform capabilities that help the brands deliver stable, secure and reliable customer experiences.


The Platform Team works across five capability areas:

* **Backend Engineering:** Shared backend services and system\-to\-system integration services.
* **Site Reliability Engineering:** Reliability, availability, monitoring, alerts and performance engineering.
* **Automation:** Quality automation using Playwright and process automation using RPA.
* **Operations:** Incident management, problem management and platform stability.
* **Security \& Compliance:** Security engineering, audits and compliance.


You will work mainly within Backend Engineering and the Identity module, while collaborating closely with SRE, operations, automation, security and other product teams. The team values end\-to\-end ownership, open communication, shared learning and practical solutions that improve customer experience and business reliability.

**WHO YOU ARE**


We are looking for someone with strong backend engineering and customer identity experience, along with a collaborative and ownership\-driven mindset.

* **Overall Experience:** 8\-10 years of relevant software engineering experience, including designing, developing, testing and operating backend applications or services.
* **Java:** Strong and recent hands\-on experience with Java 17\+ and core Java concepts, including object\-oriented design, collections, exception handling, concurrency and clean code.
* **Spring Boot:** Practical experience building production\-grade REST APIs and microservices using Spring Boot and the wider Spring ecosystem.
* **IAM / CIAM:** Meaningful hands\-on experience with customer identity and access management, including authentication, authorization, user identity, access control, identity journeys, customer profiles, consent and personal\-data protection.
* **Azure B2C:** Experience with Azure AD B2C / Microsoft Entra External ID or a comparable CIAM platform. You should understand user flows or policies, registration, MFA, social identity providers, tokens and backend integration.
* **Identity Standards:** Good understanding of OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, JWT and token lifecycle management.
* **Backend Engineering:** Strong experience with API design, microservices, secure coding, databases, system integrations, performance, reliability and production support.
* **Cloud \& Containers:** Experience with cloud\-native development, Docker and Kubernetes. Azure experience is preferred.
* **CI/CD:** Experience with automated build, test and deployment pipelines.
* **Databases:** Practical experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases, for example PostgreSQL or Cosmos DB.
* **Testing:** Experience with unit, integration, contract, security and performance testing.
* **Observability:** Experience with logging, monitoring, metrics, tracing and production alerting.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with event\-driven systems and messaging platforms such as Azure Service Bus or similar technologies.
* Experience migrating between customer identity platforms or modernizing an existing CIAM solution.
* Exposure to Strivacity or another modern customer identity platform.
* Experience working with customer consent, preference or newsletter capabilities.
* Experience in e\-commerce or another high\-traffic customer\-facing digital platform.

**And people who are**

* Passionate about secure, reliable and simple customer experiences.
* Comfortable taking ownership and moving complex work from problem to production.
* Collaborative team players who work well in global, cross\-functional environments.
* Proactive problem\-solvers who balance technical quality with practical delivery.
* Able to explain technical choices, risks and trade\-offs in clear language.
* Interested in mentoring colleagues and growing into broader technical leadership responsibilities.
* Curious and adaptable as technologies and identity platforms evolve.

**WHO WE ARE**

H\&M is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.


We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.


Help us re\-imagine fashion and together we will re\-shape our industry. Learn more about H\&M here.

**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE**

At H\&M, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.


We offer all our employees at H\&M attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H\&M brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H\&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H\&M HOME, \& Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H\&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H\&M Incentive Program here.  

  

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment types and countries.

**JOIN US**

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.


Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.


* *We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.*

title: GeoSpatial Sr.Analyst MAP
description:
Job summary
  
GeoSpatial Senior Analyst MAP will design and enhance enterprise geospatial applications using Java and Net API within a hybrid work environment. The role focuses on advanced spatial data analysis system integration and performance optimization to support strategic business decisions improve operational efficiency and enable socially impactful location based solutions for global clients.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
Analyze complex geospatial data sets and transform raw spatial information into actionable insights that support enterprise planning and operational decision making across multiple business domains.
  
Design and develop robust geospatial services using Java and Net API that enable reliable map visualization spatial querying and location intelligence features for internal and external applications.
  
Implement scalable spatial data processing workflows that optimize performance and accuracy of map related functions while maintaining high standards of data quality and governance.
  
Collaborate with product owners and business analysts to translate geospatial requirements into clear technical specifications and solution designs that align with organizational objectives and digital strategies.
  
Configure and enhance existing mapping platforms to improve usability response times and functional coverage for users in different regions and business units.
  
Conduct detailed code reviews and technical assessments of Java and Net components to ensure adherence to coding best practices security guidelines and long term maintainability standards.
  
Coordinate with data engineering teams to define and refine spatial data models that support efficient storage retrieval and analysis of geo referenced information at enterprise scale.
  
Develop and maintain automated testing scenarios for geospatial services to ensure reliability of routing distance calculations proximity analysis and other spatial functions under varied data conditions.
  
Prepare comprehensive technical documentation for geospatial solutions covering architecture configuration details integration points and operational procedures to support seamless maintenance.
  
Engage with cross functional stakeholders to present geospatial findings and explain how spatial patterns influence customer behavior risk exposure and resource allocation decisions.
  
Monitor production geospatial systems in the hybrid work model and proactively resolve incidents or performance issues to maintain high service availability during day shift operations.
  
Drive continuous improvement initiatives that leverage advanced spatial analytics to reduce operational costs enhance sustainability efforts and generate measurable benefits for society and clients.
  
Ensure compliance with organizational security policies and regulatory expectations when handling location data by applying appropriate access controls anonymization practices and audit mechanisms.
  
  

Qualifications
  
Possess extensive experience in Java based application development with strong skills in building modular code and integrating complex geospatial logic into enterprise platforms.
  
Demonstrate deep expertise in Net API development including creation of secure services and interfaces that expose map related functions to diverse consuming applications.
  
Apply solid understanding of Net work model concepts to collaborate effectively within hybrid teams and deliver reliable solutions in a structured corporate environment.
  
Bring proven background in geospatial analysis tools and spatial databases supporting tasks such as layering buffering and spatial joins for business use cases.
  
Utilize strong knowledge of software engineering practices including version control unit testing and continuous integration to maintain high technical quality standards.
  
Show proficiency in consuming and producing map based services using industry standard protocols and formats to ensure smooth interoperability between systems.
  
Exhibit clear communication skills to explain complex spatial findings to nontechnical stakeholders and to document solution approaches in an accessible manner.
  
Apply analytical and problem solving capabilities to diagnose issues in data pipelines mapping services and client applications and to implement effective corrective actions.
  
Maintain awareness of emerging trends in geospatial technologies and spatial analytics to suggest enhancements that keep company offerings competitive and socially relevant.

title: Staff Software Engineer - BackEnd (Level 4) | Gurugram, IND
description:
**About Agoda**



At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

  




Today, we are part of Booking Holdings \[NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

  



No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you're ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

  


**About our Team**  

At Agoda, our Backend Engineering team builds **high\-scale, fault\-tolerant distributed systems** that power a global travel platform serving **millions of users daily**. We own mission\-critical domains across **inventory, pricing, booking, payments, and customer/partner platforms**.



Our systems run with **high availability, low latency, and zero\-downtime expectations**, powered by modern technologies such as **Scala, Go, Java, Kotlin, Kafka, and Aerospike**, along with strong foundations in **CI/CD, automation, and observability**.



We ship fast—often **dozens of releases a day**—and design systems that are **resilient, self\-healing, and built to scale globally**.

  

**The Opportunity**  

As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll own the design and reliability of a critical service or domain end\-to\-end — from architecture through production. Beyond writing code, you'll be expected to identify problems before they're assigned to you, make independent calls on ambiguous technical trade\-offs within your domain, and raise the technical bar for your immediate team. You'll combine hands\-on coding, system design, and technical ownership — accountable for outcomes within your service, and a trusted technical voice when your work touches adjacent teams.

  

**What You will Do**

  


* Design, build, and own scalable distributed systems and microservices within your domain
* Lead development of complex features and technical initiatives end\-to\-end, within your service or team
* Drive system design, API design, and engineering best practices for your team
* Own scalability, performance, reliability, and fault tolerance of the services you're responsible for
* Optimize high\-throughput, low\-latency systems
* Proactively identify gaps, risks, or improvement opportunities in your domain, and drive them to resolution without waiting to be asked
* Make independent architectural and technical trade\-off decisions within your service's scope, and be accountable for the outcomes
* Collaborate with adjacent teams when your service's boundaries or dependencies require it, and raise engineering standards within your own team
* Partner with your product and business stakeholders to translate business needs into technical priorities, and technical constraints into business context
* Stay hands\-on with coding and system design
* Mentor engineers on your team with a structured approach, supporting their growth
* Handle production issues within your domain, drive RCA, and lead follow\-through improvements

  

**What We're Looking For**


*Technical*

  


* 8–12 years of backend engineering experience
* Strong experience building and owning distributed systems at scale, within a service or domain
* Expertise in: Java, Kotlin, Scala, or Go
* Strong understanding of microservices architecture, REST APIs \& system design, SQL/NoSQL databases, and performance, scalability, and concurrency
* Strong coding and problem\-solving ability


*Beyond the technical bar:*

  


* A track record of taking ownership beyond your assigned tasks — initiatives you drove within your domain because you saw the need, not because you were told
* Comfort making decisions under ambiguity and owning the consequences, technical and business, within your area of ownership
* Experience communicating trade\-offs to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders, adjusting your framing accordingly
* Demonstrated impact mentoring or growing engineers on your team, with concrete outcomes, not just informal help

  



Nice to Have

  


* Experience building large\-scale consumer or marketplace platforms
* Exposure to event\-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
* Experience with NoSQL databases (Cassandra, MongoDB, Aerospike)
* Familiarity with cloud (AWS/GCP), CI/CD pipelines
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments

* Experience with Pytest, Unittest, or similar testing frameworks.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automation tools.
* Compliance and Governance:\*\* Exposure to GDPR, FERPA, or COPPA requirements, data residency constraints, consent management, and audit logging.
* Cost and Efficiency: Experience owning cloud spend, right\-sizing infrastructure, and tuning autoscaling for efficiency at scale.

* Data\-first culture with a strong focus on experimentation and learning
* Collaborative, transparent, and growth\-focused team environment

title: Lead Java Engineer
description:
**Work Schedule**


Standard (Mon\-Fri)**Environmental Conditions**


Office**Job Description**


As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.  

  

DESCRIPTION:  

Join Thermo Fisher Scientific, the world leader in serving science, as a Staff Engineer, Software to make a meaningful impact. In this role, you will provide technical leadership and architectural guidance while developing innovative software solutions that enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Working in a supportive, multi\-functional environment, you will design and implement sophisticated solutions across our product portfolio, from cloud platforms to scientific instrumentation. You will support the growth of other engineers, drive adoption of best practices, and help shape the technical direction of critical projects. This position offers the opportunity to work with advanced technologies while contributing to groundbreaking scientific discoveries.

**Role Overview**


We are looking for a highly experienced **Lead Java Engineer** with 12–15 years of software development experience and strong expertise in designing and developing scalable, secure, and high\-performance backend systems.


The ideal candidate should have deep hands\-on experience with **Java, Spring Boot, REST API development, database design, and backend integration**. The candidate will be responsible for designing robust backend solutions, developing enterprise\-grade services, integrating with internal and external systems, and providing technical leadership to engineering teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend applications and services using **Java and Spring Boot**.
* Define and drive backend design principles, coding standards, and engineering best practices.
* Design and develop secure, reliable, and well\-structured **RESTful APIs**.
* Define API contracts, request/response models, error\-handling mechanisms, and versioning strategies.
* Design efficient and scalable **relational and/or NoSQL database models**.
* Develop and optimize database queries, indexing strategies, and data\-access layers.
* Integrate backend applications with databases, third\-party services, enterprise platforms, and external systems.
* Design and implement backend integration patterns for reliable data exchange across systems.
* Develop reusable backend components, libraries, and common services.
* Ensure backend systems meet requirements for **performance, scalability, availability, security, and maintainability**.
* Identify and resolve complex application, API, database, and integration\-related issues.

description:
Huron is a global consultancy that collaborates with clients to drive strategic growth, ignite innovation and navigate constant change. Through a combination of strategy, expertise and creativity, we help clients accelerate operational, digital and cultural transformation, enabling the change they need to own their future.  

  

Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future.


This is a foundational, build\-team senior development role with a mandate to anchor technical delivery leadership for our Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance \& Supply Chain practice in India. This is not a role designed to inherit a development team — it is being created to help establish one. From the X\+\+ style standards and code review discipline to the integration patterns, the Copilot Studio plugin library, and the AI build playbook, this role will help define the practice's technical craft from the ground up. You will own the build standard.  

Success in this role will require advanced X\+\+ fluency, real integration architecture credibility, and hands\-on experience shipping AI\-augmented components — Copilot Studio plugins, Azure OpenAI integrations, or comparable. The senior consultant in this position must be equally comfortable leading a code review for a Technical Consultant and architecting a Copilot Studio plugin from scratch — bringing both engineering craft and AI build credibility to every workstream they lead. The role calls for a developer who takes pride in code other people enjoy inheriting and treats AI engineering as a first\-class discipline alongside core development skill.  

The ideal candidate brings a minimum of 7 years in enterprise development with at least 4 on Microsoft Dynamics AX or D365 F\&O X\+\+, two or more years operating at Technical Consultant level, and at least three full lifecycle implementations including one as development lead. An active GitHub portfolio and at least one shipped engagement involving Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI, or comparable AI integration is weighted heavily during selection. This individual is on a deliberate development track toward Technical Architect, with practice sponsorship for certifications, AI build time, and growing external visibility. Ultimately, this role calls for a senior consultant who is equal parts X\+\+ craftsman, integration architect, AI builder, and code\-review coach, with the appetite to grow into the architect chair through evidenced ship\-it discipline.**Requirements:*** Lead the development workstream on D365 F\&SCM engagements — owning X\+\+ extensions, custom services, data entities, and complex integrations end\-to\-end.
* Design and build Copilot Studio plugins, Azure OpenAI components, and AI\-powered F\&O extensions that move client outcomes — not science\-project work.
* Own integration design and build across Dual\-write, virtual entities, OData, custom services, Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, Azure Functions, and Logic Apps.
* Run code reviews as a teaching tool — including AI\-generated code review discipline that catches the silent technical debt GitHub Copilot can introduce.
* Partner with the Functional team to translate functional design into technical design — and push back where the functional design has missed a technical implication.
* Drive Azure DevOps hygiene — branching strategy, automated builds, release pipelines, LCS asset management, and test automation.
* Mentor Technical Consultants through paired build, code reviews, and a structured development plan toward Sr. Technical Consultant.
* Build and contribute to the practice's technical IP library — accelerators, extension templates, integration patterns, and AI build references.
* Lead technical due diligence on pursuit\-stage discovery — integration discovery, infrastructure sizing, and AI build effort estimation.
* Own performance, security, and code\-quality remediation across the build phase — not as a final\-week scramble.
* Lead cutover technical activities — data migration runs, integration cutover, and post\-cutover stabilization.
* Represent the practice externally — Microsoft community contributions, internal brown\-bags, and (for top performers) external speaking opportunities
**Preference:**

* 9\+ years experience in enterprise development with 4\+ years in D365 F\&O (X\+\+).
* Minimum 2 years as Technical Consultant on D365 F\&O.
* Delivered 3\+ full lifecycle implementations, including one as Lead Developer/workstream owner.
* Exposure to AI integrations (Copilot Studio/Azure OpenAI) strongly preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Engineering or related field; GitHub portfolio is a plus.
* Mandatory certifications: MB\-500, MB\-300; AZ\-204 (preferred/in progress); AI\-102 within 6 months.
* Strong expertise in X\+\+ development (extensions, CoC, performance tuning).
* Experience in integration architecture (OData, APIs, Service Bus, Azure Functions, Logic Apps).
* Proficiency in Azure services (App Service, Functions, Key Vault, Entra ID).
* Hands\-on with DevOps (Azure DevOps, CI/CD, LCS, automated builds/testing).
* Strong knowledge of data integration \& entity design for large\-scale systems.
* Experience with Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, connectors).
* Exposure to Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, and data lakehouse patterns.
* Strong focus on security, compliance, and testing discipline.
* Capability to build and manage AI solutions (Copilot plugins, Azure OpenAI, RAG, AI Builder).
* Contribution to AI/engineering IP, reusable components, and code reviews with AI governance.
* Strong soft skills: code quality mindset, coaching ability, collaboration across geographies, and architectural understanding.
