title: Software Development Engineer II, TFS
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


If you are looking for high impact, high growth opportunity with interesting engineering challenges in a fast\-paced environment, this is the role for you. We have a number of untapped high impact engineering and business opportunities with high criticality for Amazon. And have the opportunity to work on the leading technologies like AI/ML, Gen\-AI, RAG and various AWS systems.
  

  

What will you own?  

You will work across a suite of products that drive complex business and engineering logic for managing financial accounting for \~$100B annual spend. These solutions leverage various AWS technologies and AI capabilities to solve large\-scale complex problems. The systems demand non\-trivial engineering, requiring deep business understanding and strong technical acumen. You will collaborate with stakeholders and product managers to identify opportunities for improving accuracy, expanding the solution across multiple geographies, and defining the technical roadmap while influencing solutions and tech decisions across teams.
  

  

Who we are?  

We, Transportation Financial Systems (TFS) are responsible for building technologies that support financial aspects for Amazon transportation. Amazon’s transportation systems get millions of packages to customers worldwide faster and cheaper while providing world\-class customer experience – from checkout to shipment tracking to delivery. Our software systems include services that handle tens of thousands or requests per second and make decisions to pay billions of dollars a year and ensure that transportation's liabilities and revenues are correctly accounted for. With rapid expansion into new geographies, innovations in supply chain, delivery models and customer experience, increasingly complex transportation network, ever\-expanding selection of products and growing number of shipments worldwide, we have an opportunity to build software that scales not only with volume but also with the business models. We leverage advanced technologies including big data, Gen\-AI, machine learning, real time analytics and high volume, low latency, high availability services.  

  

TFS is 100\+ tech team across eight different platforms. We deal with problems of scale. Billions of dollars of spend is automated through our platforms and pipelines. We are a growing org and we are looking to ramp up our team across all engineering roles. This position offers the opportunity to collaborate with our global product teams and customers across the world and other tech teams in the organization as we raise the bar in delivering innovation.  

Our engineering team is completely based out of India, and we build global solutions.  

  

We have a large product and tech roadmap and are significantly ramping our tech team to meet the next level of product requirements for Trans Finance.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* The Engineer in this job is expected to make the design (High level and Low level) decisions, own end to end (depth) for specific set of features while having breadth on rest of the features and provide technical guidance for the Junior members in the team.
* Design and implement scalable solutions using Scala or Java, and AWS services
* Mentor team members and collaborate across functions to deliver integrated solutions
* Drive continuous improvement through code quality, testing, and technical debt reduction
* Provide hands\-on development for complex features while maintaining engineering excellence.

  

A day in the life  

Please reach out to avinayam@ for any further details.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Director-Software Engineering-Unify Energy
description:
We are seeking an experienced and strategic Director of Software Engineering to lead engineering for the Unify Energy platform. This role will provide technical, organizational, and delivery leadership for software and data capabilities serving the oil and gas industry. The Director will align engineering execution with customer and business priorities while advancing a secure, scalable platform that helps energy organizations manage high\-value information, streamline operational workflows, and improve access to trusted data across the asset lifecycle.
   

  

 The Director will partner closely with Product Management, business leadership, Architecture, Information Security, DevOps, Data Engineering, Quality Engineering, Implementation, Customer Success, and other software teams. This leader will translate industry needs into an executable engineering strategy, coordinate cross\-team dependencies, and ensure that product investments produce measurable customer, operational, and financial outcomes.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a hands\-on strategic leader with deep experience delivering complex SaaS and cloud\-native platforms, leading distributed engineering teams, and building data\-intensive solutions for regulated or asset\-intensive industries. Oil and gas domain experience is strongly preferred, including familiarity with upstream, midstream, or downstream workflows; land, lease, well, facility, and asset records; regulatory information; document and data onboarding; and integration with industry and enterprise systems.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Lead, mentor, and develop high\-performing engineering teams responsible for the Unify Energy platform and related software, data, integration, and automation capabilities.
* Own the engineering strategy, technical roadmap, execution plan, and delivery outcomes for Unify Energy in alignment with product strategy, customer commitments, revenue goals, and long\-term platform direction.
* Build strong working partnerships with oil and gas business leaders, customers, Product Management, Implementation, and Customer Success to understand industry workflows, prioritize the highest\-value problems, and convert business outcomes into clear engineering plans.
* Provide technical leadership across SaaS software engineering, cloud\-native architecture, APIs and integrations, data pipelines, search and document services, analytics, workflow automation, and applied AI.
* Oversee the full software development lifecycle, from discovery and architecture through development, testing, deployment, monitoring, support, and continuous improvement.
* Drive delivery of scalable, secure, and maintainable capabilities that support energy information ingestion, normalization, indexing, classification, validation, search, retrieval, workflow, and reporting.
* Advance platform capabilities that enable Access to serve as a trusted steward of customers’ physical and digital information assets by supporting metadata management, intuitive search, filtering, navigation, and map\-based discovery within the SaaS platform. Lead the data engineering capabilities required to ingest, organize, and enrich customer data so it becomes more accessible, useful, and valuable across oil and gas workflows.
* Guide integration strategy for industry and enterprise systems, including data exchanges, APIs, batch interfaces, identity services, content repositories, GIS or spatial data, analytics platforms, and customer\-specific systems of record.
* Lead data engineering and data quality practices for high\-volume structured and unstructured information, including ETL/ELT, metadata management, lineage, reconciliation, observability, and reliable downstream consumption.
* Guide responsible use of AI and machine learning to improve document understanding, metadata extraction, classification, entity matching, search relevance, workflow recommendations, quality assurance, and operational efficiency.
* Ensure solutions are designed with appropriate attention to cybersecurity, privacy, records retention, legal hold, auditability, data residency, regulatory obligations, customer controls, and business continuity.
* Establish outcome\-based planning and measurement. Define engineering and business KPIs for major initiatives, including delivery predictability, quality, reliability, adoption, customer value, operational efficiency, and revenue or retention impact.
* Partner with Architecture, Information Security, DevOps, Quality Engineering, Data Engineering, and Operations to establish technical standards, reusable patterns, release controls, service\-level objectives, and operational readiness.
* Monitor portfolio health, delivery metrics, product quality, reliability, risks, dependencies, capacity, and technical debt; make clear tradeoffs and proactively resolve or escalate issues that threaten business outcomes.
* Continuously improve platform architecture, technical health, and integration patterns while protecting customer continuity and sequencing change based on value, risk, and delivery readiness.
* Support talent planning through hiring, coaching, performance management, succession planning, role clarity, and the creation of an accountable, inclusive, and customer\-focused engineering culture.
* Represent Unify Energy engineering in executive, product, customer, and governance forums, providing clear updates on strategy, delivery performance, investment needs, risks, opportunities, and decisions required.
* Stay current with emerging trends in energy technology, information management, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, data platforms, AI\-enabled automation, SaaS architecture, and software delivery practices.


**First 6\-12 Months**
 The initial focus will be to establish a clear engineering and product delivery baseline for Unify Energy, strengthen alignment between customer needs and the technical roadmap, and improve execution predictability. The Director will assess the platform architecture, team capabilities, operating model, delivery commitments, reliability, security posture, technical debt, and customer integration landscape. They will work closely with Product, Operations, and customer\-facing teams to confirm the highest\-priority business and product outcomes and translate them into a focused, sequenced delivery plan.
   

  

 Success will be demonstrated through clearer accountability, stronger engineering and product operating rhythms, improved delivery and quality metrics, reduced execution risk, deeper customer partnership, and measurable progress on the highest\-value Unify Energy capabilities.

title: Test Lead
description:
Job Summary
  
This hybrid Test Lead role for a global payer focused organization involves owning end to end testing strategy and execution for complex web services and API solutions using Agile methodologies. The Test Lead will coordinate test planning design execution and defect management across SQL based backends and payer domain workflows ensuring high quality releases that enhance member and provider experiences while supporting business growth.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
Lead comprehensive test planning activities for payer domain applications by defining clear test objectives scope timelines and resource needs to ensure reliable delivery of high quality features in a hybrid work model.
  
Oversee design of detailed test scenarios and test cases for web services testing and API testing by translating business and technical requirements into robust validation steps that cover functional integration and end to end workflows.
  
Provide direction on using Postman SoapUI and Rest API tools to create execute and maintain automated and manual test suites that validate request response structures status codes and data integrity across environments.
  
Drive execution of API and web services tests with strong SQL based data validation by querying relational databases to confirm data consistency transaction accuracy and proper handling of payer specific rules.
  
Coordinate defect identification triage and retesting by working closely with developers business analysts and product owners to prioritize issues that have the highest impact on member and provider journeys.
  
Guide Agile testing ceremonies such as backlog refinement sprint planning daily standups and sprint reviews by providing risk based testing insights and aligning test efforts with sprint goals and release milestones.
  
Ensure test assets including test cases test data and API collections are structured reusable and well documented to support ongoing regression testing and smooth onboarding of new team members.
  
Collaborate with architecture and development teams to review service contracts payload structures and error handling approaches so that test coverage anticipates edge cases and performance constraints in payer systems.
  
Monitor test progress and quality metrics by preparing concise reports on test execution status defect trends and readiness indicators that support informed release decisions by stakeholders.
  
Implement and refine test processes that improve efficiency and reliability by introducing practical best practices in Agile testing environment usage and data management tailored to payer program needs.
  
Support production readiness and post release validation activities by planning smoke tests health checks and targeted API validations that reduce risk of defects impacting claims processing and customer service.
  
Mentor team members on best practices for API testing SQL validation and web services tools usage by providing constructive feedback and sharing practical examples from payer domain scenarios.
  
Coordinate with cross functional teams in English for both written and spoken communication by ensuring clear documentation issue descriptions and test evidence that facilitate quick understanding and resolution.
  
  

Qualifications
  
Display strong experience in Agile methodologies by applying iterative delivery continuous feedback and collaborative planning techniques throughout the testing lifecycle.
  
Exhibit deep hands on expertise in web services testing and API testing using Postman SoapUI and Rest API tools to validate complex service integrations.
  
Demonstrate advanced SQL skills through the ability to design and execute queries that verify transactional accuracy data transformations and audit trails in payer systems.
  
Bring proven payer domain knowledge by understanding claims flows eligibility checks benefits determination and regulatory constraints relevant to health plan operations.
  
Show capability to work effectively in a hybrid model and day shift by managing time collaboration and coordination across onsite and remote activities without requiring travel.
  
Communicate clearly in English for read write and speak capabilities by producing well structured test documentation and engaging constructively with global stakeholders.
  
  

Certifications Required
  
Preferred certifications include ISTQB Advanced Test Analyst or Certified Agile Tester and any recognized API testing or SQL professional credential.

 As a rapidly scaling product\-led organisation, we’re shaping the future of hospitality technology.
 



 We build the technology backbone that powers modern hospitality businesses to perform, compete, and thrive at scale.
 



  





**JOB DESCRIPTION:**




 At Oolio,
 **Senior Backend Engineers – Golang** 
 are hands\-on engineers who design, build, and operate scalable, reliable, and high\-performance backend systems. You will take ownership across the backend engineering lifecycle — from technical design and development through testing, deployment, observability, and production support.
 



  





 The role requires strong expertise in Golang, microservices, distributed systems, APIs, event\-driven architectures, cloud\-native technologies, and system performance. As AI continues to transform software engineering, you will also be encouraged to leverage AI\-powered development tools, automation, and emerging AI capabilities to improve engineering productivity, accelerate delivery, enhance code quality, and solve real\-world engineering problems.
 



  





 The primary focus of this role is
 **hands\-on backend engineering** 
 , with opportunities to contribute to technical design, architecture decisions, and engineering best practices. You will work closely with Product, Design, Platform, and Engineering teams to build customer\-facing products and backend capabilities that support Oolio's growing global platform.
 



  





**RESPONSIBILITIES:**



* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain reliable and scalable backend services using Golang.
* Contribute to the design and implementation of scalable microservices with strong emphasis on performance, concurrency, maintainability, and reliability.
* Contribute to technical design and architecture discussions, including HLD/LLD, service boundaries, data flows, and integration patterns.
* Design and implement event\-driven systems using asynchronous messaging, queues, pub/sub, and streaming patterns where appropriate.
* Build and maintain RESTful and/or gRPC APIs that power web, mobile, and third\-party integrations.
* Work collaboratively across the stack when required, including integration with React and Node.js services to deliver end\-to\-end product features.
* Develop and operate cloud\-native services deployed on AWS, leveraging Kubernetes and Docker for containerized environments.
* Identify and resolve performance, scalability, and reliability bottlenecks as product usage and customer scale increase.
* Implement effective testing strategies including unit, integration, contract, and performance testing.
* Contribute to observability best practices including structured logging, monitoring, metrics, tracing, and alerting.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to improving engineering standards, coding practices, and overall code quality.
* Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement sustainable fixes to prevent recurrence.
* Collaborate with other engineers to deliver high\-quality solutions within agreed timelines.
* Mentor and support junior and mid\-level engineers through code reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge sharing.
* Leverage AI\-powered development tools and automation to improve development productivity, code quality, testing, documentation, and software delivery.
* Explore and adopt relevant AI capabilities and engineering tools that can solve practical software development and operational challenges.



  





**REQUIREMENTS:**




**Role:** 
 Senior Backend Engineer (Product Engineering) – final role will depend on candidate experience, credentials, and interview outcomes
 



**Experience:** 
 5 – 9 Years
 



**Education:** 
 Preferred – B.Tech/B.E/M.Tech/M.E/MCA/M.S
 



**Technology Stack:** 




**(A) Core Engineering:** 




 Golang, Microservices, Distributed Systems, Event\-Driven Architecture, REST APIs, gRPC, System Design (HLD/LLD), Performance Optimization, Testing Frameworks, AI\-Powered Development Tooling
 



**(B) Good/Nice to Have:** 




 ReactJS, NodeJS, GraphQL
 



  





**OTHER REQUIREMENTS:**

* Strong expertise in Golang, including concurrency patterns, goroutines, channels, memory management, profiling, and performance optimization.
* Proven experience developing and operating scalable microservices and distributed systems.
* Strong understanding of API design, asynchronous processing, event\-driven architectures, and system reliability principles.

description:
**About Agoda**



At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

  




Today, we are part of Booking Holdings \[NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

  



No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you're ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

  


**About our Team**  

At Agoda, our Backend Engineering team builds **high\-scale, fault\-tolerant distributed systems** that power a global travel platform serving **millions of users daily**. We own mission\-critical domains across **inventory, pricing, booking, payments, and customer/partner platforms**.



Our systems run with **high availability, low latency, and zero\-downtime expectations**, powered by modern technologies such as **Scala, Go, Java, Kotlin, Kafka, and Aerospike**, along with strong foundations in **CI/CD, automation, and observability**.



We ship fast—often **dozens of releases a day**—and design systems that are **resilient, self\-healing, and built to scale globally**.

  

**The Opportunity**  

As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll own the design and reliability of a critical service or domain end\-to\-end — from architecture through production. Beyond writing code, you'll be expected to identify problems before they're assigned to you, make independent calls on ambiguous technical trade\-offs within your domain, and raise the technical bar for your immediate team. You'll combine hands\-on coding, system design, and technical ownership — accountable for outcomes within your service, and a trusted technical voice when your work touches adjacent teams.

  

**What You will Do**

  


* Design, build, and own scalable distributed systems and microservices within your domain
* Lead development of complex features and technical initiatives end\-to\-end, within your service or team
* Drive system design, API design, and engineering best practices for your team
* Own scalability, performance, reliability, and fault tolerance of the services you're responsible for
* Optimize high\-throughput, low\-latency systems
* Proactively identify gaps, risks, or improvement opportunities in your domain, and drive them to resolution without waiting to be asked
* Make independent architectural and technical trade\-off decisions within your service's scope, and be accountable for the outcomes
* Collaborate with adjacent teams when your service's boundaries or dependencies require it, and raise engineering standards within your own team
* Partner with your product and business stakeholders to translate business needs into technical priorities, and technical constraints into business context
* Stay hands\-on with coding and system design
* Mentor engineers on your team with a structured approach, supporting their growth
* Handle production issues within your domain, drive RCA, and lead follow\-through improvements

  

**What We're Looking For**


*Technical*

  


* 8–12 years of backend engineering experience
* Strong experience building and owning distributed systems at scale, within a service or domain
* Expertise in: Java, Kotlin, Scala, or Go
* Strong understanding of microservices architecture, REST APIs \& system design, SQL/NoSQL databases, and performance, scalability, and concurrency
* Strong coding and problem\-solving ability


*Beyond the technical bar:*

  


* A track record of taking ownership beyond your assigned tasks — initiatives you drove within your domain because you saw the need, not because you were told
* Comfort making decisions under ambiguity and owning the consequences, technical and business, within your area of ownership
* Experience communicating trade\-offs to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders, adjusting your framing accordingly
* Demonstrated impact mentoring or growing engineers on your team, with concrete outcomes, not just informal help

  



Nice to Have

  


* Experience building large\-scale consumer or marketplace platforms
* Exposure to event\-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
* Experience with NoSQL databases (Cassandra, MongoDB, Aerospike)
* Familiarity with cloud (AWS/GCP), CI/CD pipelines
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments

  


###### **\#Delhi \#Gurgaon \#Gurugram \#Bangalore \#Bengaluru \#Chennai \#Noida \#DelhiNCR \#Pune \#Mumbai \#Hyderabad \#Chandigarh \#Kolkata**

description:
**About Agoda**



At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

  




Today, we are part of Booking Holdings \[NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

  



No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you're ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

  


**About our Team**  

At Agoda, our Backend Engineering team builds **high\-scale, fault\-tolerant distributed systems** that power a global travel platform serving **millions of users daily**. We own mission\-critical domains across **inventory, pricing, booking, payments, and customer/partner platforms**.



Our systems run with **high availability, low latency, and zero\-downtime expectations**, powered by modern technologies such as **Scala, Go, Java, Kotlin, Kafka, and Aerospike**, along with strong foundations in **CI/CD, automation, and observability**.



We ship fast—often **dozens of releases a day**—and design systems that are **resilient, self\-healing, and built to scale globally**.

  

**The Opportunity**  

As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll own the design and reliability of a critical service or domain end\-to\-end — from architecture through production. Beyond writing code, you'll be expected to identify problems before they're assigned to you, make independent calls on ambiguous technical trade\-offs within your domain, and raise the technical bar for your immediate team. You'll combine hands\-on coding, system design, and technical ownership — accountable for outcomes within your service, and a trusted technical voice when your work touches adjacent teams.

  

**What You will Do**

  


* Design, build, and own scalable distributed systems and microservices within your domain
* Lead development of complex features and technical initiatives end\-to\-end, within your service or team
* Drive system design, API design, and engineering best practices for your team
* Own scalability, performance, reliability, and fault tolerance of the services you're responsible for
* Optimize high\-throughput, low\-latency systems
* Proactively identify gaps, risks, or improvement opportunities in your domain, and drive them to resolution without waiting to be asked
* Make independent architectural and technical trade\-off decisions within your service's scope, and be accountable for the outcomes
* Collaborate with adjacent teams when your service's boundaries or dependencies require it, and raise engineering standards within your own team
* Partner with your product and business stakeholders to translate business needs into technical priorities, and technical constraints into business context
* Stay hands\-on with coding and system design
* Mentor engineers on your team with a structured approach, supporting their growth
* Handle production issues within your domain, drive RCA, and lead follow\-through improvements

  

**What We're Looking For**


*Technical*

  


* 8–12 years of backend engineering experience
* Strong experience building and owning distributed systems at scale, within a service or domain
* Expertise in: Java, Kotlin, Scala, or Go
* Strong understanding of microservices architecture, REST APIs \& system design, SQL/NoSQL databases, and performance, scalability, and concurrency
* Strong coding and problem\-solving ability


*Beyond the technical bar:*

  


* A track record of taking ownership beyond your assigned tasks — initiatives you drove within your domain because you saw the need, not because you were told
* Comfort making decisions under ambiguity and owning the consequences, technical and business, within your area of ownership
* Experience communicating trade\-offs to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders, adjusting your framing accordingly
* Demonstrated impact mentoring or growing engineers on your team, with concrete outcomes, not just informal help

  



Nice to Have

  


* Experience building large\-scale consumer or marketplace platforms
* Exposure to event\-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
* Experience with NoSQL databases (Cassandra, MongoDB, Aerospike)
* Familiarity with cloud (AWS/GCP), CI/CD pipelines
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments

  


###### **\#Delhi \#Gurgaon \#Gurugram \#Bangalore \#Bengaluru \#Chennai \#Noida \#DelhiNCR \#Pune \#Mumbai \#Hyderabad \#Chandigarh \#Kolkata**

#### 


#### **Please review our Hiring Process Guidelines before your interview — click** **here****to learn how interviewing at Agoda works.**

  


### **Discover more about working at Agoda**


* Agoda Careers https://careersatagoda.com
* Facebook https://www.facebook.com/agodacareers/
* LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/agoda
* YouTube https://www.youtube.com/agodalife

  


**Equal Opportunity Employer**



At Agoda, we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds and orientations. We prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and innovation. Employment at Agoda is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity regardless of sex, age, race, color, national origin, religion, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, citizenship, veteran or military status, and other legally protected characteristics.



We will keep your application on file so that we can consider you for future vacancies and you can always ask to have your details removed from the file. For more details please read our privacy policy.


**Disclaimer**



We do not accept any terms or conditions, nor do we recognize any agency's representation of a candidate, from unsolicited third\-party or agency submissions. If we receive unsolicited or speculative CVs, we reserve the right to contact and hire the candidate directly without any obligation to pay a recruitment fee.

title: Engineer II - Software Development
description:
For more than 40 years, Accelya has been the industry’s partner for change, simplifying airline financial and commercial processes and empowering the air transport community to take better control of the future. Whether partnering with IATA on industry\-wide initiatives or enabling digital transformation to simplify airline processes, Accelya drives the airline industry forward and proudly puts control back in the hands of airlines so they can move further, faster.
   

  

 Role Purpose
   

  

 As Engineer II \- Software Development at Accelya, you will lead complex software features and services work, designing authoritative technical solutions, mentoring junior engineers and driving engineering quality and best practices across the team.
   

  

 Duties \& Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead complex software features and services design and delivery, producing high\-quality, scalable and maintainable solutions
* Drive adoption of GitHub Copilot, AWS CodeWhisperer, Cursor AI and Claude for AI\-assisted code generation, review and documentation across the team, measuring and communicating engineering velocity improvements
* Lead technical quality activities including architecture reviews and code quality standards
* Mentor and coach junior engineers, building technical capability and engineering culture
* Collaborate with senior architects on platform design decisions and technical roadmaps
* Lead resolution of complex technical incidents, applying expert debugging and problem\-solving
* Use generative AI (Claude, ChatGPT) for technical design documents, engineering RFCs and knowledge base articles


**Required Experience \& Skills**
* 5–7 years of Software Development experience including technical leadership of complex features or systems
* Expert proficiency in Java, Python, Go, TypeScript, REST APIs, microservices and cloud\-native development on AWS
* Proven ability to lead code reviews, mentor engineers and drive engineering best practices
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS) and modern software delivery
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field


**Preferred Experience \& Skills**
* Expert use of GitHub Copilot, AWS CodeWhisperer, Cursor AI and Claude for AI\-assisted code generation, review and documentation to accelerate complex engineering work and drive quality improvement across a team
* Deep knowledge of AWS services and how cloud\-native patterns apply to mission\-critical airline software
* Proficiency with generative AI (Claude, ChatGPT) for engineering RFCs, technical leadership content and knowledge management
* Understanding of the competitive airline technology engineering landscape


 What do we offer?
   

  

* An open culture with a creative and challenging opportunity to satisfy your intellectual needs
* Flexible working hours
* Smart working: a hybrid remote/office working environment
* Work\-life balance
* An excellent, dynamic and multicultural environment to work in


**About Accelya**
 Accelya is a leading global software provider to the airline industry, powering over 200 airlines with an open, modular software platform. Owned by Vista Equity Partners, we bring together 2,000\+ employees across 10 global offices. We are proud partners of AWS and pioneers in NDC expertise. Find out more at www.accelya.com
   

  

 What does the future of the air transport industry look like to you? Whether you’re an industry veteran or someone with experience from other industries, we want to make your ambitions a reality!

title: Associate Software Analyst
description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.
   

  

 Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.
   

  

 PTC is looking for a SME who has practical hands\-on experience in Java for secured software integration, delivery and deployment, and is responsible for shifting Security to the left in entire software supply chain right from building to the deployment aiding reliability to the agility.
   

  

 The candidate will be working as a part of a team involved in design, implementation, performant, secured, agile, and reliable delivery and deployment of PTC’s flagship PLM suite, Windchill \& Visualization Content Service (VCS), on a SaaS platform. This position is based out of PTC’s Pune R\&D facility.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities Include**
* Develop and deploy highly secure in multiple environments.
* Work towards achieving 100% automation.
* Participate in Code Analysis/Review, bug fixing.
* Implement industry best practices for system hardening and configuration management
* Sustain and improve the process of knowledge sharing throughout the cross\-functional team including multiple groups (viz. IT, Engineering) working on several different technologies
* Communicate effectively about the work done, rationale behind it and the impact on other parts of the product and trade\-offs that have been made
* Help shape the DevOps vision and road map


**Must Have Skills \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information technology or equivalent software development experience.
* 1 to 3\+ years of experience in server\-side programming in Java, python, go
* Experience in working on PLM software like Windchill would be an added advantage.
* Proven working experience in languages like Java.
* Proven working experience in languages like Python.
* Proven working experience in languages like Go.
* Proven working experience in Oracle DB, Microsoft SQL
* Passionate about simple and clean code, unit testing and following standard coding practices.
* Excellent communication skills, interpersonal skills, problem\-solving skills and innovation capabilities.


**Positional Attributes**
* Out of the box thinker with a passion for doing things right the first time
* Should have non\-negotiable urge towards 100% automation, and “zero\-trust” policy towards security
* Strong urge towards investigation of problems, and ability to conduct independent research
* A self\-starter, data\-driven with excellent analytical \& problem\-solving ability to conceptualize and drive end\-to\-end development solutions that provide customer value
* Motivation to learn new concepts and proactively develop domain knowledge
* Strong decision\-making skills: take\-charge personality with ability to drive a plan to completion
* Smart individual who is readily approachable and be able to work effectively with multi\-site cross\-functional teams, having excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.


 Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting\-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you.
   

  

 If you share our passion for problem\-solving through innovation, you’ll likely become just as passionate about the PTC experience as we are. Are you ready to explore your next career move with us?

title: AI Product Engineer
description:
****Role Overview****
 We are transitioning our organization to an AI\-first operational model. We are seeking an
 **AI Product Engineer** 
 to architect and build the company’s central intelligence engine.
   

  

 In this role, you will be the primary builder of
 **automated intelligence systems** 
 —tools that not only retrieve insights but actively trigger workflows, and synthesize strategic intel across our entire business landscape.
   

  

****Role Profile****
 This is a high\-impact, hands\-on engineering role requiring a convergence of three distinct skill sets:
   

  

* Software Engineering (50%): Building scalable middleware, API integrations, and production\-grade applications that connect our data stack to business tools (CRM, Marketing Automation, Support/Ticketing).


* AI Engineering (30%): Implementing Agentic workflows, RAG architectures, and LLMs to process unstructured data at scale.
* Data Analytics (20%): Leveraging SQL and B2B SaaS metrics to ensure all automation is grounded in accurate, governed data.


****Key Responsibilities****
**Qualifications**
* Building the "Enterprise Brain" (Architecture \& Integration)
* Develop a unified intelligence layer that ingests signals from disparate sources (Product Telemetry, CRM, Call Transcripts, Marketing inputs) and processes them into actionable outputs.
* Build robust integrations/webhooks to push AI\-generated insights directly into workflow tools (e.g., pushing "Churn Risk" alerts into Salesforce
* AI Logic \& Agent Implementation
* Architect "Agentic" workflows where LLMs are granted permission to perform tasks
* Implement advanced RAG to ground AI outputs in company documentation, historical data, and strategic context.
* Ensure rigorous evaluation and guardrails for non\-deterministic models to prevent "hallucinations" in critical business workflows.
* Data Engineering \& Governance
* Collaborate with Analytics Engineers to ensure the underlying data pipelines support real\-time or near\-real\-time AI applications.
* Maintain security and privacy standards, ensuring that AI agents respect data access permissions across different departments.


**Minimum Qualifications:**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Software Engineering: 3\+ years of experience in Python development, with strong proficiency in API development (FastAPI/Django) and building integrations between SaaS platforms.
* AI/ML Application: Proven experience building applications using LLM APIs and orchestration frameworks, Experience with "Agent" concepts.
* Data Proficiency: Strong SQL skills and familiarity with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake/BigQuery).


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Business Systems Knowledge: Experience working with APIs for major B2B tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, Jira, Marketo).
* Workflow Automation: Experience with tools like Airflow, Zapier/Make (advanced usage), or custom workflow engines.
* B2B Domain Expertise: Understanding of the interplay between Sales, Product, and Customer Success.


****Competencies****
* The "Builder" Mindset: You are comfortable taking a high\-level strategic requirement from leadership (e.g., "We need to automate lead qualification") and independently architecting and coding the solution.
* Systemic Thinking: You understand how a change in product data schema impacts the downstream marketing automation flow.
* Adaptability: You can switch contexts rapidly—from debugging a SQL query for Strategy to refining a prompt for Customer Support automation.


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Staff Engineer - Data Path
description:
DDN is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join the Data Ocean engineering team and develop high\-performance data path software for next\-generation AI and enterprise storage platforms.
   

  

 This role focuses on designing, implementing, and optimizing core data path services that enable intelligent caching, object storage integration, metadata management, and efficient data movement across modern storage environments.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a strong systems engineer with deep C/C\+\+ development expertise, experience building high\-performance Linux\-based software, and a passion for solving complex storage and distributed systems challenges.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on engineering role requiring ownership of design, implementation, debugging, performance optimization, and delivery of production\-quality software.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Data Path Software Development
   

  

* Design and implement high\-performance data path components for the Data Ocean platform.
* Develop intelligent caching capabilities for object storage workloads.
* Build scalable services for data movement across object, file, and block storage environments.
* Implement metadata management services supporting efficient object tracking, lookup, and on\-demand retrieval.
* Develop cache management capabilities including quota management, eviction policies, and lifecycle controls.
* Optimize data transfer pipelines for throughput, latency, scalability, and reliability.
* Analyze, debug, and optimize system performance across large\-scale storage workloads.
* Develop production\-quality C/C\+\+ software for high\-performance storage systems.
* Design and implement multithreaded, concurrent systems software on Linux platforms.
* Work on storage data path components involving caching, metadata handling, I/O processing, and distributed coordination.
* Improve scalability, reliability, and performance of core storage services through profiling and optimization.
* Troubleshoot complex system issues involving performance, concurrency, and data consistency.
* Participate in architecture discussions, technical design reviews, and code reviews.
* Collaborate with senior engineers, architects, and cross\-functional teams across global engineering locations.
* Work closely with QA, performance engineering, and release teams to deliver reliable production software.
* Contribute to engineering best practices, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 8\+ years of experience developing systems software, storage software, or distributed systems.
* Strong expertise in C/C\+\+ programming with experience developing production\-grade software.
* Strong Linux systems programming experience.
* Experience with multithreaded programming, concurrency, synchronization, and performance tuning.
* Understanding of storage systems, filesystems, or distributed storage architectures.
* Experience working with object storage concepts and APIs, including S3\.
* Ability to debug complex software issues and optimize performance\-critical systems.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience developing distributed storage systems or high\-performance data platforms.
* Knowledge of filesystem internals, metadata management, and namespace services.
* Experience with intelligent caching, data tiering, replication, or data mobility solutions.
* Familiarity with storage protocols and networking technologies.
* Experience integrating cloud storage with enterprise storage platforms.
* Familiarity with AI infrastructure, HPC workloads, or large\-scale data processing environments.


 Why Join DDN?
   

  

 As a Senior Software Engineer – Data Path, Data Ocean, you will work on foundational storage technologies powering next\-generation AI, HPC, and enterprise workloads.
   

  

 You will have the opportunity to design and build high\-performance distributed systems software, solve challenging scalability and performance problems, and contribute to a global engineering team delivering advanced data management solutions for modern AI infrastructure.

title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
description:
**Position Overview**
**Job Title:** 
**Senior Data Platform Engineer**
**Corporate Title: Assistant Vice President**
**Location: Pune, India**
**Role Description**
* This position sits within Deutsche Bank's eDiscovery and Archiving Technology group and will play a leading engineering role in the modernization of a critical enterprise data platform. The platform provides identification, data\-source intelligence, and configuration\-control capabilities supporting defensible eDiscovery decisions across Legal, Compliance, HR, Audit, and Investigations. The successful candidate will strengthen and evolve the existing on\-premise data platform while leading the technical design and hands\-on development of a new generation GCP\-based data platform. This is a deeply hands\-on engineering role, not a pure architecture, coordination, or people\-management position. It requires expert\-level Java engineering, strong data\-platform design capability, practical Python coding knowledge, and the ability to convert complex legacy business logic into modular, testable, observable, and auditable services and data products. The role will set engineering direction, lead designs, influence technical team members through code\-level credibility, and remain directly accountable for coding, code reviews, debugging, troubleshooting, and production delivery.


**What We’ll Offer You**
 As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy,
   

  

* Best in class leave policy.
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
* Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above


**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Operate as a deeply hands\-on lead engineer: personally design, code, unit test, review, profile, debug, deploy, and support production\-grade Oracle PL/SQL packages, Java services, APIs, batch components, data\-processing modules, and integration frameworks. Produce reference implementations for complex or high\-risk capabilities.
* Own key design decisions for modular decomposition of legacy data\-platform capabilities, including custodian identity, employment history and aliases, application and data\-source coverage, archive configurations, retention context, refinement rules, and identification outputs.
* Extract and rationalize business logic embedded in legacy code, database routines, manual backend processes, and operational knowledge; distinguish essential control logic from accidental complexity and prevent a like\-for\-like migration of legacy constraints.
* Design, develop \& maintain the on\-premise data platform through substantial hands\-on Java coding, supported by relational data models, advanced SQL and PL/SQL, controlled interfaces, automated ingestion, reconciliation, and operational tooling. Improve maintainability, test coverage, documentation, release quality, and production supportability through direct implementation.
* Design for coexistence and transition between on\-premise and GCP components, including secure connectivity, data synchronization, reconciliation, dual\-run controls, cutover, rollback, and progressive retirement of legacy components without disrupting eDiscovery obligations.
* Develop scalable ingestion and onboarding patterns for HR, application, archive, account, migration, retention, and other source data; support bulk loads, schema validation, data\-quality controls, source traceability, and controlled schema evolution.
* Establish a trusted data model and source\-of\-truth hierarchy for custodian identity and source coverage, with explicit provenance, effective dating, confidence, exception handling, and full traceability of why an identification or downstream task was produced.
* Design services and configuration capabilities that reduce hard\-coded change, enable controlled onboarding and offboarding of applications and data sources, and expose reusable capabilities to EDI and other approved consumers through secure APIs and events.
* Build end\-to\-end auditability into the platform, capturing data lineage, rule versions, decision context, user and system actions, overrides, approvals, and evidence needed to explain and defend identification outcomes.
* Define engineering standards for Java, Python, SQL, APIs, data modeling, testing, observability, resilience, security, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code; use code reviews and design reviews to drive consistent adoption across the team.
* Lead technical design forums and influence engineers, architects, product partners, and control stakeholders toward robust, simple, and supportable solutions; challenge weak designs constructively and translate target architecture into implementable increments.
* Influence and coach technical team members through pair programming, hands\-on design walkthroughs, reference implementations, and detailed code reviews while holding a high bar for correctness, readability, automated testing, performance, resilience, and operational readiness.
* Implement comprehensive observability across services and pipelines, including data\-quality metrics, usage and health monitoring, structured logging, tracing, alerting, reconciliation, failure recovery, and actionable operational dashboards.
* Lead performance engineering and root\-cause analysis across Java services, databases, data pipelines, and integrations, including JVM behavior, concurrency, memory, SQL execution plans, indexing, throughput, latency, and batch\-window optimization.
* Partner with Architecture, Information Security, Data Governance, Compliance, and operations teams to ensure designs meet requirements for access control, encryption, retention, residency, resilience, disaster recovery, change governance, and production evidence.
* Drive incremental delivery through proofs of concept, walking skeletons, reusable platform components, automated tests, and measurable migration outcomes rather than producing architecture artifacts without executable implementation.


**Your Skills And Experience**
* Strong relational database engineering and advanced SQL skills, including complex queries, analytical functions, execution plan analysis, indexing, data modeling, stored procedures, and performance tuning; strong PL/SQL knowledge is highly desirable.
* Hands\-on Java expertise, including modern Java, object\-oriented and functional design, collections, concurrency, JVM internals, memory and performance tuning, exception handling, dependency management, and production debugging.
* Good practical Python coding knowledge for data processing, automation, validation, orchestration, utilities, and integration, with the ability to review Python design and code quality even though Java is the primary engineering skill.

description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Principal Engineer – Application Architect
   

  

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
   

  

 Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
   

  

**Overview**
 Payments Network Technology is seeking a Principal Engineer to provide technical and delivery leadership across payment\-network initiatives. This role will connect architecture, release coordination, dependency management, and engineering execution across multiple teams.
   

  

 Roles and Responsibilities
   

  

* Define and evolve architecture for secure, scalable, and highly available payment\-network services.
* Coordinate technical delivery across teams, including releases, dependencies, defect triage, and resolution of cross\-cutting issues.
* Partner with product and engineering leaders to translate business needs into architecture and implementation direction.
* Lead design reviews and drive decisions on APIs, service interactions, data, resiliency, security, and operational readiness.
* Identify reuse opportunities and promote common engineering patterns and standards.
* Mentor engineers and technical leads across teams.
* Communicate architecture trade\-offs, delivery risks, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Provide technical or product leadership, mentor team members, and drive decisions across multiple workstreams.


**Essential Skills**
* Extensive software architecture and development experience in large\-scale systems.
* Deep knowledge of Java, Spring Boot, microservices, REST APIs, messaging, event\-driven architecture, SQL/NoSQL, and cloud\-native platforms.
* Experience with secure engineering, DevOps, performance, resiliency, observability, and production\-readiness practices.
* Ability to lead through influence across organizational boundaries.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.


**All About You**
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments and across the software development lifecycle.
* Clear communication, collaboration, problem\-solving, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to work with globally distributed product, engineering, architecture, operations, and business teams.
* Experience leading SOAR (Solution Architecture Review) and driving technical strategy, architecture alignment, engineering excellence, and risk management across multiple teams.
* Experience creating and reviewing TADs (Technical Architecture Documents) for large\-scale distributed systems, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards, security requirements, resiliency objectives, and long\-term maintainability.
* Demonstrated experience defining and governing cross\-platform architecture, enabling interoperability, reuse, standardization, and consistent engineering practices across multiple products and services.
* Experience designing and implementing multi\-region resiliency architectures, including active\-active and active\-passive deployment patterns, disaster recovery strategies, cross\-region data replication, failover mechanisms, and business continuity solutions.
* Strong understanding of distributed data management, including data replication, consistency models, recovery objectives, and operational considerations across geographic regions.
* Champions operability and maintainability as first\-class design principles, ensuring observability, monitoring, automation, self\-healing capabilities, supportability, and simplified operational management are built into solutions from inception.
* Deep understanding of Mastercard Engineering Principles (or equivalent large\-scale enterprise engineering standards) and a proven ability to apply them consistently across architecture, software design, deployment, resiliency, security, and operational practices.
* Demonstrated ability to balance architecture, business priorities, scalability, security, resiliency, and operational considerations while establishing technology direction for multiple engineering teams.
* Experience defining architecture guardrails, engineering standards, reference implementations, and reusable patterns that improve consistency, quality, and delivery effectiveness across the organization.
* Strong knowledge of reliability engineering practices, including service\-level objectives (SLOs), error budgets, observability, fault isolation, disaster recovery testing, and continuous resilience validation.
* Payments or financial\-services domain knowledge is preferred.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Staff Software Engineer - BackEnd (Level 4) | Gurugram, IND
description:
**About Agoda**



At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

  




Today, we are part of Booking Holdings \[NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

  



No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you're ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

  


**About our Team**  

At Agoda, our Backend Engineering team builds **high\-scale, fault\-tolerant distributed systems** that power a global travel platform serving **millions of users daily**. We own mission\-critical domains across **inventory, pricing, booking, payments, and customer/partner platforms**.



Our systems run with **high availability, low latency, and zero\-downtime expectations**, powered by modern technologies such as **Scala, Go, Java, Kotlin, Kafka, and Aerospike**, along with strong foundations in **CI/CD, automation, and observability**.



We ship fast—often **dozens of releases a day**—and design systems that are **resilient, self\-healing, and built to scale globally**.

  

**The Opportunity**  

As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll own the design and reliability of a critical service or domain end\-to\-end — from architecture through production. Beyond writing code, you'll be expected to identify problems before they're assigned to you, make independent calls on ambiguous technical trade\-offs within your domain, and raise the technical bar for your immediate team. You'll combine hands\-on coding, system design, and technical ownership — accountable for outcomes within your service, and a trusted technical voice when your work touches adjacent teams.

  

**What You will Do**

  


* Design, build, and own scalable distributed systems and microservices within your domain
* Lead development of complex features and technical initiatives end\-to\-end, within your service or team
* Drive system design, API design, and engineering best practices for your team
* Own scalability, performance, reliability, and fault tolerance of the services you're responsible for
* Optimize high\-throughput, low\-latency systems
* Proactively identify gaps, risks, or improvement opportunities in your domain, and drive them to resolution without waiting to be asked
* Make independent architectural and technical trade\-off decisions within your service's scope, and be accountable for the outcomes
* Collaborate with adjacent teams when your service's boundaries or dependencies require it, and raise engineering standards within your own team
* Partner with your product and business stakeholders to translate business needs into technical priorities, and technical constraints into business context
* Stay hands\-on with coding and system design
* Mentor engineers on your team with a structured approach, supporting their growth
* Handle production issues within your domain, drive RCA, and lead follow\-through improvements

  

**What We're Looking For**


*Technical*

  


* 8–12 years of backend engineering experience
* Strong experience building and owning distributed systems at scale, within a service or domain
* Expertise in: Java, Kotlin, Scala, or Go
* Strong understanding of microservices architecture, REST APIs \& system design, SQL/NoSQL databases, and performance, scalability, and concurrency
* Strong coding and problem\-solving ability


*Beyond the technical bar:*

  


* A track record of taking ownership beyond your assigned tasks — initiatives you drove within your domain because you saw the need, not because you were told
* Comfort making decisions under ambiguity and owning the consequences, technical and business, within your area of ownership
* Experience communicating trade\-offs to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders, adjusting your framing accordingly
* Demonstrated impact mentoring or growing engineers on your team, with concrete outcomes, not just informal help

  



Nice to Have

  


* Experience building large\-scale consumer or marketplace platforms
* Exposure to event\-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
* Experience with NoSQL databases (Cassandra, MongoDB, Aerospike)
* Familiarity with cloud (AWS/GCP), CI/CD pipelines
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments

  


###### **\#Delhi \#Gurgaon \#Gurugram \#Bangalore \#Bengaluru \#Chennai \#Noida \#DelhiNCR \#Pune \#Mumbai \#Hyderabad \#Chandigarh \#Kolkata**

#### 


#### **Please review our Hiring Process Guidelines before your interview — click** **here****to learn how interviewing at Agoda works.**

**Equal Opportunity Employer**



At Agoda, we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds and orientations. We prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and innovation. Employment at Agoda is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity regardless of sex, age, race, color, national origin, religion, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, citizenship, veteran or military status, and other legally protected characteristics.



We will keep your application on file so that we can consider you for future vacancies and you can always ask to have your details removed from the file. For more details please read our privacy policy.


**Disclaimer**

If we receive unsolicited or speculative CVs, we reserve the right to contact and hire the candidate directly without any obligation to pay a recruitment fee.

 Integration Engineer

 Tech Lead
   

  

**Role Summary**
 We are building the Supply Chain Operating System for India's manufacturers and distributors that run their operations on homegrown ERPs but lack real\-time visibility into inventory health, order flow, or logistics performance. Our system sits on top of existing ERPs and WMSs, creates a unified operational data model, and turns inventory data into better decisions through an intelligent pooling of AI agents and deterministic models.
   

  

 As an Integration Engineer, you will own the bridge between customer systems and our intelligence platform. You will turn ERP/WMS data into a clean, timely, and trusted operational model through reusable connectors, mappings, validations, and implementation discipline.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Build and maintain reusable ERP, accounting, and WMS connectors, starting with priority systems such as Tally/TallyPrime, ERPNext, Zoho Inventory, and WMS platforms.
* Map source masters and transactions (SKUs, warehouses, inventory positions, movements, orders, GRNs, transfers, and batches) into a canonical operational data model.
* Implement API, webhook, polling, and file\-based ingestion with incremental sync, retries, idempotency, conflict handling, rate limits, and secure credential management.
* Create validation and reconciliation routines for item masters, UOMs, inventory positions, batches/lots, and transaction history; work with AI/Data Science on freshness and quality scoring.
* Build connector\-health monitoring for sync status, lag, errors, and failed records; document mappings, edge cases, and support runbooks.
* Support pilot discovery, mapping workshops, test loads, UAT, and cutover; within 90 days, deliver an end\-to\-end staging integration and connector onboarding playbook.


**Requirements \& Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of experience in integration engineering, data engineering, ETL/ELT, implementation engineering, or ERP/WMS connector development.
* Strong SQL and data\-mapping fundamentals, including data lineage, entity resolution, and reconciliation.
* Hands\-on experience with REST/SOAP APIs, webhooks, CSV/Excel feeds, auth mechanisms, and scheduled/incremental synchronization.
* Ability to troubleshoot messy source data and communicate clearly with customer IT and operations teams.
* Comfort with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or another scripting language, plus strong documentation habits.
* Experience with Tally, Busy, Zoho, ERPNext, WMS, GST/e\-invoice, supply\-chain operations, queues/streams, or cloud data services is a plus.


**Why Join Us**
 With decades of operational experience solving supply chain problems across cold chain, beverages, packaged food, and manufacturing for Fortune 500 clients and hundreds of SMEs in India, our industry\-first model gives you the opportunity to:
   

  

* Solve the real\-world integration problems that determine whether operational intelligence works for customers.
* Build reusable connectors and implementation playbooks that make every customer onboarding faster and better.
* Work directly with ERP/WMS data and customer operations, seeing the immediate impact of clean, trustworthy data.
