title: Technical Lead (E-Commerce)
description:
SynapseIndia is a software development company with over 26 years of experience, featuring development offices in India and the USA. We serve clients worldwide, delivering innovative solutions tailored to their needs. Our Noida SEZ office is conveniently located just a 10\-minute walk from the nearest metro station.


**Why work with us?**


* **Partnerships with Industry Leaders:** We are a Google and Microsoft partner, staffed by certified professionals.
* **Global Presence:** As a multinational corporation, we have clients and employees across the globe.
* **Structured Environment:** We follow CMMI Level\-5 compliant processes to ensure quality and efficiency.
* **Timely Salaries:** We have consistently paid salaries on time since our inception.
* **Job Stability:** Despite market fluctuations, we have not had to lay off employees.
* **Work\-Life Balance:** Enjoy weekends off on the 2nd and last Saturday of every month, with no night shifts.
* Our employees are 100% satisfied, thanks to a culture of trust and growth opportunities.
* **Eco\-Friendly Workplace:** We promote health and well\-being with special anti\-radiation and energy removal features in our offices.
* We prioritize the job security of all our employees.
* We celebrate all festivals with enthusiasm and joy.
* **Yearly Appraisals:** Exceptional performers can receive over 100% increments during appraisals.
* We recognize and reward top performers on a monthly basis for their outstanding contributions.
* We provide Accidental and Medical Insurance to our employees.

  




**Who are we looking for?**


**Designation** : Technical Lead (E\-Commerce)  

**Experience Range :** 6\+ years

  


**What is the work?**


* Lead the design, architecture, development, implementation, and optimization of scalable, secure, and high\-performance e\-commerce platforms.
* Architect and optimize front\-end and back\-end components for robust web applications.
* Work with e\-commerce platforms such as Magento / Adobe Commerce, WooCommerce, Drupal / Drupal Commerce, Shopify / Shopify Plus, PrestaShop, OpenCart, Shopware, and Sylius.
* Provide technical leadership to the development team and establish coding standards, development practices, and architectural guidelines.
* Conduct code reviews and ensure code quality, automated testing, CI, and development standards.
* Collaborate with Business Development, Project Managers, UI/UX designers, developers, and clients to understand requirements and develop technical solutions.
* Participate in client discussions and provide technically feasible, scalable, and commercially viable solutions.
* Review existing client platforms and identify opportunities for enhancements, integrations, performance improvements, feature development, security upgrades, and optimization.
* Identify whether requested changes are within the agreed project scope or require additional effort/change requests.
* Provide technical inputs and estimates for additional work where required.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues involving applications, APIs/integrations, performance, databases, deployments, and production incidents.
* Lead root\-cause analysis and implement sustainable technical solutions.
* Manage deployment of features, enhancements, integrations, and bug fixes with minimal disruption.
* Ensure proper Git, CI/CD, testing, deployment, version control, and rollback processes.
* Evaluate new technologies and recommend solutions that improve performance, scalability, security, functionality, and maintainability.
* Stay updated with developments in e\-commerce platforms, open\-source frameworks, APIs, cloud technologies, security, and development tools.
* Mentor and guide junior and mid\-level developers and conduct knowledge\-sharing sessions.
* Coordinate technical activities to ensure timely project delivery.
* Review technical deliverables and identify risks affecting quality, timelines, scope, or client satisfaction.
* Maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, development standards, and project documentation.
* Support Business Development and Project Management teams with solutioning, technical discussions, scope analysis, estimation, and client communication.
* Identify technical gaps and proactively recommend enhancements and additional billable opportunities.
* Contribute to improving the organization's e\-commerce technology capabilities and service offerings.

  




**What skills and experience are we looking for?**

* Strong experience in e\-commerce development and customization.
* Hands\-on experience with Magento, WooCommerce, Drupal, Shopify, PrestaShop, OpenCart, Shopware, Sylius, or similar platforms.
* Strong knowledge of PHP, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, REST APIs, GraphQL, and MySQL/MariaDB.
* Experience with API integrations, payment gateways, ERP/CRM, marketplaces, and e\-commerce integrations.
* Strong understanding of Git, CI/CD, testing, deployment, security, and performance optimization.
* Experience with cloud and containerization technologies such as AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, or Kubernetes is an advantage.
* Proven experience in technical leadership, team mentoring, and code reviews.
* Strong skills in solution architecture, troubleshooting, estimation, scope management, and requirement analysis.
* Ability to communicate effectively with clients, technical teams, Business Development, and Project Management.
* Strong commercial awareness to identify enhancements and additional billable opportunities.

title: Salesforce Engineer
description:
**Company Overview**
 ClearView Healthcare Partners is a premier life sciences strategy consulting firm headquartered in Boston, with offices in San Francisco, New York City, London, Zurich and Gurgaon. Serving clients in the biopharmaceutical, medical device, and diagnostic spaces, we provide world\-class strategic decision\-making support across a diverse range of business issues. Our goal is to inform actionable recommendations that allow companies to achieve their business objectives.
   

  

 ClearView is looking for a Salesforce Engineer to join our Information Technology team. This role covers Platform Configuration/Development, System Administration/Integration/Support, and User Enablement and Adoption. The primary focus will be hands\-on platform development and administration/integration, with user enablement and adoption as a supporting responsibility. This position requires the ability to work with minimal direction, adapt to changing demands, and identify opportunities for process improvement. This position will work in our India office but will be responsible for ClearView’s Salesforce platform globally.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Platform Configuration and Development**
* ClearView has locations in Massachusetts, New York, California, United Kingdom, Switzerland and India. This position will be responsible for configuring and maintaining ClearView’s Salesforce org to support business processes across all locations, including declarative configuration of objects, fields, page layouts, flows, validation rules, permission sets and reports.
* Build new functionality where it does not exist today to support business development, project delivery, expert network, and finance workflows.
* Develop and maintain custom solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, and the Salesforce APIs where declarative tools are insufficient.
* Apply Salesforce development best practices, including bulkification, governor\-limit\-aware design, automated testing, error handling and logging, asynchronous processing, code reviews, and source control.
* Maintain release management and change control practices across sandbox and production environments, including testing, deployment and documentation of changes.
* Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements, implement Salesforce changes within established standards, and document them for ongoing support.
* Annual review of org configuration, technical debt, and license utilization, with recommendations for enhancement.


**User Enablement and Adoption**
* Partner with business stakeholders and ClearView’s training group to support Salesforce adoption and effective use of the platform.
* Support adoption through clear communication, demonstrations, documentation, and targeted enablement as new capabilities are introduced.
* Develop reference materials, release notes, and office hours to support onboarding, ongoing platform use, and new feature rollouts.
* Work with the Salesforce Architect to share Salesforce knowledge and provide targeted enablement for the Information Technology Team.


**System Administration/Integration/Support**
* Work closely with other IT Infrastructure and Applications personnel to ensure Salesforce and connected systems are securely designed, deployed, and managed. This includes SSO/SAML, organization\-wide defaults (OWD), role hierarchy and sharing rules, permission sets, CRUD/FLS enforcement, Apex security considerations, data access models, and integrations with systems currently in place at ClearView.
* Provide recommendations on changes/enhancements to the above systems to ensure ClearView is using best in class platform capabilities.
* Evaluate and refine existing integrations, data quality, and platform performance/availability.
* Manage Salesforce data lifecycle considerations, including data retention, archiving/purge, data quality, bulk data operations, and how client data is stored or retained in downstream systems and integrations.
* Serve as Salesforce subject matter expert and key technical resource for the platform and connected tools, including data management, reporting/analytics, user provisioning, and AppExchange applications.
* Identify defects and performance issues through testing, monitoring and user feedback, and work with responsible teams to address and resolve them.
* Ensure compliance with ClearView’s IT and data protection policies and follow established change management procedures.
* In the event of system outages or data issues, work directly with the Salesforce Architect to diagnose the issue, manage the remediation process, and document the results.


**Other Responsibilities**
* Provide technical Salesforce expertise, support platform initiatives, and contribute to the Salesforce roadmap.
* Design and implement standardized deployment and testing checklists for all new Salesforce releases and connected applications.
* Stay current with Salesforce seasonal releases and new platform capabilities and recommend appropriate action.
* Work with the Head of Information Technology to support audit processes related to system access and data integrity.
* As per client MSAs, ensure client data held in Salesforce is protected and ultimately purged as required.
* Perform other related duties and activities as required.


**Job Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree in a technical or computer science related discipline. Advanced degree preferred.
* 4\-7 years of relevant Salesforce configuration and development experience.
* Salesforce Platform Developer II certification or equivalent demonstrated real\-world Salesforce development experience.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to business and non\-technical stakeholders and support adoption through documentation, demonstrations, and training.
* Demonstrates strong problem solving, analytical, interpersonal, and ownership skills.
* Possesses excellent collaboration skills for work with various internal team members.


**Required Skills/Experience**

description:
**About Agoda**



At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

  




Today, we are part of Booking Holdings \[NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

  



No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you're ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

  


**About our Team**  

At Agoda, our Backend Engineering team builds **high\-scale, fault\-tolerant distributed systems** that power a global travel platform serving **millions of users daily**. We own mission\-critical domains across **inventory, pricing, booking, payments, and customer/partner platforms**.



Our systems run with **high availability, low latency, and zero\-downtime expectations**, powered by modern technologies such as **Scala, Go, Java, Kotlin, Kafka, and Aerospike**, along with strong foundations in **CI/CD, automation, and observability**.



We ship fast—often **dozens of releases a day**—and design systems that are **resilient, self\-healing, and built to scale globally**.

  

**The Opportunity**  

As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll own the design and reliability of a critical service or domain end\-to\-end — from architecture through production. Beyond writing code, you'll be expected to identify problems before they're assigned to you, make independent calls on ambiguous technical trade\-offs within your domain, and raise the technical bar for your immediate team. You'll combine hands\-on coding, system design, and technical ownership — accountable for outcomes within your service, and a trusted technical voice when your work touches adjacent teams.

  

**What You will Do**

  


* Design, build, and own scalable distributed systems and microservices within your domain
* Lead development of complex features and technical initiatives end\-to\-end, within your service or team
* Drive system design, API design, and engineering best practices for your team
* Own scalability, performance, reliability, and fault tolerance of the services you're responsible for
* Optimize high\-throughput, low\-latency systems
* Proactively identify gaps, risks, or improvement opportunities in your domain, and drive them to resolution without waiting to be asked
* Make independent architectural and technical trade\-off decisions within your service's scope, and be accountable for the outcomes
* Collaborate with adjacent teams when your service's boundaries or dependencies require it, and raise engineering standards within your own team
* Partner with your product and business stakeholders to translate business needs into technical priorities, and technical constraints into business context
* Stay hands\-on with coding and system design
* Mentor engineers on your team with a structured approach, supporting their growth
* Handle production issues within your domain, drive RCA, and lead follow\-through improvements

  

**What We're Looking For**


*Technical*

  


* 8–12 years of backend engineering experience
* Strong experience building and owning distributed systems at scale, within a service or domain
* Expertise in: Java, Kotlin, Scala, or Go
* Strong understanding of microservices architecture, REST APIs \& system design, SQL/NoSQL databases, and performance, scalability, and concurrency
* Strong coding and problem\-solving ability


*Beyond the technical bar:*

  


* A track record of taking ownership beyond your assigned tasks — initiatives you drove within your domain because you saw the need, not because you were told
* Comfort making decisions under ambiguity and owning the consequences, technical and business, within your area of ownership
* Experience communicating trade\-offs to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders, adjusting your framing accordingly
* Demonstrated impact mentoring or growing engineers on your team, with concrete outcomes, not just informal help

  



Nice to Have

  


* Experience building large\-scale consumer or marketplace platforms
* Exposure to event\-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
* Experience with NoSQL databases (Cassandra, MongoDB, Aerospike)
* Familiarity with cloud (AWS/GCP), CI/CD pipelines
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments

  


###### **\#Delhi \#Gurgaon \#Gurugram \#Bangalore \#Bengaluru \#Chennai \#Noida \#DelhiNCR \#Pune \#Mumbai \#Hyderabad \#Chandigarh \#Kolkata**

description:

**About Level AI**
 Level AI is a Series C conversational intelligence company headquartered in Mountain View, CA, backed by top\-tier VCs and Silicon Valley operators. We help enterprise contact centers understand every customer conversation — using speech AI, NLP/NLU, and retrieval systems to turn millions of unstructured interactions into decisions businesses can act on.
   

  

 Why this role exists
   

  

 We're at the scaling inflection point. The systems that carried us from Series A to Series C won't carry us to the next stage, and we need someone to own that transition — not just build inside it.
   

  

 This is a
 **Principal** 
 role: you'll set technical direction for backend and ML infrastructure across multiple teams, make the architectural calls that are expensive to reverse, and raise the engineering bar through design reviews, mentorship, and the standards you set by example. You'll report to the VP of
 **Engineering** 
 and partner directly with our ML, Product, and Infrastructure leads across both sites.
   

  

 You'll work alongside engineers from Amazon, Google, and Meta who chose to build here because the problems are unsolved and the ownership is real.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

* Own the architecture for real\-time data processing at scale. Design and evolve distributed messaging systems that handle high\-throughput streaming workloads with strict latency requirements.
* Build the ML platform that lets us ship models faster. Define and execute the technical roadmap for training and serving infrastructure as our models grow in size, complexity, and inference cost.
* Scale our GPU infrastructure. Own capacity planning, scheduling, and utilization across training and inference fleets — deciding what runs where, how we handle burst demand, and how we keep spend tied to actual throughput rather than idle reservations.
* Scale inference. Drive down latency and cost per request as model complexity and traffic grow: batching and routing strategies, quantization and compilation, autoscaling, and caching — without degrading output quality.
* Make reliability a property of the system, not a heroic effort. Drive uptime, observability, and incident response for serving systems that enterprise customers depend on in production.
* Turn ambiguous business problems into executable technical plans. Partner with Product and GTM to scope large cross\-functional initiatives, then break them into work other teams can run with.
* Multiply the team. Lead design reviews, mentor senior engineers, and shape the engineering practices that outlast any single project.
* Bring the outside in. Evaluate emerging tools and techniques with judgment — adopt what earns its complexity, skip what doesn't.


 What success looks like in your first year
   

  

* 90 days: You've mapped our critical paths and failure modes, shipped a meaningful improvement to a serving or pipeline bottleneck, and earned trust across both sites.
* 6 months: You own a published technical roadmap for \[messaging / ML infra], with at least one major migration or redesign underway. GPU utilization and inference cost per request are measured, and trending the right way.
* 12 months: Our infrastructure scales predictably with customer growth, inference cost stays flat or falls as volume rises, on\-call load is down, and other engineers are making better architectural decisions because of standards you established.


 What you'll bring
   

  

* \[10]\+ years building backend and infrastructure systems, with a track record of owning architecture and design at scale — not just implementing it.
* Deep, hands\-on experience with large\-scale databases, high\-throughput messaging systems, and real\-time job queues.
* Proven ability to navigate large, complex codebases and reason clearly about architectural tradeoffs in systems you didn't build.
* Experience mentoring senior engineers and driving technical decisions through influence rather than authority.
* Strong written communication — you'll be making technical cases to engineers in two time zones and business cases to executives.
* BTech/MTech/PhD in Computer Science or equivalent. At this level we weight track record well above pedigree.


 Bonus points for
   

  

* Production experience with our stack: Django, Celery, Redis, PostgreSQL, and Google Cloud.
* Hands\-on experience scaling GPU infrastructure and model inference in production — capacity planning, scheduling and utilization, autoscaling, and latency/cost optimization under real traffic.
* Depth in specific inference tooling — vLLM, TensorRT, Triton, Ray Serve, or equivalents — and experience benchmarking tradeoffs between them.
* Experience scaling a platform through a comparable growth stage (Series C → D, or equivalent), especially at a global product company's India site.
* Background in speech, NLP, or information retrieval systems.


**Compensation \& Benefits**
* Health coverage for you, your spouse, children, and parents.
* \[home\-office and connectivity allowance / annual learning budget / parental leave — trim to what's accurate].
* Real ownership over systems used by enterprises worldwide, with the autonomy to decide how they're built.


 How we hire
   

  

**\[4]** 
 stages, typically
 **\[2] weeks** 
 end to end: recruiter screen → technical deep dive → system design → team and leadership conversations → offer. Interviews are conducted from our India team with
 **\[one/two]** 
 conversations with US\-based leadership. We'll tell you where you stand at every step.
   

  

*Level AI is an equal opportunity employer. We hire and promote on merit and evaluate all applicants without regard to caste, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital or parental status, disability, or any other personal characteristic unrelated to the job. We maintain a zero\-tolerance policy on harassment in line with the POSH Act, 2013\. If you need any accommodation during the interview process, tell us — we'll arrange it.*

title: Senior Backend Engineer, NIRA
description:
Join the Tilt team
   

  

 At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile\-first products and machine learning\-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real\-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide
 **,** 
 we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.
   

  

 NIRA is building a consumer credit platform for Middle India, targeting \~200m underservied people. Active in 5000\+ cities and processing 15,000\+ loan applications/day, NIRA is backed by and integrated with US\-based Tilt.
   

  

**The opportunity \- Senior Backend Engineer, NIRA**
 We’re looking for a strong Senior Software Engineer to join NIRA’s engineering team. You will have the opportunity to shape strategy for the infrastructure and product roadmap. This role will give you the ability to have a direct and outsized impact on technical projects, leading to enormous potential for career\-growth.
   

  

**This role is Hybrid, based in our Bangalore office 2\-3 days/week.**
**How You'll Make An Impact**
* Work closely with the local NIRA Engineering team, and partner with the broader APAC Engineering team to increase the scale our platform can handle.
* Expand the platform to support multiple financial products and underlying instruments.
* Drive iterations on credit policy and improve credit decision systems.
* Collaborate with product, credit/finance, compliance, support and analytics teams.


**Why you're a great fit**
* Strong experience using Java (ideally .net too).
* Demonstrated experience working in AWS\-native environments, using tools like DynamoDB, Athena and Lambda.
* You have experience with scaled technical solutions \- have worked on projects to increase the scaleability of a platform.
* Clear communicator, ability to clearly articulate technical solutions and collaborate with colleagues globally.
* Product Engineer mentality \- own your solutions from start to finish.


**Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.**
**What You'll Get At Tilt**
* Virtual\-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.
* Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.
* Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.
* Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.
* Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)
* Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.


**The Tilt Way**
 We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non\-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the \[virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.
   

  

**You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.**

With a market share of 75% in India, we have a strong foothold in the Middle East and are also serving customers in SAARC \& APAC, Africa, and North America. Our robust network of 28000\+ partners help us deliver unmatched customer experience in sales, support, and services globally.  

With a sole purpose of Making Everyone Who Touches Tally, Happier, we aim to be the technology fabric that drives the economic growth of the world, by 2030\.


**Culture \& Values**
Over the years, we have nurtured a value\-based culture that let individuals follow their lead and support them in their growth journey with us. We value honesty and integrity, prioritize a people\-first culture, pursue excellence, and drive impactful innovation with simplicity.  

Our vision at Tally is to ensure that all employees get access to equal opportunities, with decisions grounded on performance, merit, competence, and potential. We are dedicated to fairness and transparency in our policies. By fostering diversity and equality, we strive to eliminate all forms of discrimination. We are committed to an inclusive leadership where our leaders ensure that our people are empowered to be at their best, professionally, and personally. We take great pride in our work culture which has helped become a proud member of the elite Kincentric Best Employers Club!


**Engineering:**
Our Engineering centre is located in Bangalore while our sales offices and partners are spread across the country and specific regions outside India. Our Engineering team consists of highly talented engineers who live a purpose and dream to develop the software that will accomplish our goal ‘To be the technology fabric that drives the economic growth of the world’.


To build this network of businesses Tally likes to build its own technology stack to deliver the required products. Major components of the stack are highlighted below.


* **Operating system: We use a trimmed\-down version of the Linux**
* **Database system**: An Object\-oriented database written by Tally to support single view, replication, distributed and multi\-tenancy.
* **Web server \& app server:** We shall write our own hosting platform that can handle millions of connections per server.


Engineering @ Tally is responsible for the Design, Development \& Testing of all the delightful and flawless products that we release for our customers. We at Engineering do deep technology innovation to deliver unique experiences and capabilities at scale for simplifying business operations across sectors and segments.


### **We believe in**


* **Innovate:** Build our tech stack with purpose\-driven engineers to craft robust, scalable products that power economic growth.
* **Design for the future:** Lay the foundation of technology that connects businesses, enabling seamless growth and transformation.
* **Engineer the Core:** Create resilient, and secure software systems that form the backbone of our mission to drive global prosperity.


**What You Will Own**
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Backend Lead to join our AI team. As a Backend Lead, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the performance, scalability, and efficiency of our backend architecture while mentoring and leading a team of engineers. This position requires deep expertise in backend engineering, particularly in Python, and a strong understanding of building scalable and efficient systems. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of leadership in backend development, and the ability to drive complex technical initiatives.


**Where Your Expertise Meets Our Future**
* Strong understanding of STLC, Agile and modern Quality Engineering practices, with expertise in functional, integration, API, regression, end to end, non\-functional testing and compatibility testing.
* Ability to analyse requirements and system workflows, design effective **test strategies, test scenarios, and risk\-based test cases**, and ensure comprehensive functional and non\-functional coverage.
* Hands\-on automation experience with Playwright/Selenium/Cypress and proficiency in Python, Java, JavaScript or TypeScript.
* Strong API and performance testing experience using tools such as Postman, REST Assured, JMeter, Gatling or k6\.
* Good understanding of microservices, distributed systems, networking, databases and cloud\-native architectures.
* Hands\-on exposure to AWS/Azure/GCP, Docker/Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines and Git\-based workflows.
* Experience with observability, debugging and RCA using logs, metrics and monitoring tools such as Grafana, CloudWatch or ELK.
* Exposure to AI\-assisted testing/development and testing of AI/LLM\-based applications is an added advantage.
**The Scope of Your Influence*** **End\-to\-End Deployment \& Testing:** Collaborate with backend engineers to deploy models via Docker/Kubernetes, and design end\-to\-end test strategies (on\-prem and cloud) grounded in system architecture.
* **CI/CD \& Automation:** Maintain robust CI/CD pipelines and drive continuous test automation to minimize turnaround time for new releases.
* **Research \& Distillation:** Actively research state\-of\-the\-art open\-source models (e.g., Qwen3, Mistral) and apply Knowledge Distillation to create smaller, faster proprietary models.
* **Monitor \& Improve:** Continuously monitor drift, hallucination rates, and retrieval quality in production systems.
* **Code Quality and Best Practices:** Ensure that code adheres to best practices, including clean code principles, testing, and documentation.
* **Build Agentic Systems:** Implement multi\-agent workflows using LangGraph to solve complex, multi\-step user queries.
* **Optimize for Scale:** Implement Quantization and vLLM/SGLang strategies to reduce inference costs and latency in production.

title: Lead Engineer - Backend (Data Platform)
description:
About the Role We are looking for a Lead Engineer - Backend / Data Platform to provide technical leadership for backend and data-intensive systems powering analytics, reporting, experimentation, and behavioural insights across Wingify AB Tasty. This is a hands-on technical leadership role , not an engineering management position. You will continue to design systems and write production code , while also owning architecture and technical direction for significant workstreams. You will work across Java, ClickHouse, BigQuery, Bigtable, Redis, Kafka, and GCP , solving problems spanning event ingestion, distributed processing, query engines, analytical storage, low-latency serving, and reporting. A key part of the role is helping us evolve two mature analytics platforms toward a more unified data foundation without compromising the reliability of systems already serving production customers. 
The Engineering Landscape Our production data platform includes: ClickHouse - self-hosted and ClickHouse Cloud for high-volume analytics and SaaS reporting BigQuery - large-scale analytics and data processing Bigtable - low-latency NoSQL serving Redis - caching, queues, and distributed coordination Kafka - high-volume real-time event streaming GCP - GCS, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, IAM, Secret Manager, GKE and VMs Java - Spring Boot and JVM-based backend services Apache Beam / Dataflow - distributed event and batch processing Go - adjacent SQL and reporting services Alongside the existing platform, we are building capabilities around: Warehouse-native experiment computation in customer Snowflake/BigQuery environments Cross-platform visitor profiles and identity First-party cohorts and saved audiences Unified metrics across internal and customer warehouses Converging Wingify and AB Tasty analytics onto a common data foundation 
What Youll Do Architecture System Design Own the technical architecture and design of significant backend/data-platform workstreams. Design distributed systems for high-volume event ingestion, analytical querying, data processing, and low-latency serving . Make architectural decisions around data modelling, storage engines, partitioning, query patterns, caching, streaming, reliability, and cost . Evaluate trade-offs across ClickHouse, BigQuery, Bigtable, Redis, Kafka, and other technologies based on workload characteristics. Drive designs that can evolve as the Wingify and AB Tasty platforms converge. Hands-on Engineering Remain hands-on with Java and production backend code . Build and evolve backend services, query engines, APIs, data pipelines, and distributed processing systems. Write and optimise complex analytical SQL and troubleshoot performance bottlenecks. Solve difficult production problems involving slow queries, data correctness, pipeline failures, latency, throughput, and infrastructure . Work with Kafka, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, GCS, ClickHouse, BigQuery, Bigtable, and Redis at production scale. Own critical systems through design, implementation, deployment, observability, and operation . Technical Leadership Set technical direction for a platform area or major engineering workstream . Break ambiguous product and platform requirements into clear technical designs and execution plans. Review architecture and designs from other engineers and challenge assumptions constructively. Establish engineering practices around reliability, scalability, observability, performance, and maintainability . Mentor SSE-1/SSE-2 engineers and help them grow their system-design and production-engineering capabilities. Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and Infrastructure teams. Influence architecture beyond your immediate projects without requiring formal people-management authority. 
What Were Looking For 6+ years of hands-on backend/software engineering experience , with substantial experience building distributed or data-intensive systems. Demonstrated ownership of architecture and system design for production systems at meaningful scale. Strong hands-on Java experience, including modern Java and JVM backend systems. Strong experience designing systems around analytical databases, data warehouses, and/or large-scale non-relational stores . Deep understanding of data modelling, partitioning, indexing, clustering, query execution, caching, concurrency, and performance optimisation . Strong SQL and analytical-querying experience. Experience designing and operating streaming/event-driven architectures , ideally using Kafka or equivalent technologies. Experience building batch and/or streaming data pipelines at scale. Strong cloud engineering experience; GCP is preferred. Experience operating production systems with clear SLOs, observability, failure handling, and performance requirements . Strong debugging ability across applications, distributed systems, databases, pipelines, and infrastructure. Experience mentoring senior engineers, reviewing technical designs, and influencing architecture . Ability to balance long-term platform architecture with pragmatic delivery. 
Nice to Have Deep production experience with ClickHouse , including schema design, MergeTree engines, partitioning, sorting keys, query optimisation, replication, and performance tuning. BigQuery and Bigtable at significant production scale. Apache Beam / Dataflow . Snowflake or warehouse-native compute architectures. Go , Vert.x, or other high-performance backend technologies. Experience handling billions of events and/or TB-PB scale analytical datasets . Experience with experimentation platforms, A/B testing, funnels, segmentation, identity resolution, cohorts, or behavioural analytics. Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, Prometheus, Grafana, or GCP Cloud Monitoring. 
Core Skills Java System Design Distributed Systems Data Platform ClickHouse SQL BigQuery Bigtable Kafka Redis GCP Pub/Sub Dataflow ETL Microservices Technical Leadership

title: Sr.Backend Engineer
description:
Job Summary 
 We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Node.js, TypeScript, distributed systems, microservices, and AWS cloud technologies. The engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, scaling, and supporting highly available backend services and APIs for customer-facing applications. The role requires strong ownership of backend architecture, application performance, production reliability, security, observability, and cloud-native engineering practices. Experience with React frontend development and/or Java/Spring Boot is beneficial but not mandatory. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and RESTful APIs using Node.js and TypeScript. Build reliable, secure, and highly available microservice-based and distributed applications. Design and implement efficient data models and access patterns using Amazon DynamoDB. Build cloud-native and event-driven backend solutions using AWS services such as ECS, Lambda, S3, SQS, API Gateway, and CloudWatch. Develop asynchronous processing workflows, background jobs, integrations, and messaging-based architectures. Define backend architecture, service boundaries, API contracts, data flows, and relationships between distributed components. Troubleshoot and resolve complex customer-facing and production issues across backend services and cloud infrastructure. Proactively identify and address issues related to performance, scalability, stability, security, availability, and extensibility. Participate actively in architecture discussions, technical design reviews, and code reviews. Ensure backend services meet defined standards for performance, reliability, security, maintainability, and quality. Write automated unit, integration, API, and service-level tests. Monitor and troubleshoot production applications using logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and alerts. Maintain high availability and demonstrate strong ownership of customer trust and production reliability. Support and improve CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, containerization, and deployment processes. Collaborate with product managers, quality engineers, architects, and globally distributed engineering teams. Work in an Agile/Scrum development environment. Take end-to-end ownership of backend features throughout the complete software development lifecycle, from technical design and implementation through deployment and production support. Mentor engineers and contribute to backend engineering standards, development practices, and architectural guidelines. 
 
 Minimum Qualifications 
 7-9 years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 5 years of strong backend development experience. Strong hands-on programming experience with Node.js, TypeScript, and JavaScript. Strong experience designing and developing RESTful APIs, backend services, and microservice-based applications. Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented principles, software design patterns, and architectural principles. Experience designing scalable and maintainable distributed backend systems. Hands-on experience with Amazon DynamoDB, including: Partition key and sort key design Global and local secondary indexes Query and access-pattern-based data modelling Performance and scalability considerations Strong experience developing cloud-native applications using AWS services such as: ECS / Lambda / S3 / SQS / API Gateway / CloudWatch Experience building asynchronous, queue-based, and event-driven processing workflows. Experience developing scalable, secure, resilient, and highly available applications. Experience with automated testing frameworks such as Jest, Mocha, or equivalent backend testing frameworks. Experience with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and Jenkins or equivalent CI/CD platforms. Experience using Git-based source-control and development workflows. Strong understanding of application monitoring, debugging, observability, incident troubleshooting, and production-support practices. Good understanding of API security, authentication/authorization, error handling, resiliency, and backend performance optimization. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. 
 
 Skills 
 
 Primary Skills 
 Must-have Node.js / TypeScript and JavaScript Backend application development RESTful APIs and microservices Distributed systems and service-oriented architecture AWS ECS, Lambda, S3, SQS, API Gateway, and CloudWatch Amazon DynamoDB Event-driven and asynchronous application design Docker CI/CD pipelines Unit and integration testing Production troubleshooting and application observability Backend performance, scalability, security, and reliability 
 
 Secondary Skills 
 Java and Spring Boot React HTML, CSS, and modern JavaScript frontend development MySQL or PostgreSQL Redis or Amazon ElastiCache AWS Step Functions, SNS, EventBridge, IAM, and EC2 Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation Kubernetes NestJS or Express.js OpenTelemetry, Dynatrace, Datadog, or similar observability tools Experience with messaging, event streaming, or distributed workflow platforms

description:
Apollo.io is the leading go\-to\-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1\.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top\-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.
   

  

 Your Role \& Mission
   

  

 As a Senior Backend Engineer at Apollo, you'll be a critical part of a fast\-growing company, working on a cross\-functional team to build highly scalable systems and set the bar for how we engineer. The way we build has changed: this is an
 **AI\-native** 
 role. We're not looking for someone who
 *also* 
 uses AI, we're looking for someone who thinks
 *with* 
 it, forms their own hypotheses, pressure\-tests what AI produces, catches its errors, and design more robustly than they could alone.
   

  

 You'll work in an open, collaborative environment, give and receive hands\-on mentorship, and have real opportunities to grow. You'll interface daily with design, front\-end, analytics, product, and teams beyond Engineering. You enjoy working cross\-functionally to solve hard problems and make an impact. You strive for quality, are obsessed with improving it, automation, monitoring, squashing the bugs that sneak through and you're always investigating performance improvements and better ideas.
   

  

 Daily Adventures \& Responsibilities
   

  

* Design and implement highly scalable, highly available backend services with proper monitoring and alerting in place
* Ramp quickly into large, unfamiliar codebases, de\-risk your changes, understand blast radius, and ship with confidence
* Use AI as a core part of your workflow: generate and pressure\-test approaches, verify and catch AI's mistakes, and stand behind the quality of the code you ship with it
* Drive the full lifecycle of software development: product requirements, architecture, solution design, development, quality assurance, and maintenance, ownership doesn't end at deploy
* Scope and reshape under\-specified problems, and write clear design docs that satisfy real product needs
* Partner closely with PMs: translate product intent into technical decisions, surface the technical realities they need to make good calls, and push back on the spec when reality changes the answer
* Mentor others on best practices and effectively share knowledge to up\-level the team
* Communicate progress clearly to the product lead, engineering manager, and other stakeholders
* Introduce new technologies and ideas when they earn their place
* Give and receive technical and behavioral feedback; engage in scrum ceremonies, team culture, and collaborate with the team.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

* AI\-native engineers. You use AI to raise your bar, not just move faster forming your own hypotheses, pressure\-testing and verifying AI output, catching its errors, and taking full ownership of code quality regardless of how it was produced. You stay current with a fast\-moving toolset.
* Comfort in unfamiliar code. You ramp fast into systems you didn't write, reason about blast radius, and de\-risk changes rather than hoping they work.
* Architectural ownership \& operational readiness. You design for scale and availability, anticipate failure modes, and build with monitoring and alerting from the start.
* Ownership start to finish. Just because a project has been deployed doesn't mean it's done. You own outcomes , think end to end in terms of product and are customer obsessed
* Collaboration you can trust. You let others speak, seek to understand their viewpoints, and are the kind of teammate people want to build with.
* Product judgment. You care about the customer outcome, make the technical calls that produce a great product, and know when to challenge a spec.
* Growth \& learning. You actively improve your craft, your team, and how you work.
* Proactivity. You act without being told, identify areas of improvement, and drive best practices.
* Comfort with ambiguity. You can operate without a fully\-specified problem and bring structure to it.
* Organization \& planning. You break large projects into smaller pieces that are easier to estimate and deliver.
* Strong communication. Clear in writing and in person, across technical and non\-technical audiences.


**Qualifications**
* Minimum 5\+ years of industry experience in backend development, at least 3\-4 years in senior positions, building large\-scale applications with right observability.
* Solid computer science fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, and object\-oriented design
* Fluency using AI tools in real development work, plus the judgment to verify and pressure\-test their output rather than trusting it blindly
* Experience developing distributed web applications
* Write code that is comprehensible, well\-structured, and highly performant
* Experience with database modeling (SQL or NoSQL both fine)
* Experience using and designing RESTful services


**Must have:** 
 Curiosity, AI\-native engineering judgment, communication skills, problem solving.
   

  

**Nice to have:** 
 BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or similar; GCP, Kubernetes, Docker, Mongo, Redis, Ruby on Rails, Microservices, Machine Learning

If you're energized by finding smarter, faster ways to get things done using AI and automation, you'll thrive here.

title: MTS 1, Backend Software Engineer
description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.
   

  

 Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.
   

  

 Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.
   

  

 Join eBay’s Advertising and Marketing Technology teams to build the platforms, services, and user experiences that help sellers grow their business and make eBay the destination website for existing and new customers. You’ll work on high\-scale systems spanning frontend applications, backend services, APIs, data pipelines, and AI\-assisted engineering workflows, partnering closely with product, design, analytics, and applied science. We’re looking for engineers who can turn business problems into reliable, maintainable software, make sound technical tradeoffs, and take ownership from design through production. This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys solving practical engineering problems in a fast\-moving environment where performance, quality, and measurable customer impact matter.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Design and build innovative advertising, marketing platform features that help eBay sellers, advertisers grow their business and help eBay become the dominant eCommerce platform.
* Develop scalable, highly available applications, APIs, and services using technologies such as Marko, React, Node.js, Java, and Scala.
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of complex features, from technical design and architecture through deployment and production support.
* Drive technical decisions, system design, and cross\-team collaboration to ensure scalable, reliable, and maintainable solutions.
* Leverage AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) throughout the development lifecycle for coding, debugging, testing, and code review to increase engineering velocity.
* Contribute to AI\-powered advertising and marketing features by collaborating with ML engineers on LLM integrations, recommendation systems, and intelligent campaign optimization.
* Contribute to a culture of continuous learning, Agile development, open\-source collaboration, and rapid software delivery.
* Mentor team members, participate in technical discussions, and help shape engineering best practices across the organization.


**Job Requirements**
* BS/BA in Computer Science or related field plus 6\+ years work experience or MS with 5\+ years of relevant experience.
* Strong experience in Java (17\+) and building services with Spring Boot or similar frameworks.
* Experience building scalable backend systems and RESTful APIs in distributed environments.
* Experience with event\-driven architectures and message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar).
* Experience with relational (Oracle/Postgres/MySQL) and/or NoSQL (Cassandra/MongoDB) databases, including schema design and query optimization.
* Familiar with Big Data stack (Hadoop, Spark, Flink etc).
* Proven ability to own end\-to\-end system design: writing technical design documents, leading design reviews, and making architectural decisions for multi\-service features.
* Experience designing scalable distributed systems with a track record of evaluating trade\-offs. (consistency, availability, latency, cost) and driving technical alignment across teams.
* Experience with AI\-assisted development practices and tools to increase engineering productivity (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent).
* Experience building or integrating LLM\-powered features, agentic workflows, or AI\-driven automation in production systems is a plus.
* Strong ownership mentality with ability to drive work end\-to\-end in a collaborative environment.
* Exposure to GraphQL and experience in building Federated GraphQL APIs is highly desirable.
* Experience on contributing to open\-source is a plus.


 Benefits are an essential part of your total compensation for the work you do every day. Whether you’re single, in a growing family, or nearing retirement, eBay offers a variety of comprehensive and competitive benefit programs to meet your needs. Including maternal \& paternal leave, paid sabbatical, and plans to help ensure your financial security today and in the years ahead because we know feeling financially secure during your working years and through retirement is important.
   

  

 Here at eBay, we love creating opportunities for others by connecting people from widely diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and geographies. So, being diverse and inclusive isn’t just something we strive for, it is who we are, and part of what we do each and every single day. We want to ensure that as an employee, you feel eBay is a place where, no matter who you are, you feel safe, included, and that you have the opportunity to bring your unique self to work. To learn about eBay’s Diversity \& Inclusion click here: https://www.ebayinc.com/our\-company/diversity\-inclusion/
   

  

 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
   

  

**Additional Details**
 eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

title: Back End Developer
description:
**About Company:** 




  





 Kinexcs is an AI\-driven digital health platform and wearables company with a mission to enable and empower people for mobility and a better quality of life. It is focused on reducing the burden of musculoskeletal conditions, which affects about 25% of the world's population. Their 1st product, KIMIA Recover, a continuous monitoring device for the knee joint, has obtained CE marking and HSA approval and booked revenues from large implant companies and hospitals. It has recently won the Innomatch grant by the Temasek Foundation (one of the 6 among 256 companies across 32 countries), and is currently deployed in some of the largest public hospitals in Singapore. KIMIA Recover is a comprehensive recovery management solution that provides a reduction in the number of hospital visits and complications. The product was also the National Winner and International Top 20 of the prestigious James Dyson Award 2020 and has gained traction with major public hospitals and orthopaedic clinics. Their digital therapy platform, consisting of KIMIA Assess and KIMIA Move products, uses artificial intelligence technology for digital MSK assessment and therapy. This platform is capable of providing pre\-consultation assessments and real\-time exercise guidance and feedback to musculoskeletal patients and is being adopted by some of the largest private healthcare providers in the region, along with large corporate players.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




  





 Are you a hands\-on Backend Developer who enjoys solving complex technical problems.
 



 We are looking for a Backend Developer with strong hands\-on experience in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, REST APIs, databases, and AWS.
 



 The ideal candidate will be actively involved in software development while driving engineering best practices and maintaining the code quality.
 



  





 You will work closely with Tech Lead, Architects, QA and DevOps and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable, reliable, secure and maintainable backend solutions.
 



  





**What We're Looking For:** 




  





 We’re seeking professionals with 3–6 years of software development experience, strong backend engineering expertise and experience.
 



  





**Required Technical Skills:** 




  





 Strong hands\-on experience with Java and object\-oriented programming.
 



 Strong experience with Spring Boot and the Spring ecosystem.
 



 Hands\-on experience designing and developing REST APIs and backend services.
 



 Strong practical experience with Microservices architecture.
 



 Good understanding of microservices concepts including service decomposition, inter\-service communication, scalability, resiliency and fault tolerance.
 



 Strong knowledge of SQL databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle or similar.
 



 Working experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis or similar.
 



 Strong working knowledge of AWS cloud services.
 



 Good understanding of system design and scalable backend architectures.
 



 Strong understanding of OOP, SOLID principles, design patterns, clean code and coding standards.
 



 Experience with unit testing, integration testing, debugging and code reviews.
 



 Good understanding of CI/CD and DevOps practices.
 



 Experience working with Git and modern software development practices.
 



 Ability to troubleshoot complex technical and production issues and identify root causes.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities As a Backend Developer, you will:** 




  





 Working with development of scalable Java and Spring Boot backend applications.
 



 Develop, maintain microservices and REST APIs.
 



 Participate actively in coding, debugging, technical discussions and code reviews.
 



 Ensure adherence to coding standards, design principles, testing practices and engineering best practices.
 



 Review code and provide constructive technical feedback to team members.
 



 Collaborate with Tech Lead, Architects, QA, DevOps and other stakeholders.
 



 Troubleshoot production issues and drive root\-cause analysis and permanent fixes.
 



 Contribute to improving development processes, automation, quality and engineering productivity.
 



  





**Ideal Candidate:** 




 You would be a great fit if you:
 



 Have 3–6 years of professional software development experience.
 



 Have strong hands\-on expertise in Java and Spring Boot.
 



 Have solid experience building and maintaining REST APIs and Microservices.
 



 Have experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases.
 



 Have practical experience with AWS.
 



 Have strong problem\-solving, analytical and debugging skills.
 



 Have a good understanding of system design and scalable architectures.
 



 Take ownership of delivering high\-quality, secure, scalable and maintainable software.
 



 Have React.js or Vue.js experience as an additional advantage.

title: Support Engineer
description:
We’re looking for a skilled and detail\-oriented Back\-End Developer to design, build, and maintain robust, scalable services that power our products. You’ll work with C\# and .NET at the core, shape efficient database architectures, deliver clean and secure REST APIs, and ensure our systems are observable, testable, and easy to maintain. You’ll collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams, contribute to code reviews, and leverage AI\-assisted development tools responsibly. This role is ideal for someone who takes pride in both technical excellence and teamwork.
   

  

**What does a great Back\-end Developer do?**
* As great Back\-end Developer you build reliable, maintainable systems by mastering the tools of their craft. You write clean, efficient code in C\# and .NET (6/7/8\), making full use of async/await, dependency injection, and flexible configuration to keep services responsive and adaptable.
* You design relational database schemas, often in PostgreSQL, with an eye for performance, handling SQL queries, migrations, and transaction isolation levels with care.
* You craft well\-structured REST APIs, defining clear contracts with OpenAPI/Scalar, ensuring robust validation and error handling, managing versioning, and securing endpoints through OAuth2, OIDC, and JWT.
* Testing is second nature: you write both unit and integration tests, structure code for testability, and use mocking frameworks effectively, being familiar with tools like xUnit or NUnit.
* You ensure observability is built\-in, with structured logging, metrics, and distributed tracing, making systems are easier to monitor and debug.
* You collaborate openly, communicate clearly in writing and speech, and give thoughtful feedback in code reviews, helping your team and cross\-functional teams succeed together.
* You leverage AI\-assisted development tools thoughtfully and responsibly, using them to accelerate problem\-solving, improve quality, and explore solutions, while validating outputs and safeguarding security, privacy, and compliance.
* You have some understanding of containerization with Docker, enough to run, debug, and configure applications locally or in development environments.
* Finally, you use Git and CI/CD pipelines effectively, automating build, test, and deployment processes so changes move from idea to production smoothly and safely.


**Required Experience**
* Strong in C\# and .NET (6/7/8\).
* Proficiency in C\# Web API development and a good grasp of RESTful API concepts and integration.
* Solid understanding of Relational database design and development (preferably PostgreSQL).
* Solid understanding of writing and maintaining unit and integration tests.
* Effective collaboration and clear communication in cross\-functional teams.
* Practical experience with containerization with Docker, Git and CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, and deployment.


**Work Location**
* Hybrid Work Model: This is a hybrid position, requiring you to work in the Bengaluru office 3 times per week.


**Company Values:**
 At Radancy, we are dedicated to the core values that guide our work and culture:
   

  

* Innovative Spirit Innovation leads the way. We have a rich history of developing and delivering what’s new and next while valuing every voice on our team. Together, we’re shaping the future and leading the industry forward.
* Rewarding Impact Work that matters. We strengthen organizations with transformative software that connects people around the world to meaningful careers. This work makes a difference in people’s lives and inspires our team to advance technology with purpose.
* Performance Driven Success drives results. We use data and insights to inform strategy and maximize performance for our customers, all backed by our global teams committed to exceeding expectations with unmatched expertise and support.
* Supportive Teams Collaboration is our backbone. We foster an environment that inspires our team members to deliver industry\-defining technology. We empower our teams to learn from each other, grow their skills and create positive change in their work and communities.


*Radancy is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes all qualified applicants regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We actively work to create an inclusive environment where all of our employees can thrive. If you require any accommodations during the application process, please reach out to us at*

description:
**About Agoda**
 At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
   

  

 Today, we are part of Booking Holdings \[NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
   

  

 No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
   

  

**About Our Team**
 At Agoda, our Backend Engineering team builds
 **high\-scale, fault\-tolerant distributed systems** 
 that power a global travel platform serving
 **millions of users daily** 
 . We own mission\-critical domains across
 **inventory, pricing, booking, payments, and customer/partner platforms**

 We ship fast—often

 As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll own the design and reliability of a critical service or domain end\-to\-end — from architecture through production. Beyond writing code, you'll be expected to identify problems before they're assigned to you, make independent calls on ambiguous technical trade\-offs within your domain, and raise the technical bar for your immediate team. You'll combine hands\-on coding, system design, and technical ownership — accountable for outcomes within your service, and a trusted technical voice when your work touches adjacent teams.

* Design, build, and own scalable distributed systems and microservices within your domain

* Strong understanding of microservices architecture, REST APIs \& system design, SQL/NoSQL databases, and performance, scalability, and concurrency
* Strong coding and problem\-solving ability


*Beyond the technical bar:*
* A track record of taking ownership beyond your assigned tasks — initiatives you drove within your domain because you saw the need, not because you were told
* Comfort making decisions under ambiguity and owning the consequences, technical and business, within your area of ownership
* Experience communicating trade\-offs to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders, adjusting your framing accordingly
* Demonstrated impact mentoring or growing engineers on your team, with concrete outcomes, not just informal help

* Experience building large\-scale consumer or marketplace platforms
* Exposure to event\-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
* Experience with NoSQL databases (Cassandra, MongoDB, Aerospike)
* Familiarity with cloud (AWS/GCP), CI/CD pipelines
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments

title: Software Development Engineer II, Direct Fulfilment
description:
**Description**
 Join a talented team of software engineers and technical leaders dedicated to reaching the next billion customers. This role offers the opportunity to work on high\-impact, complex challenges as we scale our systems to support new and rapidly growing India and emerging marketplaces. As a software engineer on the team, you will be responsible for the technical design and implementation of solutions that enable our Direct Fulfillment (DF) model. DF allows vendors to ship products directly to customers on behalf of Amazon. This requires building systems that can reliably work end\-to\-end for emerging and global marketplaces and enable seamless customer experiences. If you're excited to grow your skills while helping us scale the world's most customer\-centric retail technology, we'd love to hear from you!
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 You will be a technical leader to drive the
   

  

* Designing and developing highly reliable, scalable, and distributed systems.
* Delivering quality features on\-time and execution against project plans and delivery commitments.
* Working with team members to manage the day\-to\-day development activities, participate in designs, design review, code review, implementation, and operational excellence.
* Engaging and working with customers and dependencies to ensure the quality delivery.
* Mentoring other engineers
* Maintaining current technical knowledge to support rapidly changing technology, always on a look out for new technologies and work with the team in bringing in new technologies.
* Launch products to India as well as world\-wide marketplaces


**About The Team**
 Direct Fulfillment (DF), known in the industry as "dropship," is a fulfillment model that allows vendors to ship orders directly to the Customer. The offer is branded as 'Ships and Sold by Amazon' and the customer service experience is the same as items sold from Amazon Fulfillment centers, such that the customer does not know the difference. DF was launched in India (IN) on Oct 2018\. Our vision: “provide customers with widest possible retail selection while maintaining a superior experience for vendors and cost structure for Amazon”.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Knowledge of professional software engineering \& best practices for full software development life cycle, including coding standards, software architectures, code reviews, source control management, continuous deployments, testing, and operational excellence


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Lead Member of Technical Staff- Performance Suite
description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.


We are looking for **Lead** **Member of Technical Staff** to join our Clinicals test team within our Bangalore R\&D division. Your job will be to design script which will enable establish front end \& backend performance benchmarks for the products and services offered for Clinicals. Help us reach our goal of becoming the healthcare backbone by enhancing our cloud based EHR solution and leveraging the network effect of 85,400\+ providers. Apply your technical skills towards delivering a quality product to customers and allowing doctors to be doctors so that they can spend more time doing what they do best: provide patient care.

*But enough about us, let’s talk about you.”.*


You are Technologists with zeal to solve complex problems, growth mindset, fast learners who are willing to work in fast paced environment with total accountability.


Our athena Clinicals automation team is looking forward to establishing front end / backend performance benchmarks for clinicals workflows which shall enable resolve performance bottlenecks which enable build confidence on quality and enables doctors’ workflows that is used by over 100,000 healthcare providers daily. We build quality practices which interface and make interactions between these providers and the electronic health record as seamless as possible, and elevates what the doctor needs to see, when they need to see it. This team is innovative, passionate, and driven by our mission to help make an impact.

* Design, develop and execute performance test scripts using tool such as JMeter/ K6\.
* Analyse test results and identify performance bottlenecks, scalability issues, and reliability problems.
* Profile performance bottlenecks by using profiling tools and identify root cause.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand performance requirements and translate them into effective performance test scenarios.
* Provide recommendations for performance improvements based on test results and analysis.
* Monitor system performance during load tests to identify performance degradation and potential optimizations.
* Create performance testing reports and documentation for stakeholders and management.
* Participate in architectural and design reviews to provide performance\-related insights and recommendations.
* Stay updated with the latest performance testing tools, techniques, and best practices.
* Work closely with developers, QA engineers, and infrastructure teams to troubleshoot and resolve performance issues.

**Typical Qualifications**

* 8 to 12 years of experience in performance testing and engineering.
* Proficiency in performance testing tools such as JMeter or K6\.
* Strong understanding of performance testing methodologies, processes, and best practices.
* Efficient in using AI tools like Claude / Codex and designing skills which enable E2E performance test script design
* Hands on experience with profiling tools like Datadog, JVisual VM, GC analysis, AWR report analysis, heap dump and thread dump analysis to identify performance bottlenecks.
* Familiarity with SQL or Oracle queries
* Basic understanding of C\#, Java or any programming language.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.

*Along with health and financial benefits, athenistas enjoy perks specific to each location, including commuter support, employee assistance programs, tuition assistance, employee resource groups, and collaborative* *workspaces* — *some offices even welcome dogs.*
