title: MTS 2, Backend Software Engineer
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.


Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.


Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.


Join eBay’s Advertising and Marketing Technology teams to build the platforms, services, and user experiences that help sellers grow their business and make eBay the destination website for existing and new customers. You’ll work on high\-scale systems spanning frontend applications, backend services, APIs, data pipelines, and AI\-assisted engineering workflows, partnering closely with product, design, analytics, and applied science. We’re looking for engineers who can turn business problems into reliable, maintainable software, make sound technical tradeoffs, and take ownership from design through production. This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys solving practical engineering problems in a fast\-moving environment where performance, quality, and measurable customer impact matter.


**Job Responsibilities:**
-------------------------


* Design and build innovative advertising, marketing platform features that help eBay sellers, advertisers grow their business and help eBay become the dominant eCommerce platform.
* Develop scalable, highly available applications, APIs, and services using technologies such as Marko, React, Node.js, Java, and Scala.
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of complex features, from technical design and architecture through deployment and production support.
* Drive technical decisions, system design, and cross\-team collaboration to ensure scalable, reliable, and maintainable solutions.
* Leverage AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) throughout the development lifecycle for coding, debugging, testing, and code review to increase engineering velocity.
* Contribute to AI\-powered advertising and marketing features by collaborating with ML engineers on LLM integrations, recommendation systems, and intelligent campaign optimization.
* Contribute to a culture of continuous learning, Agile development, open\-source collaboration, and rapid software delivery.
* Mentor team members, participate in technical discussions, and help shape engineering best practices across the organization.

**Job Requirements:**
---------------------


* BS/BA in Computer Science or related field plus 10\+ years work experience or MS with 8\+ years of relevant experience.
* Strong experience in Java (17\+) and building services with Spring Boot or similar frameworks.
* Experience building scalable backend systems and RESTful APIs in distributed environments.
* Experience with event\-driven architectures and message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar).
* Experience with relational (Oracle/Postgres/MySQL) and/or NoSQL (Cassandra/MongoDB) databases, including schema design and query optimization.
* Familiar with Big Data stack (Hadoop, Spark, Flink etc).
* Proven ability to own end\-to\-end system design: writing technical design documents, leading design reviews, and making architectural decisions for multi\-service features.
* Experience designing scalable distributed systems with a track record of evaluating trade\-offs. (consistency, availability, latency, cost) and driving technical alignment across teams.
* Experience with AI\-assisted development practices and tools to increase engineering productivity (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent).
* Experience building or integrating LLM\-powered features, agentic workflows, or AI\-driven automation in production systems is a plus.
* Strong ownership mentality with ability to drive work end\-to\-end in a collaborative environment.
* Exposure to GraphQL and experience in building Federated GraphQL APIs is highly desirable.
* Experience on contributing to open\-source is a plus.

Benefits are an essential part of your total compensation for the work you do every day. Whether you’re single, in a growing family, or nearing retirement, eBay offers a variety of comprehensive and competitive benefit programs to meet your needs. Including maternal \& paternal leave, paid sabbatical, and plans to help ensure your financial security today and in the years ahead because we know feeling financially secure during your working years and through retirement is important.


Here at eBay, we love creating opportunities for others by connecting people from widely diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and geographies. So, being diverse and inclusive isn’t just something we strive for, it is who we are, and part of what we do each and every single day. We want to ensure that as an employee, you feel eBay is a place where, no matter who you are, you feel safe, included, and that you have the opportunity to bring your unique self to work. To learn about eBay’s Diversity \& Inclusion click here: https://www.ebayinc.com/our\-company/diversity\-inclusion/


We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.


**Additional Details**


eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

  

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

Other Skills

title: Senior Backend Engineer II
description:
Apollo.io is the leading go\-to\-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1\.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top\-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

### **Your Role \& Mission**



As a Senior Backend Engineer at Apollo, you'll be a critical part of a fast\-growing company, working on a cross\-functional team to build highly scalable systems and set the bar for how we engineer. The way we build has changed: this is an **AI\-native** role. We're not looking for someone who *also* uses AI, we're looking for someone who thinks *with* it, forms their own hypotheses, pressure\-tests what AI produces, catches its errors, and design more robustly than they could alone.



You'll work in an open, collaborative environment, give and receive hands\-on mentorship, and have real opportunities to grow. You'll interface daily with design, front\-end, analytics, product, and teams beyond Engineering. You enjoy working cross\-functionally to solve hard problems and make an impact. You strive for quality, are obsessed with improving it, automation, monitoring, squashing the bugs that sneak through and you're always investigating performance improvements and better ideas.


### **Daily Adventures \& Responsibilities**


* Design and implement highly scalable, highly available backend services with proper monitoring and alerting in place
* Ramp quickly into large, unfamiliar codebases, de\-risk your changes, understand blast radius, and ship with confidence
* Use AI as a core part of your workflow: generate and pressure\-test approaches, verify and catch AI's mistakes, and stand behind the quality of the code you ship with it
* Drive the full lifecycle of software development: product requirements, architecture, solution design, development, quality assurance, and maintenance, ownership doesn't end at deploy
* Scope and reshape under\-specified problems, and write clear design docs that satisfy real product needs
* Partner closely with PMs: translate product intent into technical decisions, surface the technical realities they need to make good calls, and push back on the spec when reality changes the answer
* Mentor others on best practices and effectively share knowledge to up\-level the team
* Communicate progress clearly to the product lead, engineering manager, and other stakeholders
* Introduce new technologies and ideas when they earn their place
* Give and receive technical and behavioral feedback; engage in scrum ceremonies, team culture, and collaborate with the team.

### **What We're Looking For**


* **AI\-native engineers.** You use AI to raise your bar, not just move faster forming your own hypotheses, pressure\-testing and verifying AI output, catching its errors, and taking full ownership of code quality regardless of how it was produced. You stay current with a fast\-moving toolset.
* **Comfort in unfamiliar code.** You ramp fast into systems you didn't write, reason about blast radius, and de\-risk changes rather than hoping they work.
* **Architectural ownership \& operational readiness.** You design for scale and availability, anticipate failure modes, and build with monitoring and alerting from the start.
* **Ownership start to finish.** Just because a project has been deployed doesn't mean it's done. You own outcomes , think end to end in terms of product and are customer obsessed
* **Collaboration you can trust.** You let others speak, seek to understand their viewpoints, and are the kind of teammate people want to build with.
* **Product judgment.** You care about the customer outcome, make the technical calls that produce a great product, and know when to challenge a spec.
* **Growth \& learning.** You actively improve your craft, your team, and how you work.
* **Proactivity.** You act without being told, identify areas of improvement, and drive best practices.
* **Comfort with ambiguity.** You can operate without a fully\-specified problem and bring structure to it.
* **Organization \& planning.** You break large projects into smaller pieces that are easier to estimate and deliver.
* **Strong communication.** Clear in writing and in person, across technical and non\-technical audiences.

### **Qualifications**


* Minimum 5\+ years of industry experience in backend development, at least 3\-4 years in senior positions, building large\-scale applications with right observability.
* Solid computer science fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, and object\-oriented design
* Fluency using AI tools in real development work, plus the judgment to verify and pressure\-test their output rather than trusting it blindly
* Experience developing distributed web applications
* Write code that is comprehensible, well\-structured, and highly performant
* Experience with database modeling (SQL or NoSQL both fine)
* Experience using and designing RESTful services


**Must have:** Curiosity, AI\-native engineering judgment, communication skills, problem solving.


**Nice to have:** BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or similar; GCP, Kubernetes, Docker, Mongo, Redis, Ruby on Rails, Microservices, Machine Learning



Apollo.io Tech Blog: deep dives into engineering, product design, and company\-culture stories from the Apollo team — behind\-the\-scenes insight into how Apollo builds and scales its B2B sales platform.

### **We are AI Native**



Apollo.io is an AI\-native company built on a culture of continuous improvement. We’re on the front lines of driving productivity for our customers—and we expect the same mindset from our team. If you're energized by finding smarter, faster ways to get things done using AI and automation, you'll thrive here.


### **Why You’ll Love Working at Apollo**



At Apollo, we’re driven by a shared mission: to help our customers unlock their full revenue potential. That’s why we **take extreme ownership** of our work, **move with focus and urgency**, and **learn voraciously** to stay ahead.



We invest deeply in your growth, ensuring you have the resources, support, and autonomy to **own your role and make a real impact**. Collaboration is at our core—we’re **all for one**, meaning you’ll have a team across departments ready to help you succeed. We encourage **bold ideas and courageous action**, giving you the freedom to experiment, take smart risks, and drive big wins.



If you’re looking for a place where your work matters, where you can push boundaries, and where your career can thrive—Apollo is the place for you.

description:

Join a world\-class team of skilled engineers who build creative digital solutions to support our colleagues and clients. We make a broad organizational impact by delivering cutting\-edge technology solutions that power Gartner. Gartner IT values its culture of nonstop innovation, an outcome\-driven approach to success, and the notion that great ideas can come from anyone on the team.


**About this role:**

This is a hands\-on technical role responsible for guiding the design, development, and execution of test strategies and automation frameworks. This role provides technical expertise to the QA team, mentors test engineers, and collaborates closely with developers, product owners, and project managers to ensure high\-quality product delivery.


**Skills \& Experience**

A strong IT professional with 4–6 years of experience in software testing. The candidate should have excellent technical, analytical, and communication skills, and demonstrate high ownership and accountability.

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. **What makes Gartner a great place to work?**

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.


We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.


Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.


We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.


**Gartner is the world authority on AI**

title: Exasol Evergreen Talents Hunt Challenge
description:
**Exasol Evergreen Talents Hunt Challenge**

**Location: Chennai, India**  

**Why Exasol? Why Now?**


Exasol is a high\-performance analytics database built for data at scale, for the new AI era. At Exasol, our engineers solve hard problems across distributed systems, performance, reliability and real\-world customer workloads needed for this new AI era.


The new AI era requires creators and builders who enjoy building robust technology and tackling complex technical challenges. We are building an evergreen talent community that enjoys doing so.


Here is an opportunity for you to be part of this evergreen talent community. Yes, it’s not a challenge for a job opening, but more a fodder for the hungry minds, a challenging teaser to the builder of the new AI era, that may lead to new opportunities in Exasol.


**How It Works?**

* Go through the OpenSource Challenge listed below
* Show us how you think, build and solve it
* Enjoy handsome rewards for best solutions
* Get into our Exasol Evergreen talent community.
* As part of Exasol Evergreen talent community, you will be prioritized for roles opening within Exasol. You will also be invited to participate in their meetups, conferences, webinars and any other events. You could be eligible for testing Exasol pre\-releases

**The Challenge \- Welcome to Exasol's Opensource Challenge**

* Pick a public open source project that is not hosted by Exasol
* The project must have at least 100 stars on GitHub
* Make it compatible with or add a feature for Exasol (e.g., by contributing a connector to the upstream project)
* Add automatic integration tests
* The upstream maintainers must accept and merge your contribution
* Make sure you will be able to maintain it
* Present the result


**Example Projects**


The list below is just to show what kind of upstream projects we mean. Participants to not have to pick those. There are hundreds of potential projects out in the world.

* GitHub \- xo/usql: Universal command\-line interface for SQL databases
* GitHub \- dbeaver/cloudbeaver: Cloud Database Manager
* GitHub \- kayak/pypika: PyPika is a python SQL query builder that exposes the full richness of the SQL language using a syntax that reflects the resulting query. PyPika excels at all sorts of SQL queries but is especially useful for data analysis.


**The Dos**

* Integrate with an existing open source project
* Ensure it is getting accepted upstream
* Make it maintainable. This is the most critical point
* Even if you maintain an upstream project, you can participate


**The Donts**

* Don’t start a new open source project just to integrate Exasol
* Maintainability should not require rewriting and more work


**Evaluation**


If someone manages to fulfill all criteria of the challenge, we will do a code and documentation review, to gauge how well that was executed.


Criteria (in descending order of importance):

* Security
* User experience
* Performance
* Maintainability


Winners (multiple categories) will be declared post evaluation and prizes given.


**What’s in it for You**


Completing a challenge gives you the opportunity to connect with Exasol, demonstrate your skills and ability to build new things, and become part of the broader global data community.

**Ready to Launch Your Career with Exasol?**


If you’re hungry to learn, unafraid to fail, and energized by the idea of helping the world’s leading organizations unlock the power of their data — we want to hear from you.


Apply now and be part of Exasol’s next chapter.

**About Exasol**


Take the next step in your career journey. Visit www.exasol.com to explore our current job openings, and follow us on LinkedIn to see what it is like to work at Exasol.


Exasol is a proud equal opportunities employer. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive working environment and therefore base all our employment selection decisions, within all aspects of our business, on experience, skill, and integrity. We strongly encourage applicants from all walks to life to apply for our positions, irrespective of age, sex, gender identity, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion, etc.

**ABOUT US:**  

As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
  
  

With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different \- in what we do, in how we work and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
  
  

Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
  
  

The Role
  
  

We are looking for an API Developer who builds the platform APIs other teams depend on, and runs them in production. You will write the code in TypeScript and Python, and you will own the Kubernetes deployments, pipelines and monitoring that keep it running.
  
  

These are platform APIs, so your users are other developers. That changes how you work: an API only succeeds if it is easy to adopt. We want someone who puts themselves in the user’s shoes before shipping.
  
  

Roles \& Responsibilities
  
  

Building Platform Capabilities
  
  

Design and build APIs in TypeScript and Python that other teams use as building blocks
  
Treat other developers as your customers. Talk to them, understand how they will integrate, and design for that
  
Write clear OpenAPI contracts, useful documentation and error messages that actually help the caller
  
Pick sensible defaults so the common case works with minimal setup
  
Keep versioning and backwards compatibility in mind, so adopting your API today does not create work for someone tomorrow
  
  

Deployment \& Operations
  
  

Package services as containers and deploy them to Kubernetes, writing and maintaining your own Helm charts
  
Ship through GitOps with Flux, so what is in the repository is what is running in the cluster
  
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions for automated testing, building and release
  
**Configure the API layer in front of your services:** routing, authentication, rate limiting and versioning
  
Instrument your services with OpenTelemetry so traces, metrics and logs show you a problem before a user reports it
  
Debug issues across application code, infrastructure and networking
  
  

Working in the Team
  
  

Take a problem with its context and come back with a proposal. You will not be handed a solution to implement
  
Review other people’s code and take review well on your own
  
Work with security and operations to keep services aligned with our controls
  
Qualifications \& Skills
  
  

Must Have
  
  

3–5 years building production APIs, comfortable in both TypeScript and Python
  
Good grasp of API design and OpenAPI (REST conventions, versioning, error handling, pagination)
  
**Real Kubernetes experience:** you can debug a pod that will not start, not just deploy to a cluster someone else built
  
Hands\-on with Docker and Helm
  
CI/CD experience, ideally GitHub Actions
  
Familiar with authentication patterns such as OAuth2, OIDC and JWT
  
Working knowledge of relational databases
  
You use AI tools every day, to get up to speed on unfamiliar technology, to explore options before committing, and to move faster on routine work, while still understanding what you ship. Tell us how you use them.
  
Able to work autonomously, raise questions early and own a piece of the platform end to end
  
Fluent in English
  
  

Nice to Have
  
  

API gateway experience such as Kong, a plus and not a requirement. We will train the right person
  
GitOps tooling such as Flux or Argo CD
  
OpenTelemetry and an observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo or similar)
  
Event\-driven architectures and messaging (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, Azure Service Bus)
  
Cloud platform experience (AWS or Azure)
  
Terraform basics, enough to provision your own databases, caches and queues
  
GraphQL
  
Previous platform engineering or developer experience work
  
Background in financial services or another regulated industry
  
Mindset
  
  

**We are looking for someone who:**  

Thinks about the developer on the other end of the API, and asks "would I want to integrate with this?" before shipping
  
Enjoys building the foundations other people build on
  
Is curious and self\-directed, you research what you do not know rather than waiting to be taught
  
Uses AI as a normal working tool, not a novelty, and stays critical of what it gives back
  
Is comfortable owning a service from the API contract through to production
  
Prefers asking a good question early over guessing quietly
  
  

WHAT WE OFFER

 Since 2015, Gravitee has grown into a global force, recognized as a 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader for API Management. What started with four developers challenging the complexities of APIs has evolved into a revolutionary platform powering API and event stream ecosystems worldwide. We drive digital transformation for top enterprises \- from Michelin to Roche to Blue Yonder \- offering unmatched control over APIs and event streams.
   

  

 Now, we are leading the next evolution: AI Agent Management. Our platform brings security and governance to the agentic ecosystem \- with our Agent Gateway for A2A protocol communications, native Model Context Protocol (MCP) support, and multi\-agent, multi\-LLM control.  As a Senior Platform Engineer, you will be part of a Platform Team dedicated to making Gravitee's products best in class in terms of both product and infrastructure. You will be responsible for building and maintaining the cloud infrastructure that powers Gravitee's platform, while also supporting our customers with exceptional technical expertise.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, critical role in our organization. The right candidate will enjoy problem solving in a highly specialized and technical way \- from delivering production\-ready Kubernetes\-based environments to investigating complex customer issues.

 AI at Gravitee is not about shortcuts \- it is about working smarter, faster, and more sustainably at scale.

* Strong understanding of infrastructure and deployment automation

title: Tech Ops Engineering II-SUPPORT SERVICES-CTO - In House Engineering
description:
Job Title: Production Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) – Digital Payments
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are seeking a highly technical and driven Production SRE Engineer to manage and monitor mission\-critical payment platforms including UPI, IMPS, and Payment Hub systems\& various Payment Applications.
   

  

 The role focuses on ensuring high availability, low latency, and seamless transaction experience for customers. The incumbent will collaborate with cross\-functional teams (Engineering, Business, Compliance) and external regulators (RBI, NPCI) to maintain resilient and scalable payment infrastructure.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Production Support \& Incident Management
   

  

* Provide L2/L3 production support for UPI, IMPS, and Payment Hub platforms \& various Payment Applications.
* Diagnose, triage, and resolve transaction failures, timeouts, and API disruptions.
* Lead and participate in Major Incident Management (MIM) calls and ensure timely stakeholder communication.
* Manage incidents, service requests, and problem tickets via Jira, ServiceNow.
* Provide regular updates to internal stakeholders and regulatory bodies (NPCI/RBI) during critical issues.


 Reliability Engineering \& RCA
   

  

* Perform deep\-dive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring payment and system issues.
* Implement preventive and corrective measures to improve system stability.
* Drive SRE best practices including error budgets, SLIs/SLOs, and system resilience.
* Experience in managing DR Drills \& Documentations.
* Reviewing the SOPs \& its relative documentations.


 Monitoring, Observability \& System Engineering
   

  

* Monitor key performance indicators: \- Transaction success rates
* Latency and response times
* Failure trends and retries
* Build and maintain dashboards using: \- ELK Stack, Grafana, Kibana, Splunk, Datadog, Prometheus
* Establish proactive alerting and anomaly detection mechanisms.
* Work closely with engineering teams to design and optimize: \- High\-throughput payment switches
* Routing logic
* Settlement and reconciliation systems
* Understand and support UPI architecture, IMPS rails, and payment orchestration layers \& various Payment Applications.
* Trace end\-to\-end transaction lifecycle across distributed systems.


 External Partner \& Regulatory Coordination
   

  

* Coordinate with NPCI, partner banks, and TPAPs during outages, reconciliation issues, or network disruptions.
* Lead integrations and ensure seamless onboarding of ecosystem participants.
* Ensure compliance with: \- RBI guidelines and data localization mandates
* NPCI operational and technical standards


 Technical Skills \& Expertise
   

  

 Payments Domain Knowledge
   

  

* Strong expertise in: \- UPI architecture and flows
* IMPS rails
* Payment gateway / switch systems
* Payment Hub orchestration \& various Payment Applications.


 Core Technical Skills
   

  

* Advanced SQL proficiency (joins, aggregations, stored procedures)
* Strong hands\-on experience in: \- Linux/UNIX systems administration
* Shell scripting
* Ability to: \- Read , Write and interpret All types documentation (SOPs, workflows, etc.)
* Understand database schemas
* Analyse system architecture and latency


 Monitoring \& Observability Tools
   

  

* Hands\-on expertise with: \- ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana)
* Grafana, Prometheus
* Splunk, Datadog


 DevOps \& Cloud
   

  

* Experience with: \- CI/CD pipelines, Containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
* Cloud platforms: \- AWS / GCP / Azure


 Key Competencies
   

  

* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills
* High ownership in production environments
* Ability to work under pressure in real\-time systems
* Strong stakeholder communication and coordination
* Focus on reliability, scalability, and performance
* Must have can do, takes initiative, Drives end to end deliverables.
* Proactive, solution\-oriented mindset with ownership to resolve production issues under pressure.
* Ability to clearly articulate incidents, updates, and RCA to stakeholders, leadership, and regulators.
* Works effectively with cross\-functional teams (engineering, product, partners, regulators).
* Structured thinking to diagnose complex system failures and drive long\-term fixes.
* Ability to stay calm and effective during high\-severity incidents and critical outages.
* Knowledge of PCI\-DSS compliance, Financial data governance \& security best practices
* Quickly adapts to changing technologies, incidents, and regulatory requirements in a fast\-evolving payments ecosystem.
* Precision in analysing logs, transactions, and system behaviour to avoid critical errors in production.
* Effectively manage multiple incidents, tasks, and escalations in a high\-pressure environment.
* Ability to handle expectations and coordinate with internal teams, partners, and regulators efficiently.
* Takes ownership to make quick, informed decisions during outages or critical production incidents \& communications to various Stake holders including Regulatory.

title: AI Technical Analyst
description:
**Technology \& AI Analyst – Business Intelligence \& Ratings Advisory** 




  





**Role Overview** 




 We are seeking a
 **Technology \& AI Analyst** 
 to help transform how our Business Intelligence and Ratings Advisory team uses data and technology to generate insights for the P\&C insurance and reinsurance industry.
 



 This role sits at the intersection of
 **insurance, financial analytics, data and emerging technology** 
 . The successful candidate will identify and lead opportunities to apply
 **GenAI, agentic AI, automation and modern data and analytics tools** 
 to improve how we source information, conduct analysis, generate insights and connect those insights to actionable client solutions.
 



 This is not a traditional IT or developer role. We are looking for someone who combines
 **technical capability with business curiosity** 
 , someone who can understand what we do, challenge how it is done today and use technology to fundamentally improve it.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 




  




* **Reimagine existing analytical workflows** 
 using GenAI, AI agents, automation and modern analytics, rather than simply automating existing processes.
* Develop tools and workflows that integrate
 **public financial information, regulatory and statutory filings, rating agency data, third\-party databases and internal data** 
 .
* Apply technology to generate differentiated
 **macro, sector and company\-level insights** 
 , identifying emerging trends, risks and opportunities.
* Help connect data and insights to
 **actionable client opportunities and solutions** 
 across reinsurance, capital and ratings advisory.
* Explore new AI and technology capabilities, determine where they can create value and
 **lead implementation from concept through deployment** 
 .
* Build scalable data and analytical capabilities using technologies such as
 **Python, SQL, Microsoft Azure and Databricks** 
 .
* Develop scalable approaches for accessing, analyzing and synthesizing large volumes of
 **structured and unstructured data** 
 .
* Partner with insurance and ratings specialists to translate business questions into effective technology and analytical solutions.
* Help drive
 **adoption of new tools and ways of working** 
 across the team.



  





**Qualifications** 



* **Bachelor’s degree** 
 in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Economics or another relevant field.
* Approximately
 **3\+ years of relevant experience** 
 in data and analytics, AI, technology, financial services or a related field.
* Strong hands\-on proficiency with
 **Python and SQL** 
 , including working with large datasets, data transformation and analytical workflows.
* Experience with
 **Microsoft Azure and Databricks** 
 or comparable cloud\-based data and analytics platforms.
* Experience developing and working with
 **APIs, data pipelines, databases and automated workflows** 
 .
* Practical experience with
 **GenAI and LLMs** 
 , including areas such as prompt engineering, RAG and search, agentic workflows and integrating AI into business processes.
* Ability to work with
 **large, complex and disparate datasets** 
 and translate them into useful analytics and insights.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with an ability to understand financial and business concepts.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively with
 **both technical and non\-technical subject\-matter experts** 
 .
* Demonstrated
 **self\-starter mentality** 
 , with the ability to identify opportunities, experiment with new approaches and take initiatives from idea through implementation.
* Intellectual curiosity and willingness to develop a strong understanding of the
 **P\&C insurance and reinsurance industry** 
 .



  





**Preferred Experience** 




  





 Experience in
 **insurance/reinsurance** 
 (or broader financial services) is highly desirable. Familiarity with one or more of the following would be particularly valuable:
 


* Insurance financial and statutory reporting, including
 **NAIC, Solvency II and Lloyd’s** 
 data.
* Financial and insurance databases such as
 **S\&P Capital IQ/SNL and AM Best** 
 .
* Rating agency methodologies, financial strength ratings or capital models.
* Financial statement, peer, sector or company\-level analysis.
* Experience applying
 **Azure, Databricks and GenAI capabilities** 
 to financial or insurance datasets.
* Advanced degree, CFA, actuarial qualifications or relevant AI/data certifications are helpful, but not required.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 The successful candidate will become the team's
 **technology catalyst** 
 , developing a strong understanding of our business, identifying where emerging technology can materially improve our capabilities and taking ownership of turning those ideas into practical solutions.
 



 We are looking for someone who asks not only
 **“How can we automate this?”** 
 but also
 **“How could technology fundamentally change how we do this, and what new insights could it allow us to deliver?”**

title: Tech S and T-AI -Architect-ISR-SeniorManager-GDSF02
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Description: AI Architect – Infrastructure \& Cloud**
**Title** 
 : AI Architect
   

  

**Level** 
 : Senior Manager
   

  

**Experience** 
 : 16\-18 years
   

  

**Role Summary**
 We are looking for an AI Architect to sit at the intersection of Infrastructure and Artificial Intelligence — someone who can design, build, and operationalize AI/LLM/Agentic solutions that solve real infrastructure problems: capacity planning, incident response, observability, automation, cost optimization, and resiliency engineering. This is not a pure research role — it's an applied engineering \+ architecture role for someone who can code, ship, and integrate AI into production infra workflows.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Architect and deliver AI/ML/LLM\-based solutions embedded into infrastructure operations (ITOps/AIOps, self\-healing systems, predictive capacity, automated RCA)
* Design and build agentic AI workflows (multi\-step, tool\-using agents) for infra automation — ticketing, monitoring, remediation, provisioning
* Evaluate, fine\-tune, and integrate LLMs (open\-source and commercial: OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, local/open models) into enterprise infra tooling
* Build RAG pipelines, vector databases, and knowledge\-grounding systems over infra documentation, runbooks, and CMDB data
* Write production\-grade code (Python primarily; scripting in Bash/PowerShell) — this role codes, doesn't just design PPTs
* Integrate AI solutions with cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP), ITSM tools (ServiceNow), observability stacks (Datadog, Splunk, Prometheus/Grafana), and CI/CD pipelines
* Define and enforce AI governance guardrails — data privacy, model security, hallucination control, cost/token management
* Partner with infra leadership to identify high\-ROI AI use cases and build the roadmap
* Mentor infra engineers on AI\-adjacent skills; act as the internal AI Center of Excellence lead for the infra vertical
* Own POC → pilot → production lifecycle for AI initiatives, including MLOps/LLMOps practices


**Must\-Have Skills**
* 16–18 years in Infrastructure/Cloud engineering or architecture, with the last 5–6 years focused on applied AI/ML/LLM work
* Strong hands\-on coding ability — Python (must), API integration, SDK usage (OpenAI/Anthropic/LangChain/LlamaIndex)
* Solid understanding of LLM fundamentals: prompting, fine\-tuning, embeddings, RAG, context windows, tokens/cost
* Practical experience building agentic AI systems (LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or custom orchestration) with tool\-calling/function\-calling
* Experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, Azure AI Search, etc.)
* Deep infra background: cloud architecture, networking, virtualization, ITSM, monitoring/observability, automation (Ansible/Terraform)
* Experience with MLOps/LLMOps — model deployment, monitoring, versioning, cost governance
* Strong architecture and solutioning skills — can whiteboard an end\-to\-end system and defend design tradeoffs


**Good\-to\-Have**
* Certifications: AWS/Azure/GCP AI or Solutions Architect
* Exposure to enterprise AI governance/responsible AI frameworks
* Experience presenting to CXO/leadership on AI strategy and business cases
* Prior experience in a Big 4 / GDS / large enterprise infra environment
* Open\-source contributions or published POCs in AI/agentic systems


**Soft Skills**
* Ability to translate ambiguous infra pain points into AI\-solvable use cases
* Strong stakeholder management — bridges infra teams, data science teams, and business
* Comfortable being hands\-on (code/architecture) as well as strategic (roadmap, governance)


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Description**
 We’re building the identity and access layer that every service in our SaaS control plane depends on. You’ll own the common auth stack — making sure the right principals get the right access, consistently, across every tenant and product surface.
   

  

**Requirements**
 You should have
   

  

 – 5\+ years building auth systems in production SaaS environments.
   

  

 – Strong Go or Python (ideally both); comfortable writing performant, well\-tested service code in either.
   

  

 – Deep knowledge of OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, JWT, and SAML — not just using libraries but understanding what’s happening underneath.
   

  

 – Experience with authorization policy engines (OPA, Casbin, or equivalent) and modeling complex permission structures.
   

  

 – Familiarity with multi\-tenant isolation patterns and the security implications of getting them wrong.
   

  

 – Comfort in an AWS/EKS environment with secrets management (AWS Secrets Manager, Vault).
   

  

 Nice to have: SCIM provisioning, FIDO2/WebAuthn, zero\-trust networking, SOC 2 audit experience, or prior work on a shared platform team serving internal consumers.
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

 – Design and operate the centralized authn/authz platform: token issuance and validation (OIDC/JWT), OAuth 2\.0 flows, API key management, and service\-to\-service identity.
   

  

 – Build and maintain the authorization model: RBAC and ABAC policies, tenant isolation enforcement, and fine\-grained permission evaluation (Open Policy Agent or similar).
   

  

 – Expose auth as a shared internal service consumed by the rest of the control plane — clean APIs, well\-documented contracts, and minimal coupling.
   

  

 – Partner with product and platform teams to implement SSO integrations (SAML, SCIM) and onboard enterprise identity providers.
   

  

 – Harden the auth layer: token rotation, secret management, audit logging, and threat modeling against common identity attacks.
   

  

 – Drive adoption of consistent auth patterns across services, replacing one\-off implementations.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

**Exciting Projects:**

title: Data & AI Transformation Lead - Senior Vice President
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


At Citi, we value engineering and foster an environment where our best engineers continue to code and grow their careers.


Oasys Financial is a sub\-ledger for Citi’s OTC business and covers global trading books across all asset classes. This system handles millions of trades daily and conduct all sub\-ledger activities and is a critical system for the bank. We are taking up overhauling \& re\-write of this platform.


We invite applications from experienced and well\-rounded senior technologist for a SVP role who can work in a globally distributed team. This role requires strong Technology and Business knowledge of OTC products, trade life cycle and Pnl. The candidate will join a team in the early stages of transformation. Candidate will find spending their time in both coding \& business analysis. There will be regular interfacing with senior stakeholders across the bank. Candidate will be expected to demonstrate an established track record of handling senior stakeholders \& lead such discussions independently.


Candidates are expected to demonstrate strong delivery background in financial industry, preferably in OTC products. We expect depth of knowledge in Java stack. Candidate should be willing to drive re\-architecture and lead by example. Candidate should be able to work in Kubernetes based deployments in both on\-prem and external cloud and deal with variety of build technologies. Candidate will have limited line management responsibilities, intentionally designed to provide focus on coding \& business analysis.


Growth opportunities are excellent and in future candidate will have options of choosing between engineering, business analysis or and management tracks. The team you’ll be working with is distributed across 3 countries.


**Key Responsibilities**

  

  

**Hands\-On Engineering \& Re\-Architecture**
  

* Be an active, hands\-on contributor to the codebase — designing, building, and reviewing new Java microservices that replace legacy components.
* Lead the re\-engineering of the existing Oasys codebase, breaking down monolithic structures and migrating business logic into a modern, event\-driven microservices architecture.
* Establish and enforce application methodologies and standards for program analysis, design, coding, testing, and implementation across the engineering organization.
* Analyze complex business processes, system workflows, and industry standards to define solutions to high\-level problems, particularly in the context of post\-trade processing and financial accounting.
**AI\-Assisted Development \& Change Leadership**
  

* Serve as the organization's champion and change agent for AI\-assisted software development, driving the adoption of tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, OpenAI Codex, and Devin across the engineering team.
* Bring deep, practical expertise in prompt engineering and apply it to accelerate development workflows, improve code generation quality, and automate repetitive engineering tasks.
* Lead by example — demonstrating how AI tooling can be integrated into day\-to\-day development practices to meaningfully improve productivity and code quality.
  

  

**Transformation Execution**
  

* Lead the design and delivery of the new Oasys platform in parallel with the Sybase IQ exit, overseeing the build\-out of high\-throughput data pipelines, distributed data stores, and scalable data processing frameworks.
* Drive the integration of new systems and functions to meet strategic goals, deploy new capabilities, and continuously enhance processes.
* Utilize advanced knowledge of the Oasys system flows and a comprehensive understanding of multiple technology domains to achieve transformation milestones on time and at scale.
**Leadership \& People Development**
  

* Build, lead, and inspire a high\-performing, multi\-disciplinary engineering organization in Pune.
* Allocate work effectively and act as an advisor and coach to developers, architects, analysts, and new team members, fostering a culture of engineering excellence and continuous learning.
* Develop the next generation of technical leaders within the team.

**Stakeholder Engagement**
  

* Influence and negotiate with senior global technology and business leaders, communicating the transformation vision, progress, and risks with clarity and confidence.
* Consult with end users and business stakeholders to identify system function specifications and incorporate them into the overall system design.
* Manage large program budgets and cross\-functional, multi\-project delivery.

**Risk \& Governance**
  

* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients, and assets.
* Drive compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations, adhering to Policy and applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct, and business practices.
* Escalate, manage, and report control issues with full transparency.

**Qualifications**


**Required**:
  

* 15\+ years of progressive experience in technology, with a significant portion in senior technical leadership roles — and a continued, active hands\-on involvement in software development.
* Java Expertise: Expert\-level background in Java, including designing and building resilient, high\-throughput distributed systems and microservices architectures. Must be comfortable writing and reviewing production code.
* Big Data Mastery: Deep, hands\-on expertise in modern Big Data platforms using technologies such as Apache Spark, Kafka, Presto/Trino, and distributed data lakes or lakehouses.
* Transformation Track Record: Demonstrated success leading complex, multi\-year legacy modernization and re\-engineering programs from concept to production in a global enterprise environment.
* Change Leadership: A proven change agent with the ability to shift engineering culture, introduce modern practices, and bring teams along on a transformation journey.
* Leadership: Exceptional organizational leadership skills with experience managing and developing multiple teams of senior engineers, architects, and technical leads.

**Preferred (Highly Desirable):**
  

* Prompt Engineering \& AI Tooling: Deep, practical experience with prompt engineering and hands\-on use of AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, OpenAI Codex, Devin) to drive engineering productivity and code quality at scale.
* Financial Domain: Experience in financial services, particularly in trading systems, post\-trade processing, sub\-ledger accounting, or risk platforms.
* Cloud Platforms: Experience with public or private cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and their associated data and compute services.

**Education:**
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline is preferred.

**Why Join Us?**
  

* Lead by Example: This is a role for a builder, not just a manager. You will be in the code, setting the standard, and driving change from the front.
* Be a Change Agent: Shape how an entire engineering organization thinks about modern development practices, AI tooling, and software craftsmanship.
* Unmatched Scale: Work on a system that processes millions of trades daily, presenting engineering challenges that are rare in their complexity and consequence.
* Build Something Lasting: Lead the creation of a modern platform that will serve as the foundation of Citi's post\-trade operations for years to come.

This role helps move AI Quality Automation from proof of concept into reliable operational use by building the deployment, CI/CD, observability, environment, reliability, and support foundations needed for enterprise adoption.

The Staff AI Quality Platform Engineer helps ensure current automation capabilities remain operational while enabling the future\-state platform to mature safely and responsibly.

**Lead Software Engineer \- (Priv Controls)**

  


**at Bitwarden in Engineering**

  


**Remote, U.S.**

  


**About Bitwarden**



Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California. Learn more at bitwarden.com.

  


**The Role**



As a Senior Software Engineer on Bitwarden's Priv Controls team you will lead the design and development of our next\-generation privileged access platform. You'll own critical gateway services, terminal access protocols, and auditing/enforcement at the intersection of security, scalability, and user experience.



In alignment with our modern **True Ownership** model, our engineers are "T\-shaped" professionals who own their services end\-to\-end—from initial design and secure development to automated testing, deployment, and operational health in production. This role offers unique opportunities to build secure\-by\-default patterns and make significant contributions to our open\-source security ecosystem.



This is an all\-remote team and we're looking for someone located in the US. We do not offer visa sponsorship at this time.

  


**RESPONSIBILITIES**


* **End\-to\-End Delivery:** Support Bitwarden goals by designing, developing, testing, deploying, and operating secure, performant gateway controls, audited terminal logins, and session recording mechanics for our PAM product line.
* **Decoupled Architecture:** Maintain strict service boundaries and design resilient APIs that allow the PAM platform to operate as an independent, decoupled tenant on our core platform infrastructure.
* **Upstream Collaboration:** Partner closely in a co\-located, cross\-functional "Embedded Trio" (Product, Design, and Engineering) to rapidly design and validate technical solutions prior to code implementation.

* **Operational Stewardship:** Own the operational health, performance, and reliability telemetry of your services in production, proactively participating in sustainable on\-call rotations and postmortem analyses.
* **Documentation:** Build and maintain high\-quality internal architecture specifications, API contracts, and external open\-source developer documentation.

  


**WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN**


* **Overall Experience:** 10\-15 years as a Software Engineer with team lead experience
* **Technical Stack:** Strong proficiency and experience in AI\-Led Development in C\# / .NET, Rust, or TypeScript.
* **Security Domain Expertise:** Practical experience designing or implementing secure gateway architectures, reverse proxies, and session proxying (SSH, RDP, or HTTPS).
* **Identity \& Auditing:** Understanding of Identity and Access Management, key\-rotation protocols, and real\-time audit logging systems.
* **T\-Shaped Engineering Mindset:** Practical experience with containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes), automated test frameworks (unit, integration, and end\-to\-end), and SRE/observability tools (APM, alerting, and telemetry dashboards).
* **Secure Coding:** Familiarity with zero\-trust and zero\-knowledge security architectures, encryption standards, and threat\-modeling methodologies.
* **Collaborative Spirit:** A highly collaborative and adaptable mindset, excited to work in rapid, outcome\-driven feedback loops.
* **Open Source Passion:** Excitement and enthusiasm for open source, developer advocacy, and building a more secure internet.
* **Problem\-Solving:** Excellent problem\-solving skills—valuing written, clear documentation and using data to make technical decisions.

* Interview/s with team members
* Reference calls


**A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US**


* Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world's largest organizations.

title: Staff Platform Engineer
description:
### **About Hupo**


We are an AI\-native start\-up building sales enablement products in the banking, financial services, and insurance industry; already trusted by **dozens of enterprise customers** (including Fortune 500 companies).

### **Role at a Glance**

**Title:** Staff Platform Engineer  

**Team:** Engineering  

**Employment Type:** Full\-time  

**Location:** Singapore, Europe, the US

### **What we do**


We build AI products for the people who sell insurance and banking products across Asia. An advisor can practise a hard client conversation against an AI persona, get a nudge during a live call, or have an AI agent make the first call for them. Our clients are big, regulated, and spread across markets and languages \- which means the interesting problems are latency, reliability, testing things that are not deterministic, security that satisfies a bank, and making an AI sound natural in Thai or Cantonese, not just English.

### **Why this role exists**


Two years ago we had one product. Now we have nine surfaces across seven enterprise clients, and most of them were built by hand, one client at a time. That is how you win early deals, and it worked. It will not keep working. The same things \- tenant configuration, identity, access to models, evaluation \- now exist in several slightly different versions, and every new client costs more engineering than the last.


We want one platform underneath all of it: shared services, configuration per client instead of code per client, and eventually a builder that lets us assemble a new use case instead of engineering it from scratch. This role leads that. You would own the platform core, pull shared capabilities out of products that have to keep shipping while you do it, and set the technical bar for a team of about seventeen engineers across India and Southeast Asia. It is hands\-on. You would write code every week. It is not a management job and it is not an architecture job that ends at a diagram.

### **What you would actually do**

* Build the shared pieces our products use \- configuration, identity and permissions, tenant isolation, model and retrieval access, evaluation \- once, properly.
* Extract them from the existing products without stopping delivery, and get more than one team to adopt what you build. The adoption part is the hard part.
* Make the architecture and migration calls across repositories, from design through to running in production.
* Set standards for ownership, review, testing, security and release, and hold them when a deadline makes it tempting not to \- while helping the team find a way through.
* Give teams a safe way to vary behaviour per client, so nobody needs a fork or an if\-statement with a client's name in it.
* Work with our infrastructure engineers on deployment, CI/CD and observability.
* Make sure every important system has a second owner. Including the ones you build.

### **First three months**

* **Month one:** get to know the codebase and the platform work already under way; agree the migration sequence with the working leads; become second owner of one critical system.
* **Month two:** first shared capability extracted and running in production for one product, with tests, an owner and an adoption plan for the next.
* **Month three:** a second product adopting it or migrating; the next two quarters of platform work written down and agreed; a named second owner for what you have built.

### **What we need from you**

* 8 or more years building production backend systems, and real Staff\-scope experience: architecture across several teams, migrations you led from start to finish, adoption you drove in teams that did not report to you.
* Deep production TypeScript and Node.js. Comfortable in Python, and comfortable reviewing code outside your main language.
* Multi\-tenant SaaS for real: you have designed, tested and operated the controls that stop one client's data reaching another.
* You have taken a monolith apart, or pulled shared services out of one, while it stayed in production \- and you can tell us what you did first, why, and what went wrong.
* Infrastructure judgment: Kubernetes, GCP or AWS, CI/CD, observability. You do not need to run it, but you design for it and you review it.
* Good security and data\-handling instincts, ideally from somewhere regulated.
* You write clearly. This team spans three time zones and most decisions travel in writing.
* You can push back on an unsafe shortcut under pressure and still have the person's trust afterwards.

### **Nice if you have**

* **Time in banking, insurance or another regulated industry; security reviews, SOC 2, or Singapore's OSPAR.**
* **LLM application work \- model gateways, retrieval, prompt versioning, evaluation harnesses, testing non\-deterministic output.**
* **Internal developer platforms or self\-service configuration systems.**
* **Real use of AI coding tools and an honest view of when they help and when they produce plausible code nobody has read.**

 complex problem\-solving experience., LLMs, Celery, PostgreSQL, Redis, Python, Django, FastAPI, AI Agent
   

  

**construction management platform that specializes in digitizing the entire project lifecycle is Looking for:**
**Job Description: Software Development Engineer 2 — Backend******
**What You Will Do**
* Own features end to end — data model, business rules, API contract, background jobs, migrations, testing and rollout.
* Take problems from the construction domain to production alongside product managers, not after them.
* Design APIs for web and mobile clients you do not control: versioning, pagination, validation and backward compatibility.
* Make technical design decisions and document the constraints, trade\-offs and failure modes behind them.
* Own what you ship in production — monitoring, alerts, debugging and the fix when a job stalls mid\-approval.
* Build systems that handle real\-world failure: retries, timeouts, partial failures, duplicate requests and inconsistent external dependencies.
* Work across backend and AI systems, deciding when a problem needs deterministic business logic, retrieval, an LLM or an agent.
* Use AI coding tools as leverage. Claude and Codex write a lot of the first draft here you are accountable for what lands.


**What We Need From You**
* 3\+ years minimum of production Python work that real customers depended on. Django, FastAPI or both.
* Strong software design fundamentals. You apply SOLID and clean architecture in practice: transport, business rules and persistence stay separated, dependencies point inward, and domain code does not know which framework it is running under.
* Test\-driven development. You write the test first when that is the faster route, and your tests describe behaviour rather than implementation.
* Technical design ownership. You can take an ambiguous requirement, identify constraints and trade\-offs, design the system and drive it through implementation.
* Judgment on service boundaries. You can argue for a modular monolith over microservices, and explain what would have to change for the answer to flip.
* Data models you can defend. You read the query plan before the ORM trick, and you have indexed a table that was already large and busy.
* Migrations under load. You understand schema changes against live data, including locks, backfills, rollbacks and running old and new versions of code simultaneously.
* Idempotency and retries. A job that runs twice here can move stock or money. You design accordingly.
* LLM systems built like software, not demos. Experience building agent systems using LangGraph, LangChain or equivalent abstractions, retrieval over a vector store, and integrations with more than one model provider.
* Agent infrastructure. You understand context and memory management, summarisation/compaction for long\-running conversations, structured tool calling, argument validation, retries and graceful behaviour when a tool fails or a model returns nonsense.
* RAG you have taken past the demo. You have worked with chunking, embeddings, retrieval and context assembly, and have measured retrieval quality rather than assuming it works.
* Evaluation\-driven AI development. You can build datasets and evaluation harnesses for retrieval and agent behaviour, compare model or prompt changes, and detect regressions before they reach production.
* Production AI judgment. You understand that LLM output is probabilistic and know where to introduce validation, deterministic business rules, fallbacks or human approval.
* Shipping hygiene. Git, Docker and CI/CD you keep green, and review comments that are specific enough to act on.
* Root\-cause debugging. You can go from a trace or production symptom to the actual cause, and leave behind a regression test.
* Mentorship. You improve the engineers around you through design reviews, code reviews and technical guidance.
* A bachelor''s degree in computer science, or the shipped work that stands in for one.


**BONUS POINTS**
* Evaluation and observability for non\-deterministic systems.
* Natural\-language interfaces over structured data.
* Multi\-modal input handled as a first\-class data problem.
* Vector stores in production — pgvector, Pinecone or Weaviate.
* AWS or Azure at the level of failure modes, reliability and cost, not just deploys.
* Enough JavaScript and CSS to debug across the boundary with the frontend team.
* Security practices and SOC 2 controls.
* Multi\-tenant SaaS at enterprise scale.
* Domain exposure to construction, ERP, procurement or fintech.
* Performance work on large datasets.
* Experience building systems that combine structured business data with unstructured documents.


**What We Offer**
* Competitive compensation.
* High ownership in a YC\-backed company, working on systems the whole product runs on.
* Range in one role — backend architecture, LLM systems, cloud infrastructure and system design.
* The opportunity to build production AI systems that operate on real construction workflows and business data.
* Mentorship from engineering leaders and a culture that values shipping over slideware.
* The opportunity to shape the architecture as RDash scales.

* Step 2: Complete the Screening Form \& Upload updated Resume
* Step 3: Increase your chances to get shortlisted \& meet the client for the Interview!

title: Software Development Engineer 2 – Fulfilment
description:
**Software Development Engineer 2 – Fulfilment** 




**About Urban Company** 




 Urban Company is Asia's largest tech\-enabled home services marketplace, operating across India, UAE, Singapore, and Saudi Arabia. Customers use our platform to book a wide range of services — beauty and grooming, cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, appliance repair, painting, and more — delivered at home, at a time of their choosing. Behind this simple promise sits a deep technology stack that matches millions of customers with trained, background\-verified service partners while guaranteeing a standardised, high\-quality, and reliable experience every single time.
 



  





**About the Fulfilment Team** 




 The Fulfilment team sits at the heart of Urban Company's marketplace — we make sure every customer gets the right service, from the right partner, at the right time. We do this through three core charters:
 



  





 \- Planning \& Shaping: Efficiently planning supply to meet forecasted customer demand, and intelligently shaping that demand to meet business goals.
 



 \- Capacity Management: Managing partner time and computing real\-time availability of UC services for any given time slot, customer location, business category, and skill requirement.
 



 \- Allocation \& Recovery: Assigning the most suitable partner for each job while maintaining fairness in partner earnings, and protecting customer experience in cases of no\-shows, cancellations, or partner unavailability.
 



 These are classic marketplace optimization problems — forecasting, matching, scheduling, and real\-time recovery — solved at the scale of millions of monthly service requests.
 



  





**Job Description: SDE\-2** 




 We are looking for experienced Software Development Engineers (SDE\-2\) to join our Fulfilment team. You will work on complex, high\-impact engineering challenges — the systems you build directly determine whether a customer's booking is fulfilled seamlessly and whether a partner earns fairly. If you enjoy problems that blend distributed systems, optimization, and real\-world operational constraints, this is the team for you.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 \- Design and build scalable, high\-performance, fault\-tolerant systems and services that power supply planning, capacity, and allocation.
 



 \- Develop and optimize intelligent algorithms and ML/AI\-driven solutions for demand forecasting, capacity planning, and partner–job matching.
 



 \- Own features end\-to\-end — from ideation and design to deployment, monitoring, and iteration across a modern tech stack.
 



 \- Raise the bar on the team's engineering practices: code quality, system architecture, observability, and operational excellence.
 



 \- Collaborate cross\-functionally with Product, Analytics, and Data Science teams to translate business problems into robust technical solutions.
 



  





**What Are We Looking For?** 




 \- Experience: 2–3 years of experience building large\-scale backend applications or Products.
 



 \-Technical Strength: Strong foundation in Data Structures, Algorithms, OS, Networks, and Database fundamentals, with a good understanding of distributed systems, concurrency, caching, and scalable architectures.
 



 \- Backend Skills: Proficiency in at least one backend language (Node.js, Java, Go, or Python). Experience with databases (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and messaging systems like Kafka is a plus; exposure to cloud platforms and production observability is desirable.
 



 \- AI Fluency: Hands\-on experience leveraging AI in day\-to\-day engineering — using AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to ship faster, and/or building with LLMs, ML models, or intelligent automation in production systems. Curiosity to apply.
 



 \- AI to real marketplace problems is a strong plus.
 



 \- Mindset: Bias for action, end\-to\-end ownership, and comfort with ambiguity.
 



 \- Team Player: Ability to work collaboratively with diverse teams and stakeholders.
 



  





**Why Join Us?** 




 \- Work on marketplace\-scale optimisation problems that few companies in the region get to solve.
 



 \- High ownership from day one — your systems ship to millions of users.
 



 \- A culture that rewards initiative, craftsmanship, and first\-principles thinking.

title: Systems Integration Engineer (OSS/BSS)
description:
**Your Role** 




 Megaport is looking for an experienced, hands\-on engineer in OSS and operations automation. This is a new role within Megaport’s operations department. The purpose of the role is to continue managing our monitoring and customer support systems, implement synergies with existing tools, and develop automation for day\-to\-day work. Your customers are the front\-line support team, CS / TSE / NOC, Network Operations Engineering and Production Development Engineering teams.
 



  





 To be successful in this role, you will need to be experienced in relevant technologies, have excellent interpersonal skills, be able to project\-manage dependencies across technical departments and lead the implementation of operations tools/automation strategy.
 



  





 We are looking for someone excited to lead the development of this capability. There is an abundance of high\-value opportunities in this space for Megaport. Proven experience in designing, implementing and maintaining OSS tools is a must. The ideal candidate would have a genuine interest in analysing measurable operations work activity, exploring opportunities to develop systemic automations and managing the design and implementation of the identified opportunities.
 



  





**About Megaport** 




 We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia\-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.
 



  





**What You’ll Be Doing** 




  





**1\. OSS, Observability \& Network Assurance** 



* Deploy, maintain, and optimize open\-source monitoring stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenNMS, Alerta) to modernize network assurance.
* Configure streaming telemetry, SNMP, and automated alert thresholds across cloud apps and network elements for rapid failure detection.
* Provide Level 3 troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis (RCA) for complex system and network incidents.



  





**2\. Software Engineering, Automation \& DevOps** 



* Build custom automations, scripts, and front\-end user interfaces (Python, JavaScript, HTML, REST APIs, Message Bus) to streamline tools and eliminate manual operational bottlenecks.
* Maintain solution delivery end\-to\-end—from solution design and API integrations to QA testing and release management.
* Support deployment pipelines using GitHub\-based CI/CD and cloud infrastructure on AWS.



  





**3\. Business Systems \& Ecosystem Integration (Salesforce \& Atlassian)** 



* Maintain operational integrations within Salesforce Service Cloud and ticketing workflows to keep front\-line support running smoothly.
* Administer Jira spaces, custom workflows, and native automations to streamline cross\-team handoffs between NOC, CS, and Engineering teams.
* Build targeted operational dashboards (Power BI, Salesforce, Jira) to track SLAs and performance metrics.



  





**4\. Stakeholder Engagement \& Process Improvement** 



* Partner with NOC, CS, and Engineering leads to translate operational pain points into clear technical requirements, user stories, and workflows.
* Author and update technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and operational playbooks in Confluence.
* Participate in scheduled on\-call rotations to ensure high platform availability.
* Deploy, maintain, and optimize open\-source monitoring stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenNMS, Alerta) to modernize network assurance.
* Configure streaming telemetry, SNMP, and automated alert thresholds across cloud apps and network elements for rapid failure detection.
* Provide Level 3 troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis (RCA) for complex system and network



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




  





 This is a broad, high\-impact role with wide visibility across our operations ecosystem. We know no candidate will check every single box on this list! If you have strong hands\-on experience in OSS/Fault Management, Python/DevOps, and Telecom systems, but are keen to expand your skills into our Salesforce and Atlassian environments, we want to hear from you.
 



  




* 5\+ years of experience in Telecom, NaaS, or ISP environments working with OSS/BSS and Fault Management systems.
* Proven hands\-on experience with open\-source observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenNMS, Alerta, or similar).
* Strong programming and scripting skills in Python, Shell, and front\-end web basics (HTML, JavaScript), alongside solid Linux sysadmin and DevOps/CI/CD pipeline experience.
* Strong cross\-team collaboration skills with a track record of driving operational improvements under pressure.
* Familiarity with
 **Salesforce Service Cloud** 
 or declarative/programmatic automations.
* Experience configuring Jira spaces, custom workflows, or Atlassian automations.
* AWS cloud infrastructure and REST API / Webhook integration experience.



  





**Working Conditions, Location and Hours** 



* Full\-time office\-based role, at our Gurugram office
* The working day is 8 hours, and the working week is 40 hours.
* 24/7 on\-call availability for emergencies
* You will get 2 days weekly off (on\-call availability for emergencies)
* 90\-day notice period for resignation after the probation period
* Working exclusively for Extreme Infocom Pvt. Ltd. and not for any other companies



  





**What We Offer** 




 Subject to the internal policies of Megaport, which may be updated from time to time:
 


* 18 days per year's privilege/earned leave
* Family health insurance according to company policy
* A motivated team combining industry experts and emerging talent.
* Recognition programs – including Legend and Kudos Awards.
* Health \& wellness programs and mental well\-being support.



  





 If you have any questions, please reach out to Megaport's Talent Acquisition Team at Careers@megaport.com

If you have any concerns, please reach out to Megaport's careers team careers@megaport.com directly and we will verify the legitimacy of any communication. Megaport will not ask you to create an account via Microsoft teams, and does not associate with any email accounts under "@megaportau.com".***
