description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.  



  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.


**Introduction to team:**

Our Technology Team partners with teams across Expedia Group to create innovative products, services, and tools to deliver high\-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction.


Our team is looking for a Software Development Engineer II for our Tax and Regulatory Platforms. As a member of this team, you will have the opportunity to build and support the Global Tax Platform and Unified Regulatory Platform for the travel industry.


These highly resilient systems must scale to process Expedia Group's entire business transactions in real time, while adapting to ever\-changing regulations across global markets. They power complete transaction lifecycles from shopping through booking, invoicing, accounting, filing, reporting, and beyond with financial\-grade accuracy and robust audit trails.


This is an opportunity to take a pivotal role in building the travel industry's premier commerce and financial platforms. You will design and implement APIs, data streams, real\-time compute, and data lake storage at scale pushing the boundaries of cloud technologies including Kafka, Kubernetes, gRPC, Apache Spark, and Flink.


**In this role, you will:**

**Core Engineering**

* Work in small, agile teams to design, develop, test, and maintain scalable and resilient services across the Tax and Regulatory Platform
* Build and operate cloud\-native streaming data, real\-time processing, and data lake platforms at scale using Kafka, Kubernetes, Apache Spark, and Flink
* Ensure all software meets the highest standards of performance, security, scalability, and financial\-grade accuracy
* Review pull requests and lead by example on code quality refactoring for readability, extensibility, and testability
* Leverage CI/CD techniques and tools to maximise delivery speed, reliability, and operational confidence
* Embrace change always open to replacing what you built yesterday with something better today
* Support ever\-changing global regulatory requirements by building adaptable, configurable platform components that reduce time\-to\-compliance in new markets
* Drive observability and reliability across services using DataDog, Splunk, or equivalent tooling ensuring proactive detection and resolution of issues
* Share knowledge, mentor peers, and contribute to a culture of continuous learning including AI fluency across the engineering team

**AI \& Intelligent Systems**

* Design and integrate AI\-powered capabilities into regulatory and financial workflows including intelligent document processing, automated compliance checks, and anomaly detection
* Build and maintain RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) pipelines connecting internal knowledge sources, regulatory datasets, and transaction data to LLM\-powered services for accurate, context\-aware outputs
* Integrate and manage model inference endpoints into production services, ensuring low latency, high availability, and cost\-efficient serving at scale
* Experiment with and adopt AI developer tooling leveraging tools like GitHub Copilot and Claude to accelerate engineering velocity across the team
* Apply responsible AI practices in compliance\-sensitive contexts including prompt engineering, hallucination mitigation, output validation, and audit trail requirements
* Collaborate with data science and ML teams to translate model outputs into reliable, production\-grade engineering solutions aligned to regulatory standards.

**Experience \& Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience
* 3\+ years of relevant professional experience in software engineering
* **Java preferred** Experienced software developer with strong system design, problem\-solving, and object\-oriented coding skills
* **AWS, Kubernetes/Containerisation, and Apache Spark/Streaming preferred** Experience developing in cloud environments
* Experience delivering and supporting highly available, scalable, and fault\-tolerant distributed systems
* Excellent teamwork and communication skills with the ability to collaborate across cross\-functional teams
* Proficiency with monitoring and observability tools such as DataDog or Splunk
* Strong experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for rapid, reliable delivery

**AI Fluency \& Emerging Technologies**

* Foundational understanding of AI/ML concepts and how large language models (LLMs) are applied in production engineering contexts

title: Senior Associate Technology L1_Python
description:
**Job Description**
 Publicis Sapient is looking for Python Developers to join our team of bright thinkers and enablers. You will use your problem\-solving skills, craft, and creativity to design and develop infrastructure interfaces for complex business applications. You will build and orchestrate agentic, GenAI\-powered workflows that transform how our clients operate – from data ingestion and enrichment to intelligent, LLM\-driven automation. We are on a mission to transform the world, and you will be instrumental in shaping how we do it with your ideas, thoughts, and solutions.
   

  

**Your Impact:**
* Build and orchestrate agentic workflows using LangChain and LangGraph to power scalable, production\-ready GenAI solutions.
* Develop reusable components for data ingestion, transformation, enrichment, and validation that accelerate delivery across projects.
* Ensure reliability, scalability, and traceability across agent workflows to support dependable, enterprise\-grade AI applications.
* Implement performance monitoring with tools like LangSmith and apply tuning mechanisms to continuously improve agent accuracy and efficiency.
* Deploy and maintain Python\-based GenAI services in production, leveraging Bitbucket, Git, and CI/CD tools for reliable releases.
* Architect secure API communication and access management, using JWT, OAuth, and RBAC, to safeguard sensitive client data.
* Apply NLP, LLM, and retrieval techniques, including vector stores and embeddings, to build context\-aware, intelligent solutions for clients.


**Qualifications**
**Your Skills \& Experience:**
* Strong Python fundamentals (OOP, data structures, error handling) with hands\-on experience using Pandas, NumPy, PySpark, or Dask.
* Hands\-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, and Semantic Kernel, building agent orchestration, memory, and tool\-use workflows.
* Proficiency in Python API frameworks (Flask/FastAPI), with experience using IDEs such as VSCode and PyCharm.
* Working knowledge of SQL/NoSQL databases, time\-series data, and data modeling and schema design.
* Basic integration experience with TensorFlow or PyTorch, plus exposure to vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Chroma) and embedding\-based retrieval.
* Proficiency with AWS Cloud Services and production deployment practices, including Bitbucket, Git, and CI/CD tools.
* Strong understanding of security \& access management – JWT, OAuth, RBAC – and secure API communication.


**Additional Information**
**Set Yourself Apart With:**
* Prior work on GenAI, CoPilot, or RAG\-based systems.
* Familiarity with marketing data models and real\-time customer journeys.
* Exposure to NLP, LLMs, and retrieval frameworks beyond the core requirements above.


**A Tip from the Hiring Manager:**
 “AI is evolving fast – join us to work hands\-on with big clients, sharpen your skills, and stay future\-ready.
   

  

**Benefits of Working Here:**
* Gender\-Neutral Policy
* 18 paid holidays throughout the year.
* Generous parental leave and new parent transition program
* Flexible work arrangements
* Employee Assistance Programs to help you in wellness and well\-being.


**Company Description**
 Publicis Sapient is a digital transformation partner helping established organizations get to their future, digitally enabled state, both in the way they work and the way they serve their customers. We help unlock value through a start\-up mindset and modern methods, fusing strategy, consulting, and customer experience with agile engineering and problem\-solving creativity. United by our core values and our purpose of helping people thrive in the brave pursuit of next, our 20,000\+ people in 53 offices around the world combine experience across technology, data sciences, consulting, and customer obsession to accelerate our clients’ businesses through designing the products and services their customers truly value.

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**SAP FI\+Tax Engine\-Vertex \- Tax Technology Services Consultant II**
 Join Deloitte’s Tax Technology Consulting practice in India and help global clients modernize and transform their tax operations. This role focuses on delivering technology\-enabled indirect tax solutions that improve compliance, reporting, and business process integration across complex ERP environments. You will work with cross\-functional teams and multinational stakeholders to implement scalable tax engine and SAP finance solutions that support evolving business and regulatory needs.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Senior, Tax Technology Services on the Tax Technology Consulting team, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Supporting the implementation, enhancement, and maintenance of indirect tax technology solutions within SAP or Oracle enterprise resource planning environments
* Configuring and integrating OneSource Indirect Tax Determination or Vertex O Series with SAP Finance and related Procure\-to\-Pay, Order\-to\-Cash, and Record\-to\-Report processes
* Designing, testing, and deploying tax determination configurations, content updates, and configuration migrations for global and North American business requirements
* Developing and supporting SAP forms, reports, customizations, and service level agreement rules to address indirect tax process needs
* Preparing client demos, status updates, and project deliverables while managing multiple workstreams and timelines


**The team**
 Deloitte’s Tax Technology Consulting team helps organizations transform tax operations through the use of enterprise technology, automation, and scalable process design. The team works at the intersection of tax, finance, and technology to support implementation of indirect tax solutions that align with client business requirements. Professionals in this group collaborate across global teams to deliver practical, technology\-enabled outcomes for complex tax environments.
   

  

**Location: All Locations**
**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* 4\+ years of experience in enterprise resource planning implementation or support in SAP or Oracle environments
* 2\-4 years of hands\-on experience with OneSource Indirect Tax Determination or Vertex O Series
* Experience integrating Procure\-to\-Pay, Order\-to\-Cash, and Record\-to\-Report processes with SAP Finance and third\-party tax engines
* Experience configuring OneSource Indirect Tax Determination or Vertex O Series for indirect tax calculation
* Experience supporting indirect tax requirements for value\-added tax, sales tax, or use tax
* Experience developing SAP forms, reports, or customizations
* Experience creating client demonstrations, presentations, or ad hoc materials for stakeholder audiences


 Preferred:
   

  

* Experience integrating SAP S/4HANA with OneSource Indirect Tax Determination using Global Next or with Vertex O Series using Vertex Indirect Tax Accelerator
* Experience with native SAP indirect tax configuration
* Experience with testing tools, content updates, and configuration migration within OneSource or Vertex
* Experience with Vertex CFA
* Experience with defect management, documentation, user support, and enhancement delivery across the project lifecycle
* Experience with indirect tax reporting in SAP

description:

 A career in IBM Consulting is built on long\-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact.  As a Package Consultant specializing in SAP HANA SCM SD, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and configuring SAP HANA\-based Supply Chain Management (SCM) and Sales and Distribution (SD) solutions for clients. Your expertise will enable clients to optimize their sales and distribution operations, improve customer satisfaction, and increase revenue.

* Deliver Solution Value: Help clients realize the value of implemented solutions, providing guidance on how to optimize sales and distribution operations, improve customer satisfaction, and increase revenue.

 Master's Degree

* SAP HANA Implementation: Experience implementing SAP HANA\-based SCM and SD solutions that meet clients' business requirements, with a focus on optimizing sales and distribution operations.
* Supply Chain Optimization: Experience with analyzing and optimizing supply chain operations using SAP HANA, SCM, and SD tools, to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
* SAP HANA Integration: Experience with integrating SAP HANA systems with other business applications to support SCM and SD operations.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Advanced SAP HANA Knowledge: Experience with advanced SAP HANA features and functionalities, including data modeling, data warehousing, and analytics. Ability to apply this knowledge to design and implement complex SAP HANA\-based SCM and SD solutions.

Ability to apply this knowledge to help clients optimize their sales and distribution operations.

title: Kubernetes Platform Architect (India, Bangalore, Remote))
description:
**Job Description:**
 The VKS Application Engineering team is responsible for enabling enterprise success with VMware Kubernetes Service (VKS) as part of VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF). Our mission is to accelerate adoption of VKS as the enterprise\-grade Kubernetes platform for modern applications in private cloud.
   

  

 As a VKS Application Engineer, you will be on the front lines with enterprise customers, driving the successful adoption of VMware Kubernetes Service (vKS) on VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF). This is a hands\-on, customer\-facing role focused on designing and validating solutions, running proof\-of\-concepts, and guiding customers through their modernization journey.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Act as a trusted advisor for enterprise customers, guiding them through the design, validation, and deployment of vKS solutions on VCF.
* Collaborate closely with field account teams to align solution architecture with customer priorities and drive successful engagement outcomes.
* Lead technical discovery sessions, workshops, and proof\-of\-concepts to validate vKS architectures and demonstrate business value.
* Partner with sales to jointly develop customer proposals that address modernization goals, workload placement, and operational transformation.
* Provide prescriptive guidance on Kubernetes adoption, DevOps/CI\-CD integration, and enterprise requirements such as scalability, security, and disaster recovery.
* Build and share reference architectures, deployment patterns, and technical assets to accelerate customer adoption of VKS.
* Deliver clear, compelling technical presentations to diverse audiences, from architects to executive decision makers.
* Stay current on industry trends, competitor offerings, and evolving enterprise requirements to position VKS effectively.
* Collaborate with product management and engineering to provide field feedback that influences roadmap direction.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
